title: Sr. Communication Sys Engineer, Modeling and Simulation
description:
Amazon Leo is a low Earth orbit satellite constellation providing low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. The mission of Amazon Leo for Government is to leverage Leo and provide high speed, low latency, and secure satellite services to United States and allied government customers. As a Modeling and Simulation Systems Engineer supporting that mission, this role is primarily responsible for assessing and analyzing how both Leo's capabilities and Leo products built for government perform against government use cases, and for producing the analyses that underpin government contract work. You will evaluate system and network performance from the capacity, coverage, latency, and availability point of view to determine how Leo delivers the operational outcome the customer mission needs. It is a unique opportunity to innovate and define groundbreaking wireless technology with few legacy constraints.

Key job responsibilities
• Own system-level modeling, simulation, and analysis for government mission scenarios and constellation designs, across coverage, capacity, latency, and availability, from concept trades through customer deliverables
• Perform mission engineering: translate customer mission objectives into scenarios and measures of effectiveness, develop design reference missions and CONOPS, and model whether the end-to-end system delivers the required operational outcome
• Apply orbital mechanics, including orbit and constellation geometry, reference frames, revisit and access behavior, and station-keeping and conjunction considerations, as the foundation of coverage, access, and contact analyses
• Design and evaluate resource scheduling and allocation approaches, heuristic or solver-based, for contact scheduling, satellite beam assignment, and prioritization under power, thermal, and spectrum constraints
• Evaluate complex multi-disciplinary trades involving RF bandwidth and network resource allocation to customers, optimizing customer experience against cost, power, and spectrum, including constellation design and link selection trades
• Build and/or utilize RF and optical link budgets and combine them with orbital constellation dynamics to model time-varying system capacity, latency, and availability
• Model inter-satellite geometry and access, including link availability windows, contact scheduling, and handover behavior
• Extend existing simulation code and tools, and create new simulation models representative of the target system (primarily MATLAB, also C++ / Python), designing around hardware and software capabilities and constraints to support a dynamic network topology
• Prepare and present technical content for government customers and program reviews, including analysis packages, visualizations, briefings, and proposal material
• Account for self-interference and interference with other space and terrestrial communication systems in coverage and capacity analyses


Export Control : This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.

title: Senior Crm Manager 12M Ftc | Lookfantastic
description:
About THG

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.

Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?

Life at THG Beauty

We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.

By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin, with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.

THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader.

About The Role
This is an exciting opportunity for an established Senior CRM Manager to lead the LOOKFANTASTIC CRM team. This role is responsible for ensuring markets deliver against the overall CRM strategy, creating plans aligned with market maturity and business growth ambitions. Managing a CRM team of eight who have responsibility for the UK & Ireland and EU regions, you will work closely with our marketing activation and trading teams to increase the CRM mix-of-business, drive customer activation and customer retention metrics.

Why be a Senior CRM Manager at THG Beauty?

This is an exciting opportunity for an established Senior CRM Manager to lead the LOOKFANTASTIC CRM team. This role is responsible for ensuring markets deliver against the overall CRM strategy, creating plans aligned with market maturity and business growth ambitions. Managing a CRM team of eight who have responsibility for the UK & Ireland and EU regions, you will work closely with our marketing activation and trading teams to increase the CRM mix-of-business, drive customer activation and customer retention metrics.

As Senior CRM Manager you’ll:

  • Deliver LOOKFANTASTIC’s CRM strategy across key CRM channels, including email and app push.
  • Develop monthly CRM campaign plans, rooted in data and insights, to meet commercial targets whilst delivering an optimal customer experience. Ensure operational excellence in the team’s execution of these plans.
  • Continually review the automations programme (workflows and triggers), monitoring and reporting on performance. Identify challenges and opportunities to improve performance ongoing, whether that be optimisations of existing and/or introduction of new workflows and automations.
  • Lead Test & Learn initiatives across markets: Planning, implementation and reporting of a regular testing framework across each CRM channel, aligned to overall strategy, to drive ongoing optimisations.
  • Identify touchpoints for improvement and implement strategies to maximise customer satisfaction, retention and lifetime value. For example, initiatives to increase opt in rates; initiatives to reduce unsubscribe rates; getting CRM customers into our app, loyalty scheme, subscription propositions, and so on.
  • Contribute regularly to trading meetings and communicate to senior stakeholders the performance of CRM channels, both campaigns and automations.
  • Manage and motivate the team to deliver against targets, whilst supporting their personal goals and objectives. As part of this, ensure ways of working set the team up for success.

What skills and experience do I need for this role?

  • 4+ years in a CRM role with direct line-management experience of managing multiple team members at the same time
  • Proven ability to analyse data and draw out actionable insights
  • Highly articulate and confident communicator with strong influencing skills
  • Ability to work with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
  • Confident dealing with senior stakeholders
  • Self-motivated multi-tasker able to handle multiple projects with good time management
  • Strong commercial acumen

What’s in it for me?

Career Development

  • Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team.
  • Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.

Enhanced Leave

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
  • Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us!
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.
  • Up to 10 days compassionate leave.
  • Buy back up to 3 days each year.
  • Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months.

Wellbeing Support

  • Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.
  • Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.
  • State-of-the-art on-site gym.
  • Access to our on-site physio.

Other Perks

  • Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme.
  • Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.
  • Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands.

  • On-site staff shop.
  • Know someone who would be perfect for THG? Refer them and get up to £1000 when they pass their probation.
  • Anniversary gifts when you hit 5 and 10 years of service.

THG is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.

THG is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.

Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. title: Oracle APEX Operations Technical Leader
description:
Oracle APEX Operations Technical Leader


Would you like to be a part of successful team?

Join our team!

Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company, who delivers across the energy value chain through our market-leading business segments. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries. Our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward! Making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

Partner with the best

We operate at the heart of the digital transformation of our business. From Digital Engineering to enabling employee success, the Digital Technology team is driven to provide the best products and services. We collaborate with teams to solve complex technical challenges and design future innovations.

As a Digital Technology Senior Specialist, you will also be responsible for:

  • Owning the operational health, reliability, security, performance, and lifecycle of a portfolio of enterprise Oracle APEX applications.
  • Leading AppOps, DevOps, and DevSecOps practices and coordinating internal teams and suppliers across development, support, infrastructure, database, cloud, and cybersecurity.
  • Leading incident management and major-incident response, including prioritization, service restoration, stakeholder communication, escalation, and post-incident review.
  • Owning problem management, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, knowledge management, and initiatives that reduce recurring incidents.
  • Governing change and release management through impact and risk assessment, implementation planning, testing evidence, approvals, deployment coordination, rollback readiness, and post-implementation validation.
  • Defining and monitoring service levels and operational KPIs, including availability, performance, incident volume, resolution time, change success, backlog, vulnerability remediation, and operational risk.
  • Driving CI/CD, source control, automated testing, deployment automation, environment management, and repeatable release practices for Oracle APEX solutions.
  • Embedding security throughout the application lifecycle through secure coding, access controls, vulnerability management, dependency governance, security testing, and remediation tracking.
  • Acting as the technical authority for Oracle APEX, Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL, Oracle REST Data Services, integrations, and related cloud technologies.
  • Leading complex troubleshooting, performance tuning, capacity planning, technology upgrades, and obsolescence remediation with minimum business disruption.
  • Partnering with technical leaders, product owners, enterprise architects, business stakeholders, service-management teams, and governance functions to prioritize operational improvements and technical investments.
  • Mentoring engineers, setting clear technical and operational expectations, and fostering accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and automation.
  • Representing the application portfolio in change advisory boards, architecture reviews, service reviews, risk forums, audits, and cross-functional technology initiatives.

Fuel your passion!

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Have significant experience supporting and technically leading enterprise applications, including at least five years working with Oracle APEX and Oracle Database technologies.
  • Have proven ownership of production application operations in a complex enterprise environment, including incident, problem, change, release, and service-level management.
  • Demonstrate the ability to lead major incidents, coordinate cross-functional technical teams, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
  • Have advanced proficiency in Oracle APEX, SQL, and PL/SQL, including application architecture, database object design, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and scalable solution design.
  • Have strong knowledge of Oracle APEX security, including authentication, authorization, role-based access control, session protection, secure coding, data protection, and API security.
  • Have experience with source control, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, environment promotion, release governance, and rollback planning.
  • Have practical DevSecOps experience, including vulnerability assessment, secure development controls, patching, dependency management, security remediation, and risk-based prioritization.
  • Have experience establishing monitoring, logging, alerting, runbooks, service KPIs, operational dashboards, support models, and disaster-recovery procedures.
  • Have experience integrating Oracle APEX applications with enterprise systems through REST APIs, SOAP services, Oracle REST Data Services, Oracle Integration Cloud, Oracle API gateway or similar technologies.
  • Have working knowledge of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure or comparable cloud platforms and their application, database, identity, networking, monitoring, and security services.
  • Have experience defining technical standards, conducting architecture and code reviews, mentoring engineers, and improving engineering and operational practices across an application portfolio.
  • Demonstrate sound judgment in technology decisions through due diligence, risk assessment, business-impact evaluation, and lifecycle planning.
  • Have strong analytical, leadership, collaboration, supplier-management, and stakeholder-communication skills, with fluency in English.
  • ITIL Foundation or equivalent service-management experience is preferred.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.

About the role

As a Delivery Manager in our Public Services team at Faculty, you will act as a pivotal commercial and delivery lead, driving high-stakes AI transformation for the UK’s most critical government partners.

You will be a key point of contact for both our external clients and internal technical teams, building deep networks of influence and solving complex challenges by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI research and operational mission needs.

With an entrepreneurial spirit, you will work with multidisciplinary teams to ensure every project delivers meaningful, long-term value in a fast-evolving landscape.

What you'll be doing:

  • Owning the end-to-end delivery of our AI projects for prominent clients across the Public Services space

  • Working side-by-side with Government stakeholders to understand critical mission challenges and user needs

  • Collaborating with technical, innovation, and other key client teams

  • Managing projects, driving development and ensuring a delivery approach that provides maximum value to the customer

  • Forming strong, trusting relationships with customers, internal team members (e.g. data scientists, ML engineers), and technical partners to translate user research into solution requirements and operational impact

  • Developing and executing compelling proposals to grow our footprint and impact across Public Services

  • Advising clients on AI strategy and technical implementation, acting as a trusted partner in high-stakes environments (with support from a technical team)

  • Mentoring your peers and taking a proactive role in building robust processes and practices within the team.

Who we're looking for:

  • You possess experience in consultancy or service-based delivery, allowing you to manage complex project lifecycles and meet critical deadlines under pressure.

  • You bring proven experience in Public Services space, possibly from your time in Government, academia, or roles in industry.

  • You have had exposure to working with GDS-style digital products and knowing exactly what it takes to get AI-enabled services over the line in Government.

  • You take full responsibility for the successful delivery of your projects, from initial scoping to end-user adoption within regulated businesses

  • You are an exceptional communicator, with outstanding skills in managing senior stakeholders and translating complex concepts for non-technical audiences.

  • You are comfortable working with technical teams and have a proven track record of delivering technical projects, ideally in AI.

  • You are a practical problem-solver, identifying potential risks to important missions in this space and proactively implementing solutions.

  • You thrive in ambiguous settings and demonstrate a structured approach to problem-solving and delivering high-quality, high-stakes projects.

The Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction Interview (60 minutes)

  3. Case Study Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Mechanical QAQC Inspector
description:
Our team members are consummate professionals who are well respected by our Fortune 100 clients in the semiconductor/cleanroom, manufacturing, and mission-critical data center industries. Our mission is to do the very best for our clients and customers with integrity, professionalism, and altruism allowing them to BE the very best in their business globally.


Are you ready to be a part of a dynamic team that values excellence, integrity, and collaboration? Our dedicated team believes in honesty, integrity, performance, partnership, and trust, ensuring long-lasting customer and employee relationships built on solid principles. By upholding the highest standards of quality and performance, we aim to achieve total customer satisfaction in the various markets we serve.


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Mechanical QA Inspector to join our team on a large-scale data center project in Sparks, NV. This role is responsible for ensuring all mechanical systems are installed, tested, and documented in compliance with project specifications, industry codes, and client quality standards. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of mission-critical MEP systems, strong field inspection experience, and the ability to collaborate with contractors, engineers, and commissioning teams to maintain quality from installation through turnover.


Key Responsibilities

  • Pipe / Duct QA/QC, test procedure review / develop, review test process from test packages, push subcontractors for testing, witness tests, review test reports, test document / report control Oversee and enforce mechanical quality assurance and quality control processes for all phases of construction.
  • Review installation work against approved drawings, specifications, and applicable codes (ASHRAE, SMACNA, ASME).
  • Perform daily field inspections of mechanical systems, including HVAC, chilled water, cooling towers, CRAC/CRAH units, boilers, pumps, and piping.
  • Monitor contractor compliance with the project’s QA/QC plan and report deviations.
  • Document inspections, punch list items, and deficiencies, ensuring timely resolution.
  • Support equipment start-up, functional testing, and integration with commissioning activities.
  • Review and verify submittals, shop drawings, and O&M manuals for accuracy.
  • Maintain quality documentation and logs in accordance with client requirements.
  • Coordinate with design teams, contractors, and owner representatives to resolve field issues.

title: Health Data Protection and Data Licensing Consultant
description:
About Intelance

Intelance is an independent technology, AI and cyber assurance firm based in the UK. We help organisations check, govern and improve their technology through enterprise architecture, AI governance, cyber assurance and data governance work. We are building a small panel of senior associates to deliver technology and AI due diligence on company sales and investments.

The role

You will check whether a company has the legal right to use the health data its business depends on, as part of technology due diligence for clients who are selling, buying or investing in data and AI companies. Buyers in life sciences want to know that client data is handled lawfully, deleted when it should be, and not used for anything the contracts do not allow.

You report to an Intelance engagement partner and work with our technology due diligence lead, who brings your findings into the final report.

What you will do

  • Confirm who is the controller and who is the processor for each type of data, and check the data processing agreements in place.

  • Review client contracts to see whether client data may be used to improve AI workflows, test suites or models.

  • Check how data is deleted when contracts end, and whether that is possible where data has shaped models or tests.

  • Review licences for real world data from third party providers, and what happens to them if the company changes owner.

  • Check data transfers outside the UK, including any use of outside AI providers.

  • Check HIPAA readiness where US health data is involved.

  • Rate each finding by how it could affect the deal, and write clear, practical fixes.

What you will bring

  • At least five years advising on data protection in health, pharmaceutical or life sciences settings.

  • Strong working knowledge of UK GDPR, EU GDPR and international data transfers. HIPAA knowledge is a strong plus.

  • Experience reviewing data processing agreements and data licences.

  • A recognised qualification such as CIPP/E or the BCS Practitioner Certificate, or legal practice in data protection.

  • Clear, plain writing that founders, buyers and lawyers can follow.

  • Experience of AI and data rights, or of due diligence work, is a strong plus.

Key job responsibilities

title: Optometric Technician
description:

We are committed to customer service and making every interaction extraordinary while inspiring the complete confidence of our patients. Our employees contribute directly to the growth and success of our practices and take pride in being a member of our team.   • Make introductions and establish rapport with patients
  • Initiate patient evaluation, documenting the chief complaint, history of present illness, review of systems, and all pertinent ocular findings accurately and in accordance with compliance guidelines.
  • Perform pre-exam testing to include visual acuity assessment, including pinhole and glare testing, confrontational visual field testing, assess extra ocular muscles, pupillary evaluation, tonometry, assess angles, pupillary dilation, and all other patient services as requested by the physician including specialty tests such as color vision screening, stereopsis, and dry eye testing
  • Perform lensometry and specialized testing such as visual fields, keratometry, A/B scans, and ophthalmic photography optical coherence tomography (OCT), and optical biometry

  • Educate patients regarding administration of medications and pre- and post-operative instructions as directed by physicians
  • Check temperature of medical refrigerator daily
  • Maintain and conduct inventory of medications and supplies
  • Assist with maintenance of clinical examination equipment

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to communicate clearly and effectively with patients, staff, managers, and doctors

title: Parts Specialist
description:
Parts Specialist

MSHS Pacific Power Group

Work Location: Mandeville, LA
Employment Type: Full-Time
Pay Range: $25.00 – $30.00 per hour (based on experience)
Schedule: Monday – Friday, flexible hours between 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM


Join Our Team!

Are you organized, detail-oriented, and experienced in inside sales, parts coordination, or inventory management? MSHS Pacific Power Group is seeking a Parts Specialist to support our parts operations and help ensure technicians, service teams, and customers have the parts and information they need to keep operations running efficiently.


In this role, you'll support the full parts lifecycle, including inventory management, order processing, documentation, reporting, and customer support. You'll work closely with service, operations, purchasing, warehouse, and other departments to maintain accurate inventory records, coordinate parts activities, resolve issues, and identify opportunities to improve processes.


If you enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and take pride in accuracy, organization, and customer service, we'd like to hear from you!


Key Responsibilities

Parts Coordination & Inventory Support

  • Maintain and update parts documentation, including inventory records, purchase orders, pick lists, receiving logs, and parts catalogs.
  • Monitor parts availability, lead times, stock levels, and order status.
  • Support parts intake, order fulfillment, returns, warranty claims, and inventory adjustments.
  • Ensure accurate parts information and documentation within ERP and inventory management systems.
  • Communicate stock updates, shortages, and parts-related information to internal teams.

Customer Service & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for internal parts inquiries, providing professional communication and parts identification assistance.
  • Coordinate with service technicians, operations, purchasing, and warehouse teams to support parts requirements.
  • Provide updates regarding parts availability, substitutions, delivery timelines, and order status.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues involving incorrect orders, shortages, delivery delays, and other parts-related concerns.
  • Escalate complex issues when necessary to ensure timely resolution.

Reporting, Audits & Compliance

  • Prepare inventory reports, parts usage summaries, dashboards, and other operational reporting.
  • Assist with internal and external audits involving inventory accuracy, documentation, and internal controls.
  • Maintain accurate records related to parts usage, stock adjustments, returns, and warranty procedures.
  • Support compliance with company policies, inventory control standards, safety requirements, and applicable industry regulations.

Process Improvement & Operational Support

  • Identify opportunities to improve parts processes, inventory accuracy, and departmental communication.
  • Participate in parts meetings, vendor discussions, inventory reviews, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Support system enhancements and workflow improvements to increase efficiency and visibility.
  • Help develop standardized procedures, documentation, and inventory management practices.
  • Coordinate multiple parts-related priorities, schedules, and deadlines.

Required Qualifications

  • 2–3 years of Inside Sales experience, preferably in parts sales, industrial equipment, marine, or a related industry.
  • Experience working with ERP systems and inventory management software.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills, with the ability to professionally interact with internal teams, technicians, vendors, and customers.
  • Strong understanding of parts workflows, inventory control practices, and order fulfillment processes.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Ability to troubleshoot parts-related issues, identify solutions, and follow through to resolution.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office or similar business applications.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Logistics, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered.
  • Basic engine knowledge and familiarity with marine, industrial, or power generation equipment.
  • Experience with parts catalogs and inventory management systems.
  • Previous experience supporting service teams, technicians, or equipment-related parts operations.
  • Experience preparing inventory reports, analyzing parts usage trends, and identifying process improvements.
  • Self-motivated with a strong desire to succeed and contribute to team and organizational goals.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize competing demands, and manage multiple responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.

Physical & Work Requirements

  • Ability to work in an office, warehouse, or hybrid environment as required.
  • Ability to lift, move, and handle parts, tools, and inventory materials as needed.
  • Ability to manage fluctuating workloads during periods of increased service demand, inventory audits, and operational initiatives.

Why Join MSHS Pacific Power Group?

At MSHS Pacific Power Group, our people play an important role in keeping essential marine and power generation operations running. As a Parts Specialist, you'll be an integral part of the team, helping ensure parts are accurately managed, readily available, and delivered to support our technicians, service teams, and customers.

You'll have the opportunity to contribute to operational improvements, strengthen cross-functional relationships, and make a meaningful impact on the efficiency and success of our business.


Benefits & Perks

MSHS Pacific Power Group offers a competitive benefits package designed to support the health, financial well-being, and work-life balance of our employees. Benefits include:

title: Senior Energy and Water Public Affairs Manager, AWS West Energy and Water Team
description:
AWS is building data center infrastructure to support our digital way of life, and the public conversation around that growth — power demand, grid reliability, and water use, — is increasingly shaped by regulators, policymakers, elected officials, and community stakeholders. The Energy & Water team is looking for a Senior Manager in Public Affairs, to lead how we engage in that conversation.

In this role you bring a public affairs lens to energy and water: you understand industry trends and the regulatory landscape, you engage with the right internal and external stakeholders, and translate that understanding into the right messaging, You are the expert who shows up, engages authentically with community members, organizations, public officials, builds lasting relationships , and contributes to an informed, transparent, and productive public dialogue. You will be one of a small cohort of 3–4 regional representatives who collectively own how the Energy & Water team builds public engagement, in coordination with our policy, legal, community, comms, and economic development partners.

Position includes up to ~25-30% travel

Key job responsibilities
Public Representation:
Represent Energy & Water in public and community settings — open houses, boot camps, hearings, and stakeholder forums— building trusted relationships with officials, regulators, and community stakeholders.

Engage with regulatory bodies, agency staff, elected officials, and policy stakeholders alongside our Public Policy and Legal teams, representing the Energy & Water perspective accurately and with sound judgment.

Field live questions about energy sourcing, power demand, grid impact, water use, wastewater — including detailed questions from engaged community members and advocacy groups

Engage authentically on energy and water topics in real time — accurately representing Amazon's approach and genuinely addressing community questions

Energy and Water Messaging and Content Ownership:
In this role you bring a public affairs lens to energy and water: you understand industry and energy-sector trends and the regulatory landscape, you engage credibly with regulatory bodies and policy audiences, and you translate that understanding into the right messaging, delivered in the right tone, to the right stakeholders.

Develop and maintain talking points, FAQs, and Q&A guidance on energy and water topics for use by the broader team, Comms, and cross-functional partners

Provide the energy and water subject matter foundation to develop materials and translate complex topics into channel-specific formats

Serve as a key resource when the team needs to respond quickly to emerging topics or prepare a spokesperson

Cross-Functional & Team Support:
Serve as the Energy & Water liaison to Public Policy, Legal, Community Engagement, and Economic Development partner teams, aligning on messaging, sequencing, and tone before positions reach external audiences

Work closely with the External Engagement team to ensure E&W subject matter is well-represented in event programming

Coordinate with Water and Energy SMEs to stay current on technical data (FAQ maintenance, approved stats, updated infrastructure positions)

Support regional leads and the broader team with ad hoc communications needs — presentations, talking points for senior stakeholders, positioning for emerging issues

Drive negotiations and agreements to support community benefit energy and water projects as needed

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

title: Strategy MBA Internship, Summer 2027
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

As Netflix continues to grow globally, we are looking for MBA intern talent to help inform decisions that underpin our content, entertainment, and overall business strategies. This summer, we are offering programs in two key areas of the business:


Business Finance & Strategy

The Business Finance & Strategy (Business F&S) team guides critical business decisions across the company through financial, operational, and strategic analysis. The team works side-by-side with business leaders across Ads, Content, Commerce, Consumer Products & Experiences, Games, and Product & Technology. The team is highly visible throughout the organization and in particular to the senior leadership of Netflix who depend heavily on the team’s insights and perspectives to inform important business decisions.


A sample of Business F&S work could include:

  • Conducting market research and competitive trends analysis
  • Researching and analyzing new business opportunities for Netflix
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop growth strategies
  • Creating memos and slides that present insights and key recommendations to Netflix executives

Content Programming Strategy & Operations

The Content Programming Strategy & Operations (CPS&O) team informs Content decisions and drives Content operations to deliver the most thrilling content offering and value to our members. We do this by:

  • Helping optimize our slate, programming and investments from development to launch
  • Leading cross functional coordination and driving solutions for operational challenges
  • Providing an informed perspective on future business development opportunities

We partner closely with our Content, Production, Business Affairs, Finance, and other cross functional teams supporting strategic and operational projects across Series, Film, Licensing, Programming and Franchises.


A sample of CPS&O work could include:

  • Leading performance analysis of launched content, including audience deep dives and data analysis to inform future content decisions
  • Providing support on programming strategy across our Film and Series slates
  • Research and analyze competitive launch and programming trends to identify opportunities for our content teams
  • Identifying process improvements to enhance efficiency in content operations

********************************


Both teams are looking for MBA interns to join in the Los Angeles office.


Netflix is fast-growing with a flat organizational structure, which means that employees are often asked to perform tasks with a range of difficulties. The ideal candidate would be prepared to regularly "roll up their sleeves" to perform more routine tasks the same day that they are asked to prepare a presentation to the executives of the company.


Qualifications

  • MBA Candidate, Class of 2028
  • 2-7 years of work experience
  • Very strong passion for Content / Entertainment
  • Experience conducting quantitative analysis (including modeling) and qualitative analysis and can drive to insight and results using data
  • Excellent communication/presentation skills with a track record of presenting complex analysis to executives/senior management clearly and concisely
  • A successful candidate demonstrates strong initiative and ability to work independently, thrives in a fast-paced, always changing environment
  • A successful candidate is highly intellectually curious and has the courage to challenge the status quo and exhibits the highest personal and professional standards of integrity and ethics.
  • Excellent proficiency with MS Excel / PowerPoint

For consideration, please send your resume, as well as a brief (no more than one page) statement on preferred placement (Business F&S or CPS&O). Please explain why you’re interested in the role, the internship, and Netflix:

  • If working with business executives across various entertainment and technology initiatives excites you, you should apply to Business F&S.
  • If working with creative executives to optimize a TV or Film slate excites you, you should apply for CPS&O.

The Summer Internship

At Netflix, we offer a personalized experience for interns, and our aim is to offer an experience that mimics what it is like to actually work here. We match qualified interns with projects and groups based on interests and skill sets, and fully embed interns within those groups for the summer. Netflix is a unique place to work and we live by our values, so it's worth learning more about our culture.


Internships are paid and are 10-12 weeks in duration. Our summer internship will be located in our Los Angeles office.


Applications close on December 6 at 11:59 PM PST.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

title: Food Auditor (with 3rd-party audit experience in food standard) (SQF/BRCGS Technical Reviewer)
description:

  • Provide technical support and advice to SGS network of affiliates and customers as required

description:
AstraZeneca’s Global Technical Operations (GTO) organization is seeking undergraduate and graduate students for multiple summer internship opportunities in 2027 at our Gaithersburg, MD and Frederick, MD sites.
Interns will lead hands-on projects across biologics manufacturing, analytical science, technology transfer, digitalization and product lifecycle management, supported by experienced technical managers and cross-functional teams

GTO Internship Projects Include:

  • Manufacturing Process & Technology: Process optimization, modeling and advanced biologics manufacturing technologies.

Your summer with GTO will be an opportunity to learn, contribute and make an impact. Along the way, you’ll build new skills, broaden your business understanding and professional network, and share your work and recommendations with the team.

¿Cuentas con experiencia en diagnóstico y reparación de sistemas eléctricos, mecánicos, neumáticos e hidráulicos, así como interpretación de diagramas eléctricos y mecánicos?


Únete a Baker Hughes – Industrial & Energy Technology (IET)

En Baker Hughes, nuestras tecnologías ayudan a impulsar la energía y la industria a nivel mundial. Nuestra organización de Industrial & Energy Technology desarrolla y fabrica soluciones innovadoras para apoyar operaciones seguras, confiables y eficientes. Estamos comprometidos con la mejora continua, la excelencia operacional y con el desarrollo de un entorno donde nuestros colaboradores puedan crecer y alcanzar su máximo potencial.


Asóciate con los mejores

Como parte de nuestro equipo de Manufactura, el Técnico de Mantenimiento será responsable de ejecutar actividades de mantenimiento preventivo, predictivo y correctivo en equipos de producción y sistemas de soporte, garantizando operaciones seguras, confiables y eficientes. Este rol trabajará en estrecha colaboración con los equipos de Producción, Ingeniería, Calidad y Operaciones para maximizar la disponibilidad de los equipos, minimizar los tiempos de inactividad y contribuir al cumplimiento de los planes de manufactura.

Como Técnico de Mantenimiento II, serás responsable de:

  • Ejecutar actividades de mantenimiento preventivo, correctivo y predictivo en equipos de manufactura y sistemas de soporte a la producción.
  • Diagnosticar y reparar fallas eléctricas, mecánicas, neumáticas e hidráulicas para restablecer la operación de los equipos de manera oportuna.
  • Responder a fallas y paros de maquinaria, minimizando interrupciones en la producción.
  • Inspeccionar equipos e identificar posibles fallas, riesgos operativos o problemas de confiabilidad.
  • Apoyar en la instalación, modificación, arranque y puesta en marcha de maquinaria y equipos industriales.
  • Interpretar diagramas eléctricos, planos mecánicos y documentación técnica para ejecutar actividades de mantenimiento.
  • Documentar órdenes de trabajo y mantener registros precisos de mantenimiento utilizando los sistemas establecidos.
  • Participar en iniciativas de mejora continua enfocadas en incrementar la confiabilidad de los equipos, la seguridad y la eficiencia operativa.

Impulsa tu pasión

Para tener éxito en este puesto, deberás:

  • Contar con carrera técnica, formación vocacional o experiencia equivalente en mantenimiento industrial.
  • Tener un mínimo de 3 años de experiencia en mantenimiento dentro de ambientes industriales o de manufactura.
  • Demostrar sólidos conocimientos en diagnóstico y solución de problemas eléctricos y mecánicos.
  • Contar con experiencia en mantenimiento y reparación de maquinaria y equipos de manufactura.
  • Tener conocimiento de sistemas eléctricos industriales, motores, sensores, relevadores y dispositivos de control.
  • Poseer experiencia trabajando con sistemas mecánicos como cajas de engranajes, rodamientos, bombas, transportadores y sistemas de transmisión de potencia.
  • Tener experiencia en sistemas neumáticos e hidráulicos.
  • Ser capaz de interpretar diagramas eléctricos, planos mecánicos y documentación técnica.
  • Contar con conocimientos básicos de computación para la gestión de órdenes de trabajo y documentación de mantenimiento.
  • Estar dispuesto(a) a trabajar en un entorno de manufactura y brindar soporte en diferentes turnos cuando sea requerido.

Cualificaciones deseadas:

  • Experiencia brindando soporte a equipos de ensamble, maquinado, manufactura o producción industrial.
  • Conocimientos en diagnóstico de PLCs y sistemas de automatización industrial.
  • Experiencia utilizando sistemas computarizados de gestión de mantenimiento (CMMS).
  • Habilidades analíticas sólidas y experiencia en metodologías de análisis de causa raíz.
  • Capacidad para administrar múltiples actividades de mantenimiento en un entorno dinámico de manufactura.
  • Compromiso demostrado con la seguridad, la calidad y la excelencia operacional.
  • Experiencia previa en industrias de energía, manufactura, industrial u Oil & Gas será considerada una ventaja.

Trabaja de la manera que mejor funcione para ti

Reconocemos que cada persona es diferente y que la forma en que cada uno trabaja y da lo mejor de sí también es diferente.

Trabajar con nosotros

Nuestra gente es el corazón de todo lo que hacemos en Baker Hughes. Sabemos que somos mejores cuando todas las personas que forman parte de nuestro equipo tienen oportunidades de desarrollo, están comprometidas y pueden aportar al trabajo su auténtica esencia. Invertimos en la salud y el bienestar de nuestra fuerza laboral, capacitamos y recompensamos el talento, y desarrollamos líderes en todos los niveles para sacar lo mejor de cada uno.

Trabajar para ti

Nuestras innovaciones han revolucionado la industria energética durante más de un siglo. Pero para seguir avanzando mañana, sabemos que debemos desafiar los límites hoy. Priorizamos reconocer y recompensar a quienes adoptan el cambio, con un paquete que refleje cuánto valoramos sus contribuciones.

Únete a nosotros y podrás disfrutar de:

  • Políticas modernas de equilibrio entre la vida laboral y personal, así como actividades de bienestar.
  • Opciones integrales de atención médica privada.
  • Protección mediante programas de seguro de vida y discapacidad.
  • Programas financieros diseñados para diferentes necesidades.
  • Beneficios adicionales opcionales o voluntarios.

Serás elegible para participar en los programas de beneficios patrocinados por la empresa, incluidos los programas de salud y bienestar.

Esta posición es elegible para nuestro paquete integral y competitivo de beneficios. Asimismo, puede ser elegible para formas adicionales de compensación, como bonos, sujetos a los términos y condiciones de los planes o políticas de beneficios aplicables.

title: Service Enginner
description:
Salary: $2,000 – $2,500 per month

Part 1: Service Technician – Job Scope

1. Maintenance & Repair

Conduct routine preventive maintenance to minimize downtime.

Diagnose mechanical, electrical, or software issues using diagnostic tools.

Repair or replace faulty components and restore equipment to working condition.

Document all maintenance activities and parts used.

optional: Network configuration, software updates, firmware installation.


2. Troubleshooting & Technical Support

Respond to service calls onsite or remotely.

Identify problems quickly and apply effective solutions.

Provide guidance to customers on proper usage and basic troubleshooting.


3. Customer Service & Communication

Communicate clearly with clients about issues, timelines, and required actions.

Maintain professionalism and positive relationships with customers.

Provide basic product usage guideline when handing over repaired or new equipment.


4. Reporting & Documentation

Prepare service reports, checklists, and maintenance logs.

Update internal systems with service records, parts inventory, and job status.

Report recurring issues to supervisors or engineering teams for escalation.


5. Safety & Compliance

Follow workplace safety procedures and manufacturer guidelines.

Ensure compliance with electrical, mechanical, or industry‑specific regulations.

Use proper PPE, tools, and testing equipment.

6. Inventory & Tools Management

Track spare parts, tools, and consumables.

Ensure tools are calibrated and in safe working condition.

Request parts replenishment when needed.


7. Team Collaboration

Coordinate with dispatch, vendor tech support team, and internal sales teams.

Assist in improvement initiatives, product testing, or customer feedback loops.


Commissioning: Equipment Installation & Setup

Install, configure devices or IT/AV systems, trolley stand

Ensure proper calibration and alignment according to manufacturer specifications.

Perform initial system checks and handover testing with customers after installation.

Provide training or demonstrations when handing over new equipment.

title: Principal Product & Brand Designer (m/f/x)
description:
Build something that truly matters

At Cortea, we envision a world where every audit is proactively managed by humans and AI agents collaboratively. Where auditing professionals have superhuman capabilities at their fingertips to strengthen the trust in the world's most critical systems.

We're not just improving auditing workflows, we're redefining how audits are done from the ground up. With a rapidly growing, global customer base and backing from world-class investors, the market is ready. What we ship next decides how big this gets.

This is your chance to join a team of sharp, ambitious and kind builders extremely early. Shape the company at its pivotal moment and build something that truly matters.

About the role

At Cortea, design earns trust, and we sell to an industry that exists to produce it. Auditors are paid to be skeptical, and people judge quality by what they can see: the product, the website, the deck a partner opens in a boardroom, the newsletter someone reads with their first coffee. All of it is Cortea.

This is a role for someone with great taste in designing software and AI systems. You'll find novel patterns for problems that haven't existed in software before, and you'll own how Cortea looks and feels to the outside world.

Roughly 70% product, 30% brand. The product work is deep, expert-facing and systems-heavy. As we are doubling down on design, you'll be working on taking the core flows to the next level. The brand work is yours to own outright: website, marketing and sales visuals, newsletter, event and content assets. It'll be on screen in a Big4 boardroom, in every customer's inbox, and on the wall at the events we host. A lot of surface for one designer, and all of it yours.

We're not looking for someone to ask whether the logo goes left or right. We're looking for someone with opinions.

What you'll do

  • Work directly with our founders, engineers, and customers to turn audit flows into intuitive, delightful interfaces

  • Work with Jonas on product design and design strategy overall

  • Own our brand designs and visuals

  • Evolve our visual identity and design system

  • Take increasing ownership of brand direction. Website, marketing and sales material, content and event assets

  • Help shape the product vision, roadmap, and user experience standards

  • Run usability tests, build user feedback loops, and bring a systems mindset to design decisions

You'll be great at this if you

  • Have product design experience in B2B / SaaS, ideally in fast-moving startups.

  • Think in experiences, not screens. With taste you can defend. Product and brand are one surface; you can explain why details work, and you call out when they don’t.

  • Want to create a unique brand, which auditors love. Identify, marketing, web should be a draw, not a tax. Taste and passion matter more than volume.

  • Can hold complexity without losing clarity. You turn configuration-heavy, expert workflows into clear systems.

  • Use AI without sacrificing quality. You've worked out which parts of the job benefit from automation and which need your judgment.

  • Work well in ambiguity. You take rough direction and deliver great work without handholding.

  • Have low ego. Best idea wins. You give and take feedback without making it about you.

Titles are fuzzy. If you're operating at principal level, or you're currently freelancing and curious rather than actively looking, talk to us anyway.

What you will get

  • Full brand ownership, shape how the product feels. Work face-to-face with experienced founders and learn directly from customer insights.

  • Real influence on strategy. In a small team of excellent engineers and operators with high autonomy, you will shape product direction. Best idea wins, regardless of seniority.

  • Fast, ambitious, and fun team. Decisions get made in hours, not weeks. Rapid experimentation is the default.

  • Meaningful equity and competitive salary. You are one of the first to build this, and you share in the upside.

  • A mission that matters. Building intelligent systems for a $200bn industry from Berlin, with AI at the core

Interview process

  • First Call — Intro on what we do with Liza

  • Second Call — Portfolio walkthrough with Jonas

  • Third Call — Get to know our product and culture with our Co-Founder Valentin

  • On-site Day — Meet our full team in our Berlin office and work on a real problem together with us.

title: Senior Devops Engineer - Infra Automation (Remote)
description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are seeking a highly skilled DevOps Specialist to architect, implement, and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, with a strong focus on test-driven deployment, automated release management, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.

The role also includes automating build, tagging, and publication processes across web, desktop, and mobile platforms to ensure consistent and traceable releases. Deep expertise in Linux system administration, networking, and IaC tools is essential to deliver

scalable, secure, and highly available deployments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, architecture, and management of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions (and similar tools), ensuring fast, reliable, and reproducible software delivery.
  • Implement and enforce test-driven deployment systems, integrating automated testing, validation, and monitoring to maintain code quality and accelerate feedback cycles.
  • Containerize applications and microservices with Docker, optimize image builds, and manage deployment pipelines for distributed environments.
  • Develop and maintain cross-platform build pipelines using CMake or equivalent tools, ensuring consistent compilation and release workflows across web, desktop, and mobile.
  • Automate end-to-end release processes, including tagging, building, signing, and distributing mobile, web, and desktop applications.
  • Define and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure environments.
  • Collaborate closely with development, QA, and operations teams to troubleshoot deployment issues, optimize performance, and improve release reliability.
  • Continuously improve observability and feedback loops, leveraging monitoring and alerting systems to maintain operational excellence.

Mandatory

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience architecting and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools at scale in a production environment.
  • Strong proficiency in test‑driven deployment methodologies, including writing and maintaining automated test suites for integration and end‑to‑end validation.
  • Expertise in containerization technologies such as Docker, including image creation, registry management, and basic orchestration patterns.
  • In‑depth knowledge of C++ build systems, specifically CMake, with proven experience optimizing native build and deployment pipelines.
  • Advanced Linux system administration and networking skills, including shell scripting, package management, performance troubleshooting, firewalls, and VPN configuration.
  • Excellent communication, problem‑solving, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in globally distributed teams.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, AWS CDK or AWS CloudFormation.
  • Experience with mobile CI/CD automation, including build, tagging, and publication for iOS and Android applications
  • Advanced knowledge of release management practices, including automated versioning, signing, and artifact distribution.

Preferred

  • Exposure to observability and monitoring systems, leveraging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK for deployment health tracking.
  • Experience working in high‑availability, security‑sensitive environments, especially in fintech, blockchain, or distributed systems contexts.
  • Experience deploying and managing blockchain‑based applications.
  • Exposure to AI/ML pipelines, including automated model training, evaluation, and deployment using frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Important information for candidates

Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

Double‑check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Internship for Software Development
description:
About the Internship:

Join our team to gain hands-on experience in real-world, modern web development! All selected interns will first undergo our structured Off-the-Job Training program in web application development, company frameworks (CakePHP), and internal engineering workflows to build a strong foundation.

Interns who demonstrate strong performance during the training phase will have the opportunity to transition into On-the-Job Training and contribute directly to live, active client projects from Japan.

In today's engineering world, AI tools are transforming how software is built. We are looking for students who possess solid programming fundamentals and demonstrate great potential in using AI tools responsibly to learn faster, solve problems logically, and build high-quality software.

High-performing interns may also be offered a full-time Junior Software Developer role upon graduation.

Working Location:​

Hybrid working

* We work in the office for one week per month and from home for the rest of the month. However, interns' eligibility to work from home may vary depending on their situation.

Responsibilities​:

Involved in the development, maintenance, and support of new/existing web applications.

  • Successfully complete our structured web development training program (focusing on the CakePHP framework, system architecture basics, and internal coding standards).

  • For qualifying interns, assist full-time developers with coding, feature development, unit testing, and maintenance tasks on actual projects.

  • Utilize modern AI tools to accelerate your learning curve, debug code logically, and translate technical requirements into clean, working code.

    • Good to Have: Prior exposure to or hands-on project experience with any PHP MVC framework (e.g., Laravel, CodeIgniter, Symfony, or similar).

This is why you should join us:

title: CLM Platform Lead
description:
Join our Baker Hughes – Digital Technology Organization

Using digital technology, we drive decarbonization and digital acceleration across the industry, achieving better outcomes, both for ourselves and our customers. We do this using innovative software to help us solve our customers toughest emission reduction challenges and make energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient for people and the planet.


Partner with the best

Serve as the Technical Advisor/Solution Architect for enterprise CLM, owning the end-to-end solution across architecture, implementation, integrations, data, AI, security, operations, and platform evolution. Define and evolve the target-state CLM architecture and roadmap, ensuring solutions are scalable, reusable, secure, supportable, and aligned with broader enterprise strategy. Lead cross-functional solutioning across Business, Legal, Data & AI, Enterprise Architecture, Security, ERP/CRM, integration teams, infrastructure, and strategic vendors.


As a CLM Platform Lead, you will be responsible for:

  • Translating complex business requirements into practical end-to-end solutions, connecting CLM workflows, metadata, repositories, APIs, enterprise data, AI, and downstream processes.
  • Architect and govern integrations across CLM, ERP, CRM, Data & AI platforms, middleware, and other enterprise applications, establishing clear system, data, and ownership boundaries.
  • Partner closely with Data & AI teams on contract metadata, extraction, data quality, lineage, traceability, analytics, and responsible AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Design for enterprise scalability and future expansion, including additional business units, regions, contract types, integrations, data volumes, users, and emerging capabilities.
  • Take end-to-end technical and operational ownership across design, build, migration, SIT/UAT, deployment, stabilization, production support, upgrades, maintenance, and continuous improvement.
  • Own and drive CLM migration strategy and execution, including data readiness, mapping, validation, reconciliation, cutover, and post-migration stabilization.
  • Provide oversight of regular platform operations, including releases, upgrades, performance, incidents, integrations, technical debt, regression testing, and operational health.
  • Lead technical/sprint execution forums, driving priorities, dependencies, decisions, issue resolution, ownership, and timely closure of actions.
  • Lead resolution of complex cross-platform issues, driving root-cause analysis across CLM, APIs, integrations, data flows, infrastructure, security, and vendor components.
  • Establish architecture standards, reusable patterns, technical guardrails, and governance to improve quality, scalability, maintainability, and long-term sustainability.
  • Own strategic vendor coordination, challenging designs and estimates where appropriate and driving accountability for delivery, quality, support, and contractual commitments.
  • Drive highly time-sensitive and cost-sensitive initiatives, proactively managing scope, dependencies, resources, risks, schedules, and financial impacts.
  • Own or support budget planning, forecasts, purchase orders (POs), vendor spend, and financial tracking, ensuring appropriate cost governance and alignment to delivery priorities.
  • Support leadership and executive reviews with concise updates on progress, architecture decisions, risks, financials, dependencies, trade-offs, and required decisions.
  • Evaluate emerging CLM, agreement intelligence, GenAI/ML, and automation capabilities based on business value, architectural fit, security, scalability, cost, and operational sustainability.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify the technology landscape, improve reuse and automation, reduce technical debt, and optimize platform and vendor costs.
  • Mentor Technical Leads/Specialists and delivery teams while strengthening internal capability and reducing unnecessary dependency on external vendors.
  • Maintain end-to-end accountability for the health, technical integrity, scalability, and evolution of the CLM ecosystem.

Fuel your passion


To be successful in this role you will:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related STEM discipline, with approximately 15 years of relevant technology experience.
  • Significant experience as a Solution Architect, Technical Advisor, or Senior Technology Leader delivering complex enterprise solutions.
  • Strong enterprise CLM experience, preferably DocuSign CLM / IAM.
  • Deep understanding of the end-to-end contract lifecycle, including authoring, workflows, templates, metadata, repositories, approvals, signature, amendments, renewals, obligations, integrations, and downstream consumption.
  • Proven ability to architect solutions spanning CLM, ERP/CRM, Data & AI, middleware, cloud platforms, security, and enterprise integrations.
  • Strong knowledge of REST APIs, JSON/XML, authentication, event/batch integration patterns, data models, transformation, lineage, traceability, and governance.
  • Demonstrated experience designing for scalability, resiliency, extensibility, security, performance, maintainability, and cost efficiency.
  • Experience leading complex migration, testing, deployment, stabilization, production support, and platform lifecycle activities.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional technical discussions and delivery cadences, resolving ambiguity across multiple teams and systems.
  • Experience managing strategic vendors, delivery commitments, dependencies, estimates, and technical quality.
  • Experience supporting budgets, POs, vendor spend, forecasting, and cost-sensitive technology initiatives.
  • Ability to operate effectively in highly time-sensitive environments, balancing delivery urgency with architecture quality and long-term sustainability.
  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical and financial topics for leadership.
  • Demonstrated end-to-end ownership, sound judgment, and ability to drive complex decisions and issues through closure.

Desired Qualifications:

Technical Expertise

  • Deep technical and architectural knowledge of DocuSign CLM/IAM platform.
  • Experience integrating CLM with ERP, Salesforce, Databricks, Informatica, Azure, and enterprise integration platforms.
  • Strong understanding of contract AI, metadata extraction, agreement intelligence, analytics, and responsible AI practices.
  • Experience defining CLM reference architectures, reusable patterns, metadata frameworks, integration standards, and technical guardrails.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise security, SSO, IAM/RBAC, privacy, compliance, resiliency, observability, and operational controls.

Business Acumen

  • Understands how CLM supports Commercial, Legal, Sales, Finance, Procurement, Operations, Data & AI, and enterprise processes.
  • Thinks beyond individual requirements to understand the larger business, application, data, and technology landscape.
  • Balances business value, delivery speed, scalability, cost, security, and long-term sustainability when making solution decisions.
  • Anticipates future growth and designs solutions that support expansion, acquisitions, new contract types, geographies, integrations, and emerging technologies.
  • Connects technical decisions to business outcomes, operational impact, cost, risk, and value realization.

Leadership

  • Acts as a trusted Solution Architect and Advisor, connecting strategy, architecture, execution, operations, and commercial considerations.
  • Leads cross-functional discussions across Business, Legal, Data & AI, Architecture, Security, application teams, and vendors.
  • Takes end-to-end accountability from solution definition through implementation, migration, operations, maintenance, and expansion.

title: Title Officer
location: Cherry Hill, New Jersey, United States
description:
Heritage Abstract Co. is hiring a Title Officer in Cherry Hill/Morristown, NJ. This is a Hybrid or Remote position. The Title Officer is responsible for determining the insurability of a particular property. The position assesses the risk and determines under what conditions a property may be insured. The position handles complicated issues that have a significant financial impact on the Company and provides guidance to less experienced staff on complex matters. The Title Officer also makes binding decisions relative to escrow for title-related items.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Evaluates title and legal issues. Provides recommendations on how to best resolve the issues.
  • Determines insurability of premises in question under various circumstances (i.e., short sales, mortgage foreclosure, In-lieu Tax Foreclosure, In-personam Tax Foreclosure, judgment sales, Deed-in-Lieu of Foreclosure, Estate situations, marital situations, bankruptcy complications, judgment, and various liens) and what conditions are necessary to insure the premises.
  • Interfaces with the Agency’s Title Insurance Underwriter to determine insurability and Settlement Department in regard to clearing title.
  • Reviews all title clearance issues and judgments. Negotiates with the buyer’s/seller’s attorney in regard to title issues; establishes escrows for title-related items, protecting the Agency’s Underwriter while creating a climate of acceptability for the escrow between the buyer/seller and their respective attorneys.
  • Establishes an acceptable outcome and resolution for title issues for all parties involved in the transactions.
  • Reviews and evaluates title claims and reports findings and recommendations to the Title Production Manager.
  • Attends “mark-up” title insurance commitment for lender and purchaser at Commercial closings and other closings as requested.
  • Interfaces with the Commercial lender’s counsel on complex issues.
  • Assesses risks and liabilities and alerts management, as appropriate.
  • Communicates effectively with attorneys, realtors, clients, underwriters, title agents, lenders, and sales force regarding all facets of the title issues.
  • Performs survey readings and prepares legal descriptions from a survey print.
  • Prepares title insurance commitments after evaluation of county searcher’s brief.
  • In consultation with the Title Production Manager, determines and effectuates various title endorsements including resolution of title issues, various deletions from the title commitment in regard to judgments, outstanding mortgages, previously unsatisfied liens, and possible outstanding interest.
  • Addresses inquiries from clients, borrowers, agents, and internal staff in a timely manner.
  • Provides technical expertise, training, and guidance to less experienced staff members.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

Education, Certification, and License Requirements

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Title Insurance Producer License required
  • Valid driver’s license

Experience

  • Five (5) or more years of experience in the title industry or related field

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Versed in procedures and processes of a Commercial closing, including orders of exhibits, UCC searches, and corporate status searches
  • Strong understanding of the real estate and mortgage industries
  • Strong understanding of real estate law
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Strong negotiation skills
  • Moderate mathematical skills including an understanding of geometry and survey coordinates
  • Must be able to think logically and resolve problems quickly
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite of products
  • Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Knowledge and ability to use typical office equipment (PC, calculator, fax machine, etc.)

The estimated base salary range for this position is from $70,000 - $100,000 (annually). The rate of pay offered will be dependent upon several factors including but not limited to the candidate's relevant skills, education, work experience, job location/geographic region, and/or certifications.
