title: Trauma Prog Lead Registrar
description:
Full Time, 1st Shift, Monday-Friday, 8:00am-4:30pm

Responsible for the accurate and timely identification, abstraction, coding, validation, and submission of trauma patient data within the trauma registry. Reviews the medical record to abstract required clinical, injury, treatment, outcome, and performance improvement data according to applicable trauma registry definitions and program requirements. Maintains the integrity and completeness of the trauma registry through ongoing data validation, correction of errors, and reconciliation of incomplete or inconsistent documentation. Supports trauma program performance improvement activities by identifying cases for review, providing registry data and reports, monitoring trauma-related measures, and assisting with data analysis. Collaborates with the Director of Quality, Trauma Program Manager, Trauma Medical Director, physicians, nursing, and other members of the multidisciplinary trauma team to support trauma performance improvement, patient safety, registry reporting, and program activities. Maintains knowledge of current trauma registry requirements, data definitions, and applicable state and national trauma standards. Completes required trauma registrar training in accordance with applicable American College of Surgeons (ACS) standards. Serves as the working lead and technical resource for trauma registry operations.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:
1. Identify trauma patients meeting established registry inclusion criteria and maintain an accurate, complete, and timely trauma registry.
2. Perform concurrent and retrospective medical record review and abstract required demographic, prehospital, injury, clinical, diagnostic, procedural, outcome, and performance improvement data.
3. Apply established trauma registry definitions, injury coding methodologies, and applicable state and national data requirements consistently and accurately.
4. Perform routine data validation, resolve registry errors and discrepancies, and ensure completeness and integrity of trauma registry data.
5. Submit required trauma registry data within established deadlines and maintain compliance with applicable reporting requirements.
6. Support trauma performance improvement and patient safety activities through case identification, data collection, issue tracking, and monitoring of outcomes and performance measures.
7. Prepare trauma registry reports and data analyses to support the Trauma Program Manager, Trauma Medical Director, trauma committees, and multidisciplinary performance improvement activities.
8. Collaborate with physicians, nursing, prehospital providers, and other members of the trauma team to clarify documentation, improve data quality, and support trauma program initiatives.
9. Maintain current knowledge of trauma registry requirements, coding conventions, data definitions, and applicable trauma standards, and participate in trauma education, meetings, performance improvement activities, and verification readiness.

Job Qualifications:
o 2 years healthcare experience required. RN or paramedic with strong anatomy and physiology knowledge preferred. Certified Abbreviated Injury Scale Specialist (CAISS) certification required within 12 months of hire.

title: GxP Computerised Systems Validation Consultant
description:
About Intelance

Intelance is an independent technology, AI and cyber assurance firm based in the UK. We help organisations check, govern and improve their technology through enterprise architecture, AI governance, cyber assurance and data governance work. We are building a small panel of senior associates to deliver technology and AI due diligence on company sales and investments.

The role

You will check whether software used in drug development is validated to GxP standards, as part of technology due diligence for clients who are selling, buying or investing in life sciences technology companies. Pharmaceutical buyers want proof that a platform producing trial and regulatory outputs works reliably, keeps a full audit trail and would stand up to an inspection.

You report to an Intelance engagement partner and work alongside our pharma specialist and technology due diligence lead, who bring your findings into the final report.

What you will do

  • Review the validation approach, records and evidence for platforms that produce clinical trial and real world evidence outputs.

  • Check audit trails, access controls, electronic records and change control against 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11.

  • Judge whether the validation is proportionate to risk, using GAMP 5 and Computer Software Assurance thinking.

  • Check how validation is kept current when AI workflows and machine learning models change.

  • Check that outputs follow the expected data standards, such as CDISC SDTM and ADaM.

  • Rate each finding by how it could affect the deal, and write clear, practical fixes.

What you will bring

  • At least five years of computerised system validation in a GxP setting.

  • Hands on use of GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11.

  • Experience validating or auditing systems that produce clinical trial or regulatory submission outputs.

  • Working knowledge of CDISC data standards.

  • Clear, plain writing that founders, buyers and lawyers can follow.

  • Experience validating systems that use machine learning or AI is a strong plus.

How the work is set up

  • Remote within the UK, with occasional meetings in London.

  • Around 3 to 5 days between late November 2026 and the end of January 2027, with further engagements as the practice grows.

  • Freelance, or through your own limited company, at £550 to £700 a day depending on experience. Reasonable travel costs for client meetings are covered.

  • A panel agreement, NDA and statement of work are signed before any client details are shared.

  • You work from an Intelance mailbox and use our evidence log and report templates, so every report meets the same standard.

How to apply

Send your CV and answer the short screening questions. They take about two minutes. We aim to reply to every shortlisted candidate within five working days.

title: UX Research Intern
description:
About baesh

baesh is a social platform connecting people in real life through events, communities, and shared interests.

We’re a small team using AI to move quickly from ideas to working experiences. Research is central to how we decide what to build and whether it’s good enough to ship. Your work will help us stay close to people as the technology moves faster.

You’ll work closely with our Head of Product and UX, an experienced researcher with a PhD in emotional and behavioural research. You’ll get practical guidance across the research process—from deciding what to investigate to helping the team act on what we learn.

This is an unpaid mandatory internship for students whose university programme requires a placement.

  • Location: Mostly remote, with opportunities to join research and events in Berlin.

  • Start date: Flexible, depending on your university requirements.

  • Duration: As required by your university, usually 3–6 months.

What you’ll help with

Usability testing and idea validation

  • Help plan and run usability tests on our app and prototypes, including interfaces built with AI.

  • Explore how easily people can discover events, join communities, and create their profiles.

  • Test whether experiences make sense to real people, beyond looking polished or functioning technically.

  • Validate early ideas and assumptions before the team invests further.

  • Identify confusing moments and recommend improvements that make a meaningful difference.

Exploratory research and interviews

  • Help interview existing users and people who haven’t tried baesh yet.

  • Explore how people make friends, find things to do, and connect with communities.

  • Understand their needs, motivations, habits, and barriers.

  • Help write discussion guides and ask open questions that uncover useful insights.

  • Bring people’s experiences into product decisions, keeping the human connection at the heart of how we build.

AI-supported research

  • Use AI to help draft interview guides, usability-testing scripts, and survey questions.

  • Explore how AI can support research synthesis by organising notes, summarising sessions, and suggesting patterns.

  • Check AI-generated summaries and interpretations against what participants actually said and did.

  • Learn where AI saves time, where it misses nuance, and where your judgement matters most.

  • Help us develop practical ways to combine faster research workflows with thoughtful, reliable findings.

Recruitment and ongoing feedback

  • Help recruit participants and coordinate research sessions.

  • Support Friends of BAESH, our community of early adopters who contribute through interviews, user testing, feedback, and feature suggestions.

  • Help create short in-app surveys about specific parts of the experience.

Making sense of what we learn

  • Analyse feedback and identify patterns across sessions.

  • Turn findings into clear insights and practical recommendations.

  • Share research with the product and development team to shape what happens next.

  • Help organise our research so we can build on previous learning.

You won’t be expected to do all of this independently from day one. We’ll guide you, give you feedback, and gradually help you take ownership of research activities.

What you’ll bring

  • You’re enrolled in a degree programme that requires a mandatory internship.

  • An interest in UX research, psychology, human–computer interaction, design, sociology, or a related field.

  • Curiosity about people and a willingness to question assumptions.

  • Good listening skills and an empathetic, respectful approach.

  • Strong communication skills in English.

  • An organised approach and willingness to take initiative.

  • An interest in using AI thoughtfully, including questioning its output.

Preferred, but not required:

  • German-speaking, so you can support research with German-speaking participants.

  • Some familiarity with interviews, usability testing, surveys, or qualitative analysis—university projects count.

  • Experience experimenting with AI tools for research, writing, analysis, or prototyping.

  • An interest in social products, communities, and how digital experiences support real-life connections.

You don’t need previous professional UX research experience. We’re looking for curiosity, care, and a willingness to learn.

What you’ll gain

  • Research mentorship: Learn directly from an experienced UX and behavioural researcher.

  • Practical experience: Contribute to exploratory interviews, usability testing, surveys, and idea validation.

  • Experience with AI-enabled product development: Learn how to assess and improve products when building is fast and informed judgement matters more than ever.

  • Visible impact: See your findings shape the experiences we build and release.

  • Portfolio experience: Develop research case studies, with guidance on what can be shared.

  • Flexible working: Agree a schedule that fits your university’s placement requirements.

  • A small, collaborative team: Work closely with the people designing and building the product.

Interested?

If you have relevant university work or a portfolio, we’d love to see it—but it’s optional.

title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, Amazon Leo E-Commerce Foundations
description:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

This Sr. Product Manager - Technical (PM-T) for Amazon Leo's E-Commerce Foundations team will be at the forefront of defining product vision, strategy, requirements and building systems to related to support both consumer and enterprise customers, catalog management, order management, broadband service provisioning and service life cycle management. This will include integrations into telecom customer systems, sales channel partners and internal upstream and downstream systems across Leo eCommerce.

This Sr. PM-T will be the single-threaded owner for Leo's Subscription Life Cycle Management. They will develop a common vision and scope, establish timelines, and drive system readiness and solutions for launching Leo services. The role will engage with both consumers and enterprise customers and will work in partnership with Leo Engineering, UX, and Amazon teams like Accounting, Tax, Legal, and Finance to execute the plan. They will own defining the end-to-end experience for customers' subscription life cycle changes and behavior.

Key job responsibilities
The successful candidate plays the role of a business liaison, product and technology leader, and owns the delivery of systems across the end-to-end customer journey.

In this role, you will:
- Work closely with senior business and software engineering leaders and SMEs to understand requirements, conceptualize solutions, facilitate development, and deploy broadband customer onboarding and service activation capabilities.
- Own tangible goals and deliverables to enable system development and readiness to scale globally and deliver the best customer experiences through service delivery.
- Provide visibility and communicate status updates to VPs, author operation plans and business reviews documents, and communicate to the broader Leo and Amazon team.
- Be a seasoned product leader with a demonstrated history of leading product strategy, technology solutions, data analytics, and customer experience.
- Thrive on ambiguity and have a track record of delivering large-scale technology products and/or led large operational or technical teams.
- Lead large, global, and complex technology initiatives in a large business unit, working cross-functionally with a number of business and technical teams.
- Think and move quickly and be inspired to build mechanisms to simplify and continuously innovate.
- Demonstrate analytical and quantitative skills; ability to use hard data and metrics to back up assumptions and develop business cases.
- Be structured, yet flexible to learn as the business evolves.

*** Export Control Requirement ***
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Content Promotion and Distribution (CPD) Engineering Organization creates technology to set up, promote, localize, and launch content on the Netflix service and off-service on social channels. Responsibilities

  • Own open-ended, ambiguous programs that span multiple teams and organizations, in collaboration with product, engineering, design, and data science, and that deliver significant business and technical impact.

title: Storekeeper & Receiving
description:
Responsible for handling the receiving, storage, issuance, and inventory control of hotel supplies and materials. Ensure that all incoming goods are properly inspected, recorded, stored, and distributed according to hotel procedures, while maintaining accurate inventory records and compliance with hotel standards.

Key Responsibilities

A. Receiving & Inspection

  1. Receive incoming goods and supplies from suppliers in accordance with approved purchase orders and delivery documents.

  2. Check the quantity, quality, specifications, and condition of received items.

  3. Ensure all goods received match the approved purchase orders and delivery notes.

  4. Report any discrepancies, damaged items, shortages, or incorrect deliveries to the Purchasing Department and immediate supervisor.

  5. Ensure all received goods are properly documented and recorded in the inventory system.

  6. Coordinate with the Purchasing Department and relevant departments regarding goods receiving issues.

B. Stock Management & Inventory Control

  1. Maintain accurate stock records for all items stored in the hotel warehouse.

  2. Monitor stock levels and ensure sufficient inventory is available to support daily hotel operations.

  3. Conduct regular physical stock counts and reconcile actual stock against system records.

  4. Monitor minimum and maximum stock levels and inform the immediate supervisor when replenishment is required.

  5. Identify slow-moving, expired, damaged, or obsolete items and report them accordingly.

  6. Ensure proper stock rotation using the FIFO (First In, First Out) or FEFO (First Expired, First Out) method, where applicable.

  7. Maintain accurate inventory documentation and stock movement records.

C. Issuing & Distribution

  1. Issue goods and supplies to hotel departments based on approved requisition forms.

  2. Verify the quantity and description of requested items before issuing stock.

  3. Ensure all stock withdrawals are properly authorized and documented.

  4. Record all stock issuance and returns accurately in the inventory system.

  5. Coordinate with department representatives to ensure timely and accurate distribution of requested items.

  6. Ensure that goods are distributed according to established hotel procedures.

D. Warehouse Organization & Maintenance

  1. Maintain a clean, organized, and properly arranged warehouse and storage area.

  2. Ensure all items are stored in designated locations with appropriate labels and identification.

  3. Maintain proper storage conditions to prevent damage, contamination, deterioration, or loss.

  4. Ensure food and beverage supplies, chemicals, and other materials are stored separately according to safety and hygiene requirements.

  5. Conduct regular checks on warehouse cleanliness, pest control, and storage conditions.

  6. Ensure proper handling and safe stacking of goods to prevent accidents or product damage.

  7. Follow hotel safety, security, and hygiene standards within the storage areas.

E. Documentation & Reporting

  1. Maintain accurate records of goods received, issued, returned, and transferred.

  2. Prepare daily and monthly stock movement reports as required.

  3. Assist in preparing monthly inventory reports and stock reconciliation.

  4. Ensure all receiving and issuing documents are properly filed and accessible for audit purposes.

  5. Report stock discrepancies, unusual consumption patterns, and inventory losses to the immediate supervisor.

  6. Assist during internal and external stock audits.

F. Internal Control & Compliance

  1. Follow established purchasing, receiving, storage, and inventory control procedures.

  2. Ensure goods are only received and issued with proper supporting documentation and authorization.

  3. Maintain proper control over warehouse access and inventory security.

  4. Prevent unauthorized stock withdrawals, misuse, and unnecessary wastage.

  5. Comply with hotel policies, Accor standards, occupational health and safety requirements, and applicable hygiene regulations.

  6. Perform other related duties as assigned by the immediate supervisor.

  • Minimum Diploma or Vocational School graduate in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Accounting, or a related field.

  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience in storekeeping, warehouse operations, inventory control, or a similar position, preferably in the hotel industry.

  • Basic knowledge of inventory management, goods receiving, and stock control procedures.

  • Familiar with FIFO and FEFO stock rotation methods.

  • Able to operate Microsoft Excel and basic inventory management systems.

  • Good numerical, organizational, and documentation skills.

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in handling inventory records.

  • Honest, responsible, disciplined, and able to maintain stock security.

  • Physically fit and able to handle goods and supplies when required.

  • Able to work independently and collaboratively with other departments.

title: Associate Engineer, Contamination Free Manufacturing (CFM)
description:
About GF

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power efficient and high-performance solutions for high growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit .


Job Summary

As a Contamination Free Manufacturing Assoc Eng, your primary responsibilities will include maintaining and planning of Airborne Molecular Contamination (AMC) detection systems are working well to ensure cleanroom environment and process tool mini-environment are within control and free from contamination. You will be able to apply knowledge of airborne molecular contamination, volatile organic compound, particulate, humidity and temperature to mitigate potential excursions in order to minimize the impact of excursion on production wafers due to environmental changes. Expect to regularly interact with Facilities, chemical lab personnel, modules equipment, and contractors in order to fulfill various requests, information and troubleshooting if any environmental alarms triggered. This role will assist engineer to monitoring fab environment and prevent environmental excursions if any. This position requires a candidate who can work in 12 hours shift (day/night), excel whether working independently or as part of team. Additionally, you will require the following skills/abilities: data analysis, strategic planning, reporting & presentation, and continuous improvement mindset.


Essential Responsibilities

  • As a shift lead in daily operation related to any cleanroom environment issues.
  • Work and align with module to troubleshoot the source of contamination for any AMC & mechanical alarms.
  • Analysis of charts to identify the root cause of contamination for any uptick or baseline drift that would be caused by internal or external.
  • Lead and guide the technician/ operator to perform activities other than routine job.
  • Prepare incident report with root cause finding for any AMC & mechanical alarms.
  • Escalate to modules for environmental CAS activation based on the defined alarm escalation guideline if any AMC & Mech alarm triggered.
  • Ensure hardware & software of monitoring systems are performing normally and taking appropriate action proactively to resolve issues with the system.
  • Plan & follow up the annual calibration & PM arrangement of AMC systems and Mini-E measurement tools with vendor.
  • Perform hardware parts change and replacement for AMC detection systems.

Other Responsibilities

  • Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.

description:
Chcete se podílet na modernizaci a rozvoji výrobního závodu?

Baker Hughes je přední globální energeticko-technologická společnost, která poskytuje inovativní řešení zvyšující bezpečnost, čistotu a efektivitu energie napříč celým hodnotovým řetězcem. Společnost působí ve více než 120 zemích a kombinuje hluboké znalosti odvětví s pokročilým inženýrstvím a digitálními technologiemi na podporu výroby energie, její transformace a dekarbonizace.


Rozviňte svou vášeň

Jako Projektový manažer pro stavební investice budete zodpovědný za přípravu, realizaci a řízení investičních stavebních projektů v rámci výrobního areálu. Budete vést projekty zaměřené na rekonstrukce a modernizace budov, přesuny technologií a další investice do firemního majetku. Součástí role je koordinace externích dodavatelů a dohled nad průběhem projektů od návrhu až po jejich úspěšné dokončení.


Jako Projektový manažer pro stavební investice budete:

  • Řídit přípravu, realizaci a vyhodnocení stavebních investičních projektů.
  • Koordinovat projekt, dodavatele a další zainteresované strany.
  • Zajišťovat dodržení rozpočtu, harmonogramu a kvality realizovaných projektů.
  • Posuzovat projektovou a stavební dokumentaci včetně technických výkresů.
  • Identifikovat odchylky v průběhu realizace a navrhovat nápravná opatření.
  • Zajišťovat pravidelný reporting o průběhu projektů a jejich finančním stavu.
  • Spolupracovat s technickými manažery, specialisty údržby a dalšími členy investičního týmu.

Abyste byli v této roli úspěšní, budete potřebovat:

  • SŠ/VŠ vzdělání stavebního směru.
  • Minimálně 5 let praxe v oblasti stavebnictví, investiční výstavby nebo řízení stavebních projektů.
  • Zkušenosti z realizační společnosti, stavební firmy nebo pozice stavbyvedoucího jsou velkou výhodou.
  • Schopnost číst a interpretovat stavební výkresy a projektovou dokumentaci.
  • Orientaci v investičních (CAPEX) projektech.
  • Zkušenosti s koordinací dodavatelů a řízením projektů.
  • Schopnost samostatně rozhodovat a efektivně komunikovat s interními i externími partnery.
  • Angličtinu na komunikativní úrovni (min. B1).
  • Schopnost vést projektové týmy a dotahovat projekty do úspěšného konce.

Pracujte způsobem, který vám vyhovuje

Uznáváme, že každý je jiný a že každý chce pracovat a podávat nejlepší výkon jiným způsobem. V této roli můžeme nabídnout následující flexibilní pracovní uspořádání:

Spolupráce s námi

Naši lidé jsou srdcem všeho, co v Baker Hughes děláme. Víme, že jsme lepší, když se všichni naši zaměstnanci rozvíjejí, jsou angažovaní a mohou být sami sebou. Co nabízíme vám

Naše vynálezy mění energetiku už více než století. Abychom mohli pokračovat i zítra, musíme posouvat hranice už dnes. Odměňujeme ty, kteří přijímají změny, balíčkem benefitů, který odráží, jak moc si jejich přínosu vážíme.

  • Zajímavé platové ohodnocení a čtvrtletní bonusy (dle splnění firemních a osobních cílů)

title: Social Content Producer - Inside I35 Contractor
company: Legal Counsel - 12 month FTC at Rightmove Greenhouse
description:

Social Video Content Producer (Contractor - Inside IR35)

Contract duration: Approximately 2-3 months
Location: London office - Hybrid working (Wednesday and Thursday in the office, with the remaining days remote)

About the Role

Rightmove is looking for an experienced Social Video Content Producer to support the delivery of an exciting programme of search-led video content as part of our Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) and social search workstream.

We're looking for someone who combines creative storytelling with hands-on video production expertise, bringing ideas to life through engaging, social-first content.

Working closely with our Content and Social teams, you'll help develop, film and edit a suite of YouTube videos across key topics, experimenting with different formats and styles to create content that is useful, engaging and discoverable.

This is a short-term contract opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership of the creative process, from initial concepts and scripting through to directing, filming, editing and final delivery.

What You'll Be Doing

Content Development & Planning

  • Develop engaging video concepts from content briefs and agreed topics.
  • Support scriptwriting and adapt existing content into compelling video narratives.
  • Collaborate with our Content and Social teams to explore creative approaches, formats and presentation styles.
  • Plan and coordinate video shoots, including preparing contributors, locations and production environments for filming.

Video Filming & Production

  • Lead the end-to-end filming and production of video content, including self-shooting and editing.
  • Film a range of social-first formats, including face-to-camera, interview-led and podcast-style content – filming in a variety of locations.
  • Direct and interview on-camera contributors.
  • Take on some face-to-camera presenting where appropriate.
  • Capture high-quality footage that can be adapted across different video formats.

Editing & Post-Production

  • Edit and produce engaging, high-quality YouTube videos that are appropriately paced and optimised for digital audiences.
  • Repurpose longer-form content into YouTube Shorts, adapting edits to suit short-form viewing.
  • Create supporting thumbnails and video packaging to help maximise engagement and discoverability.
  • Manage the post-production process, incorporating feedback and delivering polished final assets.
  • Ensure all content is delivered in the required upload-ready formats, including TRV files.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Work closely with our Content and Social teams to ensure content aligns with Rightmove's brand, tone of voice and objectives.
  • Participate in regular content reviews and planning discussions to maintain progress against agreed deliverables.
  • Incorporate creative feedback and ensure content meets relevant brand guidelines and compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate with external agencies where required to support production and delivery.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a creative, hands-on content producer and videographer who understands what makes great social content and has the technical skills to bring it to life.

You'll ideally bring:

  • Proven experience producing, filming and editing video content for social and digital platforms, particularly YouTube.
  • A good eye for detail when looking through the lens and the ability to create high-quality video content, in a range of social-first formats.
  • Strong understanding of social-first content, including what makes videos engaging, accessible and discoverable.
  • Experience creating branded content
  • Experience creating both longer-form YouTube content and short-form formats such as YouTube Shorts.
  • Ability to develop creative concepts and scripts from initial briefs.
  • Confidence directing and interviewing contributors, with some experience presenting on camera.
  • Strong video editing and post-production skills (including some graphics creation), with proficiency in industry-standard editing software, such as Adobe Premiere
  • Experience creating engaging video thumbnails and understanding how video packaging influences performance.
  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple pieces of content and deliver to agreed timelines.
  • A collaborative approach, with the confidence to share ideas, take feedback and work with a range of stakeholders.

An understanding of search-led content, YouTube SEO or emerging social search trends would be particularly valuable.

What You'll Deliver

Over the course of the engagement, you'll be responsible for delivering:

  • YouTube videos covering agreed business topics.
  • Supporting YouTube Shorts edits for each core video.
  • A mix of creative formats, including face-to-camera, interviews and podcast-style content.
  • Supporting thumbnails and video packaging.
  • Final edited assets in agreed, upload-ready formats.

The programme is expected to be completed by the end of Q4, with opportunities to test different creative approaches and styles throughout the project.

Working Arrangements

This is a 2–3 month contract engagement, based our Soho, London office.

We offer a benefit of a hybrid working arrangement, with Wednesday and Thursday as office-based days and the remaining working days remote. The successful individual will be expected to attend the London office and shoot locations to support filming, meetings and collaboration with the wider Content and Social teams.

You'll be expected to have your own filming and camera equipment, although Rightmove can support with arranging suitable filming locations where needed.

You'll work closely with our Content team, with additional creative input and oversight from our Social team, participating in regular check-ins and content reviews throughout the project.

Contract Engagement & Payment Arrangements

To engage with Rightmove on this contract, the successful candidate will be required to work through one of Rightmove's pre-vetted umbrella companies, which will be responsible for processing payments and payroll administration for the duration of the engagement. Please note the benefits below are only applicable to our directly engaged employees.

The successful candidate will be required to complete the relevant registration and onboarding process with one of our approved umbrella providers before commencing the engagement.

Please provide a link to your showreel and/or portfolio in your application.

Life at Rightmove

Despite our growth, we’ve remained a friendly, supportive place to work, with employee #1 still working here! We’ve done this by placing the Rightmove Hows at the heart of everything we do. These are the essential values that reflect our culture, and include:

  • We create value…by delivering results and building trust with partners and consumers.

We believe in careers that open doors and help our team develop by providing an open and inclusive work environment, offering ongoing training opportunities, and supporting charity fundraising events. And with 89% of Rightmovers saying we’re a great place to work, we’re clearly doing something right!


What we offer

title: Sr. Manager Product Manager - Technical, AWS Billing Product
description:
AWS Billing and Cost Management is seeking an exceptional Sr. Manager of Product Management - Technical to lead a transformational initiative maximizing how customers get the most out of AWS's billing and cost management capabilities. This is a high-impact leadership role that will shift our organization from sales operations focused to product solutions focused, driving customer enablement, reducing escalations, and pioneering outbound product engagement strategies.

Billing turns cloud usage into cash flow for AWS. Our team processes billions of dollars in revenue, delivering accurate and timely invoices to customers ranging from startups to the world's largest enterprises. We serve as the critical interface between AWS service teams, customers, partners, finance, and sales organizations. Now, we are building world-class customer-facing product experiences on top of our operational excellence foundation.

As Sr. Manager, you will lead the team building capabilities across Product Management, Technical Program Management, and Sales Operations functions. You will define and execute the product strategy for external-facing services that empower customers to understand their AWS spend, optimize costs, and resolve billing questions through self-service capabilities.


Key job responsibilities
You will lead the team analyzing escalation data and customer feedback to build self-service tools that deflect common billing questions and improve invoice acceptance rates. Your team will lead product discovery with enterprise customers to build intuitive solutions that drive understanding, adoption, and cost optimization. Working with engineering, UX, and data science teams, you will establish success metrics and drive cross-functional alignment across AWS service teams, finance, sales, and support organizations. By partnering with customer support and technical account management teams, you will translate recurring challenges into product requirements and implement proactive systems that prevent escalations.

You will establish an outbound engagement model where product managers regularly interact with customers through advisory boards, user research studies, and beta programs. Building relationships with key enterprise customers and partners, you will create feedback loops that inform product strategy and represent the voice of the customer in strategic planning and leadership reviews.

You will lead the organizational transformation from sales operations to product solutions focus, building a high-performing team across Technical Program Management, Product Management, and Sales Operations. You will establish new ways of working, uplevel capabilities, and create mechanisms that enable teams to move fast and deliver impact.


About the team
The AWS Billing and Cost Management team plays a mission-critical role in AWS's success. Customers and partners rely on us to calculate bills accurately, help them understand their charges, and enable optimization opportunities for their spend. AWS service teams rely on us to develop and commercialize pricing plans, meter usage, provide analytics, and present timely invoices for revenue collection. Finance teams rely on us to report revenue, measure program impact, and close books. Sales teams rely on us to operationalize private pricing agreements and support customer lifecycle events.

title: Software Development Manager, Amazon Software Builder Experience - Change Review, Amazon Software Builder Experience – Change Auto Review Experience (CRUX)
description:
Are you an engineering leader who wants to shape how software changes are reviewed and merged in the era of AI? The Change Review team within Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX) builds the tools and services that help Amazon engineering teams review and ship software changes safely and confidently.

AI-assisted development is changing the volume and nature of software changes and increasing the importance of reliable review and merge workflows. We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead a team building automated verification, publication, queuing, and merge capabilities. You will build and develop the team, own its technical and delivery roadmap in partnership with product leadership, and operate reliable systems that help builders advance changes safely and efficiently.

This role combines people leadership, technical depth, execution, and operational ownership. You will work backwards from builders, make decisions in an ambiguous and fast-changing domain, align partner teams, and maintain a high quality and reliability bar for the services your team delivers.

Key job responsibilities
Hire, develop, coach, and retain a diverse team of software engineers; establish clear expectations and help engineers grow their technical judgment, ownership, and leadership.
Own the team's technical and delivery roadmap in partnership with product leadership, translating customer priorities into executable plans and clear engineering outcomes.
Lead the design, delivery, operation, and continuous improvement of automated verification, publication, queuing, and merge services.
Establish mechanisms for predictable execution, dependency management, technical reviews, launch readiness, operational health, and durable follow-through.
Partner with product managers, senior engineers, customers, and dependent teams to resolve ambiguity, make trade-offs, and align interfaces and priorities.
Maintain a high technical and operational bar across architecture, security, correctness, reliability, maintainability, testing, observability, and incident response.
Establish responsible AI-assisted engineering practices in which engineers direct and validate AI tools while retaining clear human ownership of every design and production change.
Use customer feedback, operational signals, and engineering data to evaluate outcomes and improve product, delivery, and operational mechanisms.
Create an inclusive team environment that encourages constructive challenge, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.

A day in the life
Your day might begin with an operational or delivery review where you help the team understand a reliability issue, resolve a dependency, or make a technical trade-off. You may then coach an engineer, review the design of a verification or merge workflow, align a delivery plan with product leadership, or work with a partner team on an integration.

You will balance people development, technical judgment, execution, and operations. As AI-assisted development evolves, you will help the team build dependable mechanisms for reviewing and advancing software changes while keeping quality, safety, and accountable human judgment at the center.

About the team
Amazon Software Builder Experience creates tools and services that help Amazon engineering teams build, review, and deliver software. The Change Review team focuses on making software changes easier to understand, safer to review, and more dependable to merge.

We are shaping the future of change review as AI-assisted software development evolves. We value customer focus, sound engineering judgment, collaboration, technical craftsmanship, operational excellence, and inclusive leadership. We invest in our engineers' growth and expect managers to create an environment where people can do their best work and every perspective is heard.

title: Facilities Operations Centre (FOC) Engineer, AWS
description:
G'day! You've found an opportunity that could define your next chapter.

Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. More information regarding security clearances can be found at https://www.agsva.gov.au/.

The Mission - Why This Program, Why Now?

You're joining at the defining moment of one of the most significant technology programmes Australia has ever undertaken. This programme will build and operate the dedicated cloud giving Australia's national security community and its allies the capability to see more, share more, innovate and act faster than ever before.

Your Role in the Mission

Imagine being the eyes and ears of one of the world's most advanced data centre ecosystems. As a Facilities Operations Centre (FOC) team member, you'll sit at the nerve centre of 24/7 infrastructure monitoring the place where every electrical pulse, every mechanical system, and every critical alert converges into a single, unified picture.

This isn't passive monitoring. This is active stewardship of the physical backbone that powers innovation for millions. When a Large Scale Event unfolds or a Critical Site Event demands immediate coordination, you'll be the calm, decisive voice that brings teams together and drives resolution. You'll bridge the gap between IT infrastructure and facilities systems, understanding how these two worlds interlock to deliver unbreakable reliability.

You're joining a team that's being built from the ground up a newly developed capability where your ideas, your processes, and your standards will become the foundation. You'll help shape communication protocols, develop tools that amplify team performance, and drive a culture of operational excellence that ripples across the entire organisation.

Benefits
- Learning & development - AWS training and certification support, access to internal learning platforms.
- Health, income protection and life cover - Amazon subsidises private health insurance premiums, and group salary continuance and life insurance are included at no cost to you
- Military differential pay launching in Australia - Australian employees taking defence reserve leave may receive up to 52 weeks of military differential pay to help cover the difference in pay while serving
- Employee Assistance Program - Free, confidential support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for you and your family - mental health, financial coaching, legal questions, and everyday life events.
- Family-building benefit - Access to Maven for fertility treatment, adoption support, surrogacy, and parenting coaching
- Amazon Extras & employee discount - cashback and discounts across hundreds of retail, fitness, travel, and lifestyle partners.

Key job responsibilities
You'll be the operational heartbeat of our data centre infrastructure — monitoring, coordinating, and driving excellence across every shift.

Your core mission centres on real-time monitoring of the Amazon facilities infrastructure platform, where you'll interpret signals from electrical and mechanical systems to maintain optimal performance. You'll serve as the trusted point of contact for both internal engineering teams and external partners, ensuring seamless communication flows during normal operations and critical events alike.

When emergencies strike, you'll step into a coordination role that demands clarity under pressure. You'll facilitate recovery efforts during Large Scale Events and Critical Site Events, bringing together the right people with the right information at the right time. Your post-mortem contributions will turn incidents into insights, strengthening the entire operation with every lesson learned.

Beyond reactive response, you'll be a builder. You'll help develop communication and escalation protocols that sharpen team performance, and contribute to creating tools that make the entire FOC more effective. Your meticulous record-keeping will ensure continuity across shifts and provide the data foundation for continuous improvement.

This is shift work in a 24/7 environment.

title: Sr Technical Program Manager, AWS Generative AI & ML Servers
description:
AWS operates the world's largest fleet of GPU-accelerated servers powering AI/ML workloads at cloud scale. Our team designs, builds, and operates this fleet — solving systemic hardware issues and building systems that detect and prevent recurrence so customers experience the highest quality of service.

We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive end-to-end delivery of GPU-accelerated servers across our global fleet. You will coordinate cross-functional engineering teams spanning hardware, firmware, and software, manage ODM partnerships across multiple continents, and establish closed-loop quality systems that drive continuous improvements. This role requires technical depth to translate engineering constraints into program risk, combined with program management excellence to deliver complex hardware at global scale.

What You Will Do
You will own programs where the critical path runs through silicon, firmware, and software teams simultaneously. You will translate ambiguity into structure: turning a fleet telemetry signal into a corrective action plan with quantified failure rates, a customer requirement into a new platform milestone with EVT/DVT/PVT gates, or a manufacturing escape into a design change with updated validation criteria. You will drive decisions on program trade-offs — adjusting scope when qualification gates slip, balancing deployment speed against fleet risk, and determining when to accept interim mitigations instead of holding for root-cause fixes. When a large scale of GPU servers depend on your program landing on time, you are the one ensuring hardware readiness, qualification completeness, and operational handoff happen without gaps.

Why You Will Love It
The world's most advanced frontier models are trained on the platforms you help build. Your programs launch the GPU servers that power the largest AI/ML workloads on the planet. You will see your decisions reflected in fleet reliability metrics within weeks of deployment. The team is small and high-trust — you own programs end to end from concept through production, with direct access to leadership and engineering alike.

The Ideal Candidate
You have deep technical intuition across hardware and software — enough to challenge engineering decisions, not just track them. You thrive in ambiguity, bringing structure to programs where requirements, timelines, and dependencies are still forming. You align priorities across teams in different organizations, and you escalate with data, not noise. You actively mentor and develop others — TPMs and engineers alike. You contribute to hiring, promotion assessments, and raising the bar for program management practices in your organization.


Key job responsibilities
Strategy & Mechanisms
Define program strategy, objectives, and success criteria; influence resource allocation and priority decisions across engineering workstreams to align with organizational goals
Build and own mechanisms for program visibility — defining metrics, dashboards, and review cadences that enable data-driven decisions and early risk detection
Streamline delivery processes across teams; identify and eliminate dependencies, redundant gates, or coordination overhead that slow velocity

Requirements & Planning
Facilitate requirements gathering with internal customers; develop Technical Requirements Documents (TRDs) covering server specs, rack configurations, PCIe topology, power/cooling topology, and SKU definitions
Build program timelines aligned to different phases (Program Initiation, Design, Qualification, Pilot, Post-launch) with critical path analysis, risk identification with new & unique changes to the hardware, and milestone tracking for the program.
Drive Program Initiation reviews: scope definition, preliminary annualized failure rate predictions, resource planning, supply chain long-lead identification, and RFP (Request for Proposal) issuance to ODMs

Execution & Coordination
Drive cross-functional alignment across hardware, firmware (BIOS, BMC, CPLD), software, and operations teams through design reviews, manufacturing readiness and production readiness for fleet deployment.
Manage ODM partnerships: track EVT/DVT/PVT builds, manufacturing readiness gates, Bill of Materials (BOM) management in PLM systems, and quality checkpoints
Identify blockers early, escalate dependencies before they impact critical path, and facilitate technical trade-off decisions across engineering workstreams.
Communicate program status to leadership with clear reporting on milestone progress, risk posture, and mitigation plans.

Risk & Quality
Challenge technical workstreams to surface risks early; quantify impact to schedule and reliability (annualized failure rate targets, availability SLAs) with proposed mitigations
Drive root cause analysis of fleet-wide hardware failures and ensure corrective actions flow back into qualification criteria and design requirements
Define acceptance criteria, coordinate qualification testing at server and rack levels, and manage go/no-go decisions for mission-critical AI/ML workloads

Transition
Conduct knowledge transfer and document lessons learned; ensure operational readiness including automation, monitoring, and runbook completeness for production handoff

May require occasional (<10%) regional and international travel to Design and Manufacturing Partner sites.


A day in the life
You start the day syncing with ODM partners across time zones on build status and open engineering actions. Mid-morning, you run an engineering review connecting firmware, software, and hardware teams to unblock a qualification gate. In the afternoon, you triage a fleet reliability issue with operations data, drive alignment on corrective actions, and update executive stakeholders on program risk posture. You end the day reviewing NPI milestone readiness and ensuring the next design review has clear entry criteria.

About the team
The Hardware Engineering AI/ML UltraServer platform team is a group of engineers and technical program managers directly responsible for launching GPU-accelerated servers into the AWS fleet. Located in Seattle, Austin, and Cupertino, we collaborate with global development teams and ODM partners to deliver next-generation AI/ML infrastructure deployed in datacenters worldwide. We move fast with small, empowered teams delivering end-to-end — from server conception through fleet-scale operations.

title: RF Engineer
description:
About the role

The RF Engineer designs, integrates, tests, and supports radio-frequency systems for Skyeton unmanned aircraft systems (UAS), including airborne and ground-based communications, command and control, telemetry, and payload data links. The position translates mission requirements into reliable RF architectures, antenna installations, and verified system performance across intended operating environments.

This role partners with Systems, Electrical, Embedded Software, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Quality, and Flight Operations teams throughout development, production, and sustainment. Success requires strong RF fundamentals, practical laboratory and field testing skills, disciplined documentation, and an understanding of how aircraft integration affects communication reliability.

What you'll do

· Develop RF system requirements, architectures, interface definitions, and verification plans for airborne radios, ground stations, antennas, and associated RF components.

· Prepare and maintain link budgets addressing transmit power, receiver sensitivity, antenna gain and pattern, cable and connector losses, propagation, fade margin, interference, and mission geometry.

· Select, evaluate, and integrate radios, modems, amplifiers, filters, low-noise amplifiers, duplexers, couplers, attenuators, RF switches, connectors, and coaxial cable assemblies.

· Design and evaluate RF circuits or subsystems as assigned, including matching networks, filtering, gain distribution, impedance control, grounding, shielding, and power requirements.

· Analyze antenna selection, placement, polarization, radiation patterns, isolation, and coverage; collaborate with Mechanical Engineering on mounting, radomes, routing, bonding, and environmental protection.

· Evaluate RF coexistence and interference among aircraft radios, payloads, navigation equipment, electronics, and ground systems; identify desensitization, coupling, harmonics, and intermodulation issues.

· Use RF simulation and analysis tools to assess circuit behavior, antenna performance, propagation, and integration tradeoffs; validate analytical results through measurement.

· Perform laboratory characterization using spectrum analyzers, vector network analyzers, RF signal generators, power meters, oscilloscopes, and related equipment.

· Measure and document parameters such as return loss, insertion loss, gain, noise figure, output power, occupied bandwidth, spurious emissions, receiver sensitivity, and applicable error-rate metrics.

· Develop repeatable test procedures, fixtures, scripts, and acceptance criteria; maintain equipment calibration awareness and account for measurement uncertainty and test setup losses.

· Plan and support ground and flight tests to evaluate range, coverage, link availability, latency, throughput, and system behavior under representative operating conditions.

· Analyze RF logs and flight or field data; investigate intermittent link failures, interference, integration defects, and performance limitations using structured root-cause methods.

· Coordinate with Software and Systems Engineering on radio configuration, diagnostics, network interfaces, data rates, and link monitoring or recovery behavior.

· Support EMI/EMC and environmental qualification activities, including test planning, troubleshooting, corrective actions, and verification against applicable program requirements.

Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, RF engineering, telecommunications engineering, or a closely related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of relevant technical education and experience.

· Three or more years of relevant experience developing, integrating, or testing RF communications systems, antennas, radios, or related hardware.

· Strong understanding of RF fundamentals, transmission lines, impedance matching, S-parameters, antennas, propagation, link budgets, noise, interference, and modulation concepts.

· Hands-on experience using RF laboratory equipment and interpreting measurements to identify hardware and system performance issues.

· Experience integrating RF components and antenna systems, including evaluation of cable losses, connector interfaces, grounding, shielding, and coexistence.

· Proficiency with relevant analysis or simulation tools and data analysis using MATLAB, Python, or comparable software.

· Ability to read electrical schematics, RF block diagrams, mechanical installation drawings, and component specifications.

· Ability to support laboratory, ground, and flight-test activities and travel to test sites, suppliers, or customer locations as required.

Preferred Qualifications

· Master’s degree in electrical engineering, electromagnetics, communications, or a related discipline.

· Experience with UAS, avionics, airborne communications, telemetry, command and control, or long-range line-of-sight data links.

· Experience with digital communications, software-defined radios, diversity techniques, mesh networks, or resilient communications in congested RF environments.

· Experience with antenna simulation or RF circuit tools such as HFSS, CST, ADS, AWR, or comparable software.

· Experience with RF PCB layout, impedance-controlled routing, RF connectors, RF front-end design, or radio module integration.

· Experience supporting EMI/EMC or environmental testing using applicable DO-160, MIL-STD-461, or MIL-STD-810 requirements.

· Experience with automated RF testing, antenna pattern measurements, over-the-air testing, or production RF acceptance testing.

· Experience supporting aerospace or defense programs, export-controlled technical data, and formal engineering configuration management.

Skills and Competencies

RF system integration • Antennas and propagation • Link budget analysis • Laboratory measurement • Interference troubleshooting • Test data analysis • Technical documentation • Customer focus • Cross-functional collaboration

The Senior Engineer, Security Solutions leads the technical design and integration of complex security systems automation and controls solutions, including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, and their integration with building automation systems. This role translates project requirements into secure, reliable, maintainable solutions, reviews engineering deliverables, and resolves challenging design and installation issues. Working with project teams and field personnel, the senior engineer provides technical guidance, mentors engineers, supports project handoffs, and advances engineering standards and continuous improvement while balancing security, performance, budget, and client requirements.

  • Committed: Take ownership of technical quality, accurate submittals, and clear project handoffs. Address security and design risks early, follow through on commitments, and guide teams toward solutions that meet client requirements and project budgets.
  • Compassionate: Listen to the needs and challenges of clients, engineers, technicians, and programmers. Provide constructive guidance without judgment, welcome questions, and mentor others with patience and respect.
  • Innovative: Develop practical solutions to complex security automation and systems integration challenges. Evaluate emerging security technologies and alternatives for obsolete components, and turn field feedback into stronger engineering standards and deliverables.
  • One: Unite sales representatives, project managers, engineers, technicians, and programmers around shared project goals. Promote clear handoffs, collaborative problem-solving, and knowledge sharing that strengthens the entire team.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • No direct supervisory responsibilities. Provides technical leadership and mentorship to engineers and project teams.

Essential Duties

  • Lead the interpretation of construction drawings, specifications, security requirements, sequences of operation, and project scope to develop complex security automation and controls systems that meet design intent.
  • Incorporate access control panels, readers, door hardware, cameras, intrusion sensors, relays, and controllers to secure and monitor facilities; design or validate system architecture and component compatibility.
  • Serve as a technical resource for resolving complex discrepancies among security design intent, controller and device capabilities, network and communication protocols, and system configurations.
  • Partner with sales representatives and project managers to assess technical feasibility, clarify scope, identify design risks, and align security solutions with project goals, budgets, and client requirements.
  • Support or initiate improvements to engineering standards, templates, design practices, and quality review processes; mentor engineers and share technical knowledge across the department.
  • Prepare and review detailed security systems submittals, including system diagrams, controller and panel details, device schedules, door and end-device wiring diagrams, control panel layouts, third-party system integration, and network risers.
  • Coordinate or assist with technical reviews, respond to complex requests for information, and lead technical orientation and project handoffs to installation and programming teams.
  • Maintain and review accurate design records and as-built documentation to support commissioning, long-term maintenance, and troubleshooting.
  • Evaluate security technology trends, emerging technologies, cybersecurity considerations, parts obsolescence, and best practices; recommend practical updates to designs and engineering standards.
  • Conduct site visits to assess complex design requirements, support troubleshooting and resolution of installation issues, and validate security system performance against project requirements.
  • Gather feedback from technicians and programmers, investigate recurring issues, and incorporate lessons learned into clearer, more accurate engineering deliverables.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical, systems, or controls engineering, or substantial relevant security systems or controls design experience.
  • Advanced technical skills, including proficiency in CAD or Visio and the ability to interpret complex architectural and electrical blueprints, specifications, and security sequences of operation.
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading the design and integration of complex security systems automation and controls projects, with hands-on system design and programming experience and a focus on reliability, cybersecurity, and maintainability.
  • Strong working knowledge of access control, video surveillance, and intrusion detection systems, low-voltage wiring, networking and communication protocols such as OSDP, BACnet, Modbus, and TCP/IP, relay logic, and integration with building automation systems; ability to troubleshoot complex equipment and third-party integration issues.

Physical Requirements

title: Senior ASIC Cost Analyst, Silicon Operations
description:
The Senior ASIC Cost Analyst will build cost models and run cost governance for our next-generation satellite and customer terminal chips. You'll work closely with Silicon Engineering and the NPI team from the earliest design stages to build the cost picture for each new chip, covering wafer pricing, die size and yield, advanced packaging, test, and supply chain. As designs mature, you'll own the cost governance process. That means setting cost targets, maintaining the official cost baseline, reviewing changes against those targets, and holding programs accountable for cost. You'll provide the trusted cost numbers behind design, supplier, and manufacturing decisions, which ultimately drive material cost savings. You'll also partner with supplier management, supply chain, and finance, report to the ASIC Cost Manager, and brief senior leaders on cost status, risks, and savings opportunities.

Key job responsibilities
Build and maintain bottom-up "should-cost" models for ASICs. These cover wafer pricing, die size and gross die per wafer, yield, packaging and substrate, test time and ATE rates, and logistics.
Model costs across volume tiers and scenarios, such as different packaging options or supplier models (current suppliers vs. co-investment), and recommend the most cost-effective option.
Analyze wafer sort and final test costs: test time, how many parts are tested at once, ATE hourly rates and yield effects. Find ways to reduce test cost.
Compare supplier quotes from foundry, packaging and test vendors (e.g., TSMC, GF, ASE) against should-cost. Prepare cost breakdowns and fact-based arguments for negotiations.
Partner with supplier managers, program managers and engineering to set cost targets and track progress against them.
Track cost reduction efforts and savings. Report cost trends and risks in monthly business reviews.
Run sensitivity and what-if analyses for forecasts, yield ramps and changes in volume or pricing.
Maintain cost data, assumptions and model version control. Improve and automate cost modeling tools.
Present clear, data-backed recommendations to senior leadership.
Build scalable tools, dashboards and data pipelines so cost modeling is faster, repeatable and easy to check.

About the team
Our mission is to make satellite connectivity hardware affordable at scale. Our vision is a company where cost is treated as a core design requirement, just like performance and reliability, and where decisions rest on cost data everyone trusts. You'll work directly with design & test engineers, product development, supply chain and finance, and you'll present your findings to senior leaders.

title: Project Manager

Our flagship geofencing solution has been named as one of TIME’s Best Inventions and has made it onto the Digital Leaders 100 list for Geospatial Initiative of the Year.

We’re a venture-backed scale-up with an incredible team and work alongside industry-leading organisations in the rail sector to innovate and bring rail workers home safe every day. Tasks

  • Risk & Scope Management: Continuously track risks, manage dependencies, resolve delivery blockers, and maintain scope control across parallel client deployments.

  • On-the-Ground Rollouts: Take charge of live implementations. You're comfortable being on-site in operational settings (such as depots, hubs, or shift-based operations) to support deployments—including occasional weekend, bank holiday, or overnight shifts when rollouts go live.

  • Training & User Adoption: Develop and deliver training programs tailored to different end-user cohorts—from tech-savvy site leaders to frontline operational workers—ensuring capability and long-term retention.

  • Proactive Problem Solving: Take total ownership of project issues. When deployment roadblocks appear, you take the initiative to find creative, pragmatic solutions to keep projects moving forward.

title: Senior Security Technical Program Manager, AWS Security
description:
Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. For more information regarding security clearances please visit (https://www.agsva.gov.au/).

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the leading cloud service provider, providing virtualised infrastructure, storage, networking, messaging, and many other services to customers all over the world. AWS runs a globally distributed environment, operating at massive levels of scale. Businesses, from start-ups to enterprises to large government customers, run their operations and applications on AWS’ highly secure infrastructure.

As a Senior Security Technical Program Manager (Sr. Security TPM) within our team, you’ll influence and own long-term security outcomes for AWS. You’ll be working with external customers and regulated industries to understand their needs. You’ll be able to technically review and/or design security systems and solutions that enable them to operate more effectively, securely and safely. You will work with your team, partners, and customers to innovate and deliver on the vision and purpose of your programs. While working directly with AWS service teams, infrastructure, and administrative teams, you’ll identify opportunities to improve AWS’ security posture. This will include specifying tools, driving process improvements, and working with service owners technology to develop innovative solutions to complex technical challenges.

You will be responsible to identify, plan and deliver program security outcomes by independently engaging a broad set of internal and external stakeholders


Key job responsibilities
- Coordinate security-related engagements with both internal and external customers, ensuring effective communication and alignment of security objectives.
- Identify security packages of work and meticulously plan for their delivery within agreed timeframes, leveraging strategic foresight to anticipate and address potential challenges.
- Implement ISM, PSPF, DSPF, ASIO T4, NIST and/or other security compliance frameworks into design and build baselines to achieve the agreed security posture.
- Be proactive in removing roadblocks, fostering innovation, and managing multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment, driving continuous improvement and efficiency.
- Create, optimize, and support cross-functional working groups and projects, fostering collaboration and synergy across departments to enhance security capabilities.
- Utilize domain expertise to develop thought leadership material on cloud and emerging technologies, contributing to industry discourse and organizational knowledge sharing.
- Manage tight deadlines with precision and drive results, exhibiting exceptional attention to detail and ensuring the successful completion of projects and initiatives.

A day in the life
You'll immerse yourself in teams and leaders from different program stakeholders and businesses at AWS. You'll play a vital role in ensuring security outcomes crucial to our mission. You'll witness various facets of AWS's operations firsthand. Your contributions will directly shape our program's well-being and establish standards for technical security achievements. You'll own the responsibility of shaping and implementing processes to meet our program's goals.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

The team is comprised of security professionals with a cross section of national security and private sector experience, providing a range of perspectives required for creative problem solving. We value diversity of thought, creativity, and a strong Bias for Action and Earn Trust. We believe that there are no "perfect" security solutions and we develop and iterate using a continuous improvement process.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Research Project Manager (Department of Mental Health)
description:
We are seeking a Research Project Manager who will work under the general supervision of a PI(s) to manage the administrative and scientific implementation of a single complex and/or multiple research projects. As part of a research team, collaborates with faculty, develops project plan(s), develops SOPs, and oversees all activities for one or more research projects. Has accountability for grant submission and administration, and regulatory compliance. Supervises or oversees other exempt level research staff; may oversee staff at local or multiple sites.


Specific Duties & Responsibilities

  • Partner with investigator(s) and exercises independent judgement in managing the conduct of the research on behalf of the PI.
  • Participate in scientific discussions with collaborators, PIs, and funding organizations.
  • Collaborate with PI on protocol development and study design.
  • Develop or oversee development of standard operating procedures and data collection forms from protocol.
  • Train and provide oversight of research data management and regulatory compliance issues.
  • Develop or oversee development of study budget(s) and ensure that all study costs are included in the budget.
  • Responsible for finance-related issues.
  • Ensure the development, testing, and evaluation of manuals, questionnaires, and coding structures for the efficient collection of data.
  • Oversee data collection and validation.
  • Oversee quality control of study data
  • Lead study meetings to examine data, determine next steps, and implement changes to protocol operations based on results and goals.
  • Contribute to presentations and manuscripts.
  • Hire, supervise, and manage performance of other exempt-level research staff.
  • Other duties as assigned.


In Addition to Duties Listed Above

  • Assist parents in identifying school and community-based resources for the parents themselves & their children and sending parents via email or regular mail a summary of those resources.
  • Managing the study database, including the tracking of interactions with parents and children during the recruitment and interview process and participants’ needs, including incentives for interview completion & more information about the study.
  • Assisting the PI in the generation of IRB applications and progress reports.
  • Assisting the PI in the generation of progress reports for the funding agency.
  • Assisting the PI in the generation of data files to be deposited in the funding agency’s data repository.
  • On call a weeknight evening or weekend day once a week.


Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s Degree in a related field.
  • Five years of related research experience.
  • Demonstrated supervisory or lead responsibilities.
  • Experience working with school-age children in either school, medical, or mental health settings and supervisory experience within the context of research studies.
  • Additional education may substitute for required experience, and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond a high school diploma/graduation equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's Degree in a related field.
  • Training in social work and experience in the creation of IRB applications and progress reports and funding agency progress reports.


Technical Skills & Expected Level of Proficiency

  • Budget Management - Advanced
  • Data Management and Analysis - Advanced
  • Finance Project Management - Advanced
  • Oral and Written Communications - Advanced
  • Project Management - Advanced
  • Regulatory Compliance - Advanced
  • Report Writing - Advanced
  • Resource Data Quality Assurance - Advanced
  • Research Design - Advanced
  • Strategic Thinking - Advanced
