title: Senior Engineer– Thermodynamics, Rotor-dynamics & Compressor Selection
description:
Senior Engineer– Thermodynamics, Rotor-dynamics & Compressor Selection


Are you an experienced Senior Engineer looking for a new challenge?

Do you enjoy being part of team that provides high-quality engineering for our customers

A Senior Engineer in this role is responsible for the end-to-end technical development of centrifugal compressor solutions, integrating thermodynamics, rotor-dynamics, compressor selection, mechanical systems, and operability considerations into a complete flange-to-flange design. The role works across multiple engineering disciplines to ensure the selected compressor configuration meets performance, reliability, operability, cost, and customer requirements throughout the product lifecycle. The engineer leads complex technical evaluations, supports product validation and testing, resolves multidisciplinary technical challenges, and drives successful execution of New Product Development programs. Success in this role requires strong systems thinking, technical leadership, and the ability to influence engineering decisions across cross-functional teams.

A successful Senior Engineer in this multidisciplinary role would typically develop expertise in:


  • Compressor thermodynamic design and performance prediction across the entire flange-to-flange system.
  • Rotor-dynamic analysis, critical speed evaluation, stability assessment, and vibration behavior of centrifugal compressors.
  • Compressor selection, sizing, and application engineering based on customer process requirements.
  • Integration of aerodynamics, mechanical design, seals, bearings, rotor systems, and auxiliary equipment into a complete compressor solution.
  • System operability, performance matching, surge margin management, and operating envelope optimization.
  • Technical problem solving, root-cause analysis, and reliability improvement of rotating equipment systems.
  • Cross-functional leadership across Aerodynamics, Mechanical, Rotor Dynamics, Controls, Operability, Manufacturing, and Testing teams.
  • Design verification, validation, performance testing, and product qualification activities.
  • Risk assessment, technical decision-making, and lifecycle management of compressor products.
  • Project execution, technical ownership, customer engagement, and mentoring within NPD programs.



Qualification


  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering with 10 to15+ years of relevant experience, or a master’s degree with relevant experience.

Functional Job Responsibilities


  • Lead flange-to-flange compressor configuration and selection activities to meet customer process, performance, reliability, and operability requirements.
  • Perform thermodynamic analysis and performance prediction for centrifugal compressors across the full operating envelope.
  • Conduct rotor-dynamic evaluations including critical speed, stability, vibration, and rotor system behaviour to ensure robust designs.
  • Integrate aerodynamic, mechanical, seal, bearing, auxiliary system, and control requirements into a complete compressor solution.
  • Coordinate cross-functional engineering activities across Aerodynamics, Mechanical Design, Rotor Dynamics, Systems, Controls, Manufacturing, and Testing teams.
  • Lead technical trade-off studies, design reviews, and engineering decision-making to optimize performance, cost, schedule, and risk.
  • Support design verification, validation, performance testing, and product qualification activities throughout the NPD lifecycle.
  • Investigate complex technical issues and perform root-cause analysis to improve product reliability, operability, and customer satisfaction.
  • Develop and maintain engineering calculations, technical reports, product documentation, and design guidelines supporting product lifecycle management.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring while driving innovation, continuous improvement, and best-practice adoption across multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Role Responsibilities


  • Executes the evaluation, design, analysis, test, or integration of individual and team projects using sound engineering principles and adhering to business standards, practices, procedures, and product / program requirements.
  • Have complete understanding of the intended use and expected capabilities of the sub-system or sub-component and its level within the delivered structure.
  • Provide technical leadership to personnel/ cross functional teams supporting the assigned project.
  • Performs systems engineering tasks at the sub-system or component level, depending on complexity of the system and capability of the engineer.
  • Implement plans with guidance to meet technical requirements of assigned components and systems.
  • Develop action plans with guidance to respond to issues/ problems.
  • Lead or participate on teams assigned to address organizational initiatives and generic issues.
  • Recommend, with guidance, the approach to meet the technical and program requirements.
  • Present or participate in technical and program design reviews.
  • Assure proper documentation of technical data generated for the assigned projects and/or tasks consistent with engineering policies and procedures.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognise that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work during the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged, and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Our inventions have revolutionised energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritise rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

Who We Are

Founded in 1926, the Colonial Williamsburg Foundation is a private, not-for-profit educational, historic, and cultural institution that owns and operates one of the largest and best-known museum complexes in the world. Our mission is “that the future may learn from the past” through preserving and restoring 18th-century Williamsburg, Virginia’s colonial capital. We engage, inform, and inspire people to learn about this historic capital, the events that occurred here, and the diverse peoples who helped shape a new nation.

Today, Colonial Williamsburg is the largest living history museum in the U.S. The Historic Area is the 301-acre restored colonial capital with 89 original buildings and 525 buildings reconstructed to how they appeared in the 18th century through extensive archaeological, architectural, and documentary research. The Historic Area is staffed by highly trained, historically dressed interpreters and expert tradespeople who bring the 18th century to life. The Foundation also owns and operates two world-class museums, the DeWitt Wallace Decorative Arts Museum, and the Abby Aldrich Rockefeller Folk Art Museum, The Bob and Marion Wilson Teacher Institute, and a renowned research library, the John D Rockefeller Jr Library.

Additionally, Colonial Williamsburg is home to five world class accommodations at the Williamsburg Inn, Williamsburg Lodge Autograph Collection, the Griffin Hotel, the Williamsburg Woodlands Hotels and Suites and the unique Colonial Houses in the Historical Area. Visitors may also indulge in food and drink at our many on-site restaurants and taverns that blend a historically inspired dining experience with today’s evolved tastes. Each year over five million people visit Williamsburg and another 20 million engage with us digitally.

  1. Assist in developing sales and marketing strategies for short term groups of 30 rooms or less peak and/or other markets as assigned by Director of Sales that may book out further than 90 days.

Desirable

TerraBella Senior Living is looking for a Care/Medication Technician to join TerraBella Newton.

The Care Giver/Med Tech role includes providing hands-on care, physical and emotional support to each resident while maintaining a safe and comfortable home-like environment.

Responsibilities:

Care Giver:

  • Responsible for a designated group of residents during the shift; knows where their residents are and physically checks on them throughout the shift.

  • Assists with continence management and disposes of all continence products properly to ensure sanitation of resident suite and community restrooms.
  • Serves and collects food trays and assists as needed; reports refusal of meals or loss of appetite.
  • Maintains cleanliness of resident’s room and work areas.

  • Helps residents maintain independence, promotes dignity and physical safety of each resident.
  • Actively participates/leads and assists residents with activities of daily living (i.e. bathing, dressing, toileting, grooming, ambulation, transferring, eating) as instructed.
  • Engages residents in life skills and other life enrichment activities.
  • Greets and assists all internal and external customers, guests, family members, residents, vendors and team members.
  • Does resident laundry as assigned and needed.

Medication Tech duties:

  • Reviews service plan to learn pertinent information about residents.
  • Assists/observes medications and treatments for each resident using the medication observation record and the Six Rights of Medication Pass.
  • Documents and initials form as medications are given including appropriate documentation for refusal or missed doses.
  • Maintains confidentiality of all resident information including resident medication.
  • Reports all resident concerns made while assisting resident with the medication to the Nurse and/or Health Care Coordinator (HCC).
  • Restocks medication cart after all medication passes.
  • Assists in checking medication regardless of packaging system.
  • Counts all narcotics with another Medication Care Manager or Nurse each shift.
  • Maintains and cleans the Medication Room, med charts, treatment carts for neatness cleanliness, availability of medications and expired medications.
  • Follows re-fill process for medications.
  • Participates in the development of the Service Plan and monthly updates.
  • Takes and records temperature, blood pressure, weight, pulse and respiration rates.
  • Reports occupational exposures to blood, body fluids, infectious materials, sharp sticks and hazardous chemicals immediately.
  • Other duties as assigned by the Supervisor.

Qualifications:

Medication Technician Certification in NC REQUIRED

  • Certified Nurse’s Aid certification preferred.
  • High School diploma/GED
  • Must be 18 years of age.
  • CPR Certification preferred
  • First Aid Certification preferred
  • Previous experience working with seniors preferred.

Why Join Us

Discovery Senior Living Earned Coveted Great Place to Work Certification for 2025-2026!

A large part of what makes Discovery different from other companies in this industry is our willingness to embrace change. title: Pipeline Field Medical Lead

title: Asset Recovery & Remarketing Manager
description:
Asset Recovery & Remarketing Manager

Help small businesses move forward by leading the team responsible for asset recovery, remarketing, and maximizing value from recovered equipment.

Role Details

Location: Draper, Utah | On-Site

Schedule: Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM MT

Modality: In-Office

Compensation: Competitive compensation package based on experience, qualifications, and role responsibilities, with performance-based bonus eligibility.


About Clicklease

Clicklease is transforming how small businesses access the equipment they need to grow. Our technology platform uses data and automation to make equipment financing faster, simpler, and more accessible for business owners across the United States.

About the Role

We're looking for an Asset Recovery & Remarketing Manager to lead a critical function within our Portfolio Management organization.

In this role, you'll be accountable for the day-to-day performance, strategy, operational planning, vendor relationships, budget execution, and continuous improvement of our Asset Recovery and Remarketing operations.

You'll lead an established team, develop future leaders, and help strengthen how we recover, manage, and remarket equipment. You'll have meaningful ownership of operational results while partnering closely with Product, Technology, Accounting, Servicing, and the Vice President of Portfolio on strategy and priorities.

This opportunity is well suited for an experienced asset recovery or remarketing leader who has managed production teams, leveraged technology and data insights in operations, worked with third-party vendors, and improved operational and financial performance.


The Team

You'll join Clicklease's Portfolio Management department and lead agents supporting Asset Recovery and Remarketing operations based in the U.S. and Costa Rica.

The team works with external recovery and remarketing partners and collaborates with internal stakeholders to improve recovery outcomes, manage costs, and support compliant asset disposition.

You'll also help develop future team leads and supervisors as the operation continues to scale.

What You'll Do

  • Lead Asset Recovery and Remarketing operations. Oversee recovery, repossession, and disposition activities to improve timeliness, cost efficiency, and financial outcomes.
  • Build strong vendor partnerships. Manage recovery and remarketing vendors, negotiate commercial terms, monitor service performance, and improve vendor accountability.
  • Own operational performance. Develop operating plans, manage assigned budgets, establish KPIs and SMART goals, build reports and track results, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and recovery value.
  • Optimize asset disposition. Oversee auction and resale channels, evaluate remarketing outcomes, and improve processes that support net recovery proceeds.
  • Develop a high-performing team. Lead, coach, and manage production agents while identifying and developing future leaders.
  • Strengthen processes and controls. Partner with Portfolio leadership and Legal/Compliance to support appropriate asset recovery practices, issue escalation, and scalable operations.
  • Advance software & technology solutions. Identify and implement AI and data driven strategies and processes that optimize performance while limiting expense.

What You Have

  • 5+ years of professional experience in asset recovery, repossession, or remarketing within equipment finance, leasing, auto finance, or lending.
  • 3+ years of people-management experience, including direct supervision of at least seven employees.
  • Experience managing third-party asset recovery or remarketing vendors.
  • Experience negotiating vendor pricing, agreements, or commercial service terms.
  • Experience using operating budgets, performance reports, and scorecards to manage results.
  • Working knowledge of legal and regulatory requirements applicable to asset recovery and disposition, including UCC Article 9 and relevant state requirements.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Experience in small-ticket equipment finance or leasing.
  • Experience scaling operational teams and developing future supervisors or team leads.
  • Familiarity with Recovery Database Network, auction platforms, or comparable recovery and remarketing systems.
  • Experience with Salesforce and advanced Excel.
  • Experience with SQL, Snowflake, or business intelligence tools.

What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months

  • Build visibility into performance. Establish clear operating baselines and reporting for recovery results, remarketing performance, vendor effectiveness, and costs.
  • Strengthen vendor operations. Evaluate vendor coverage, agreements, and performance, and identify practical opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop the team. Establish consistent coaching and performance-management routines and begin building development plans for future leaders.
  • Create a roadmap for improvement. Deliver a prioritized Asset Recovery and Remarketing operating plan addressing budget performance, vendor strategy, processes, and scalability.

Why Join Clicklease

Clicklease is transforming how small businesses access the equipment they need to grow. Our technology platform uses data and automation to make equipment financing faster, simpler, and more accessible for business owners across the United States.

At Clicklease, you’ll work on meaningful problems that directly impact small businesses while collaborating with a team that values ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

We look for people who take initiative, work collaboratively, and care deeply about delivering great outcomes for customers and partners.

In return, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, contribute to a rapidly scaling fintech platform, and work alongside talented colleagues who are passionate about building great products and services.

What We Offer

Clicklease offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support employees and their families.

Benefits may include:

  • Competitive salary
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Employer-paid short-term disability (STD), long-term disability (LTD), and life insurance
  • Paid time off and company holidays

Benefits eligibility and details may vary based on role and employment status.

**Clicklease only accepts resumes submitted in English**

title: AI Assurance Lead (LLM Evaluation, Fine Tuning and Model Risk)
description:
About Intelance

Intelance is an independent technology, AI and cyber assurance firm based in the UK. We help organisations check, govern and improve their technology through enterprise architecture, AI governance, cyber assurance and data governance work. We are building a small panel of senior associates to deliver technology and AI due diligence on company sales and investments.

The role

You will check how AI systems are built, tested and governed, for clients who are selling, buying or investing in AI companies. You will test whether the AI does what the company claims, whether it is safe to rely on, and whether the data behind it is used lawfully. Our first engagements are with AI workflow platforms in regulated sectors that combine plain code, classic machine learning and fine tuned open source language models.

You report to an Intelance engagement partner and work with our technology due diligence lead, who brings your findings into the final report.

What you will do

  • Map where AI sits in a product: which steps are plain code, which use machine learning and which use language models.

  • Review how open source models are fine tuned, what data they learn from, and whether client contracts allow that use.

  • Test the evaluation approach: test suites, accuracy measures, human review rules and how failures are caught and fixed.

  • Check controls against prompt injection, data leaking between clients and tampering with models.

  • Check reliance on outside AI providers, and what data, if any, they receive.

  • Rate each finding by how it could affect the deal, and write clear, practical fixes.

What you will bring

  • At least five years building, evaluating or assuring machine learning or language model systems.

  • Hands on experience of fine tuning open source language models and designing evaluation suites.

  • Working knowledge of ISO/IEC 42001, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework or the EU AI Act.

  • The ability to explain model risk in plain words to founders, buyers and lawyers.

  • Experience with health, clinical or other regulated data is a strong plus.

  • Experience of due diligence, audit or model validation work is a strong plus.

How the work is set up

  • Remote within the UK, with occasional meetings in London.

  • Around 3 to 5 days between late November 2026 and the end of January 2027, with further engagements as the practice grows.

  • Freelance, or through your own limited company, at £650 to £800 a day depending on experience. Reasonable travel costs for client meetings are covered.

  • A panel agreement, NDA and statement of work are signed before any client details are shared.

  • You work from an Intelance mailbox and use our evidence log and report templates, so every report meets the same standard.

How to apply

Send your CV and answer the short screening questions. They take about two minutes. We aim to reply to every shortlisted candidate within five working days.

Nilai Tambah (Plus Points)

title: Director of Facilities (Senior Living)
description:
About Seaton Senior Living

Seaton Senior Living, part of the Discovery Senior Living family of companies, is a recognized industry leader in performance, innovation, and lifestyle personalization. As one of the nation’s leading senior living operators, Seaton Senior Living serves nearly 2,000 residents across the Mid Atlantic. Our communities are located throughout the Mid Atlantic—including Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, Virigina, and Maryland—where we are dedicated to creating exceptional experiences for our residents through operational excellence, personalized care, and a commitment to enriching lives every day.

As Director of Facilities, you’ll play an essential role in enriching the lives of seniors, creating meaningful connections, and making a difference every single day.

Your Role:

As the Director of Facilities, your role includes overseeing all building, grounds, and maintenance operations within the community. You’ll ensure the environment is safe, well-maintained, and supports resident satisfaction through proactive maintenance, staff leadership, vendor management, and regulatory compliance. In some communities, this position also oversees housekeeping, laundry, and transportation teams.

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage the daily maintenance and facility operations of the community, ensuring systems and equipment are functioning effectively and safely
  • Develop and execute a preventative maintenance program in compliance with regulatory standards and company policies
  • Supervise, schedule, and evaluate maintenance staff and, where applicable, housekeeping, laundry, and transportation teams
  • Ensure operational performance of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, fire panels, and emergency response systems
  • Oversee vendor contracts, service agreements, and capital improvement projects, ensuring quality and timeliness
  • Monitor departmental budgets, track expenses, and contribute to capital planning and cost controls
  • Conduct apartment and unit inspections prior to new resident occupancy
  • Assist with capital projects, renovations, and refurbishments to maintain a high-quality environment
  • Monitor compliance with local, state, and federal regulations governing life safety, maintenance, and environmental standards
  • Participate in the Safety Committee and disaster preparedness planning
  • Prepare departmental budgets, review variances, and implement corrective actions as needed
  • Respond promptly to after-hours emergencies and provide on-call support as required
  • Foster a service-first, resident-centered culture within all facility operations

Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or Bachelor’s/Technical degree in a related field
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in a maintenance leadership or supervisory role preferred
  • HVAC certification, licensure, or equivalent training strongly preferred
  • Working knowledge of electrical systems, plumbing, fire panels, and emergency response systems
  • Experience managing housekeeping, laundry, and/or transportation operations preferred (varies by community)
  • Demonstrated success in developing and implementing preventative maintenance programs
  • Experience managing vendor contracts and capital projects
  • Strong project management, organizational, and problem-solving skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and familiarity with TELS or other work order management systems
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and team-building abilities
  • Availability for after-hours emergency calls and participation in on-call rotation
  • [Insert if applicable: Relocation required for community; MOD responsibilities included]

Why Join Us

Discovery Senior Living Earned Coveted Great Place to Work Certification for 2025-2027!

A large part of what makes Discovery different from other companies in this industry is our willingness to embrace change. At Discovery Senior Living, we are constantly challenging how we are doing things to ensure the lifestyle we are offering our residents is absolutely the greatest value proposition in the marketplace. It’s just as important to us that the environment and culture for our team members are constantly refreshed. In addition, embracing and even encouraging change brings a never-ending supply of new energy to our business and our culture. That energy translates to other far-reaching positive impacts on our residents as well as our team members.

Find out what makes working at Discovery unique in the world of senior living. Discover Your Purpose!

Our Culture & Values

So often, what brings people together is deeply rooted in who we are and what we stand for. And at Discovery Senior Living, we’re unified by certain, core values, which we call our “Pillars of Excellence.” They make up the fabric of our company, and include TEAMWORK, INTEGRITY, PERFORMANCE, ACCOUNTABILITY, COMPASSION, HARD WORK and CREATIVITY.

Individually, they are our virtues, and together, they make up a roadmap which helps us foster innovation and success.

Benefits You’ll Enjoy

For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive pay, medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, paid time off and holidays, a 401(k) with employer match, paid training and career growth opportunities, wellness-related benefits, and additional support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. EOE D/V

A Note to Applicants

This job description outlines the general nature and level of responsibilities for this role and is not an exhaustive list of all duties. Qualified individuals with disabilities, as defined by the ADA, must be able to perform the essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation, as determined on a case-by-case basis.

Agency Policy

We do not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies. Please refrain from contacting hiring managers directly.

Employment Scam Warning

We only post jobs on our official careers site and accept applications through that platform. We do not conduct interviews via text or social media or ask for personal or banking information.

Regulatory Compliance & Background Screening

Discovery Senior Living complies with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws and regulatory requirements governing hiring practices, background screening, and workforce eligibility. Employment may be contingent upon successful completion of state-mandated and/or federally required background screenings, which may include criminal history checks, fingerprint-based screening, Level 2 background screening, registry verification, and other screenings required for healthcare and senior living roles with direct or indirect resident access.

Certain positions may be subject to additional requirements under federal programs, including CMS, Medicare, and Medicaid regulations, as well as state-specific licensing or regulatory agencies. Screening requirements vary by role and jurisdiction, and candidates must meet all applicable standards as a condition of employment. These measures support regulatory compliance and help maintain a safe, secure environment for residents, families, and team members.

Employment in Florida is contingent upon completion of a Level 2 background screening in accordance with Florida AHCA requirements. Applicants will be required to complete fingerprinting and background screening through the AHCA Clearinghouse. For more information, please visit: .

title: Part-Time Food & Beverage Associate I
description:
The Role:

San Francisco

Crafty’s Food & Beverage Associates are the face of our in-office Concierge pantry program. They are the human element and the friendly face that leads client-site execution on a daily basis; supporting the site’s product merchandising, inventory management & order replacement, in addition to equipment management.

This is a high-energy role for people who derive joy from a meticulously organized shelf and positive energy from being around people. Crafty is looking for an Associate whose responsibilities will include:

  • Merchandising: Take pride in your spaces by owning client’s office kitchens & pantries and highly organized storage rooms, complete expiration checks and product rotations as needed
  • Customer Service: With support from your manager, engage with our clients and other Crafty team members onsite, delivering the highest quality service
  • Maintenance + Inventory: Perform routine maintenance on machines (such as coffee & kegerators), quality control checks, and completion of task lists (inventory, budget)
  • Communication: Communicate and escalate any location needs or safety concerns your manager, and accurately complete pre/post route paperwork

This role is a part-time, hourly role within Crafty. This role supports one of our Chicago, clients Monday through Friday 7:00 AM - 11:00 AM by meeting the skill based qualifications below:


Required Attributes

  • Client Obsessed: Demonstrates a deep commitment to understanding and exceeding client needs and preferences, consistently showing eagerness and patience in all client interactions.
  • Effective Communicator: Demonstrates exceptional communication skills across interpersonal, verbal, and written formats to ensure clear, accurate, and positive interactions.
  • Operationally Sound: Ensures that all operations run smoothly, efficiently, and effectively, adhering to best practices and standards.
  • Reliable: Shows accountability, punctuality, and consistency in fulfilling commitments. Maintaining high service standards, fostering client trust, and contributing to operational efficiency.
  • Resilient: Quickly adapts to change, anticipates and addresses challenges with strong problem-solving skills, and maintains a positive attitude to ensure ongoing success.
    • Must be able to remain stationary for 50% of the time and capable of pushing, pulling, and lifting boxes weighing up to 50 pounds throughout the client site as needed
  • Collaborative:
    • Encompasses the ability to work effectively with others towards shared goals while providing and receiving constructive input to enhance individual and team performance
    • Demonstrates a team-oriented approach, emphasizing teamwork, supportive behavior, constructive conflict resolution, and a commitment to shared success.
  • Autonomy: Autonomy empowers client operations team members to act decisively, innovate, and continuously improve, ultimately leading to enhanced client relationships, operational efficiency, and overall success in their roles through site and task ownership.
  • Attention to Detail: Demonstrates exceptional attention to detail by meticulously overseeing merchandising, inventory management, and ownership responsibilities to ensure precision, consistency, and excellence in all aspects of operations.

Don’t meet all of the qualifications? We want you to consider all of your skills and experiences - both professional and personal- that would make you successful in this role. Although some qualifications are essential, others can be attained with time. We believe diverse perspectives, upbringings, and knowledge contribute to our strong company culture and we encourage you to apply.

Role Goals

Goal: Achieve a 95% annual client retention rate by delivering top-tier on-site operations and exceptional client experiences, ensuring all client goals are met and exceeded, for at least 6 consecutive months by completing these initiatives:

  • Initiative #1: Task Ownership: Complete daily task lists with an average of 95% successful shift completion week over week as measured via Tableau on a monthly basis.
  • Initiative #2: Quality control: Maintain an average of 95% or greater on all quality control checks quarterly.
  • Initiative #3: Client Satisfaction: Assist in supporting all client requests on a weekly basis, working with your manager and the site point of contact.

What we offer

Our people mean everything to us. When you join Crafty, you’re joining a team of passionate, smart people who work incredibly hard and have fun along the way.

We are proud to offer a compensation package that includes our Crafty healthcare plan, covering primary health, dental, and vision plans, 401k, paid time off, equipment certification courses, and parental leave. And, of course, it also includes Crafty-grade snacks, beverages, and fun events!

Lastly, this role offers a special opportunity: to have a major hand in shaping the future of a young, flourishing company. Your creativity, ambition, and work will steer the direction of our successes.

Our compensation amount for this role is $24 an hour. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including cost of living based on location, candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

title: Data Engineering Manager - Ads Audience, Identity, Signals and Measurement
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 and are building an in-house, world-class ad tech ecosystem to give our members more choices in how they enjoy Netflix. This tier lets us attract new members at a lower price point while creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences.


About the team

Ads Data Engineering is at the core of building a data ecosystem that powers Netflix's understanding and decision-making about the impact of ads on our business. This team builds rich, connected, and easily accessible data products spanning ad inventory, forecasting, targeting, ad serving, pacing, and more. This role will lead the Ads Signals & Measurement team across three core areas:

  • Conversion & Attribution: Building the data and attribution capabilities that connect advertising exposure to outcomes, powering conversion measurement and ML-based optimization.
  • Measurement: Building the data foundations that power our first-party measurement solutions across the full funnel, including incrementality, lift, experimentation, and third-party measurement studies.
  • Audience Onboarding & Identity: Enabling audience onboarding, identity resolution, and rich signal generation to power audience and targeting solutions.

Horizontally, the team connects these areas through a data flywheel where signals, identity, measurement, attribution, and optimization continuously reinforce one another. This role sits at the intersection of these domains, ensuring they come together as a cohesive data ecosystem that powers both measurement and performance optimization. We're looking for a Data Engineering Manager to help set the technical bar and lead teams across these domains.


Who are you?


  • A seasoned technologist with 15+ years building data-foundation, backend, or data engineering systems, someone other engineers naturally look to for direction.
  • You've spent real time in advertising or ad-tech data, specifically in domains like Ads identity graph, measurement, and targeting, and while your depth may run deepest in one domain, you're comfortable moving across several.
  • You've built trust and driven technical direction across organizational lines, not just within your own team, and you've done it in more than one company or role.
  • You take data privacy and governance seriously, not as a checkbox, but as something you've actually built for.
  • You're a clear, thoughtful communicator who can translate technical nuance for engineers and business context for leaders, often in the same conversation.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity, and just as comfortable helping a room of smart, opinionated engineers land on a shared answer.
  • You genuinely enjoy helping other engineers grow, and see that as just as core to the job as your own technical output.

What will you do?


  • Set the team's vision and direction, and ensure long-term coherence across the various orgs, connecting the dots between domains rather than optimizing just one.
  • Weigh in on and help resolve cross-domain decisions, working with uber TL and sub-domain ICs, helping teams converge on approaches that scale across the org, not just within a single team.
  • Mentor and coach data engineers, helping them grow technically and adopt AI and emerging tools and technologies.
  • Build strong partnerships with xfn partners in D&I, product and engineering teams as well as our data platform and horizontal DE teams outside of ads, contributing to and shaping horizontal and platform-wide efforts.

What (ideally) do you know?


  • Modern data stacks end-to-end: ingestion, processing, storage, and serving.
  • Ad-tech systems and data flows, ideally with direct exposure to at least 2 domains across measurement, attribution, identity, audience, and targeting.
  • Large-scale distributed data systems such as Spark, Kafka, or columnar stores.
  • The latest in AI and agentic technologies as they apply to data engineering.
  • A graduate degree in Computer Science with a data focus is a plus, as is experience formally mentoring engineers on their technical growth.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $446,000.00 - $752,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

title: Safety, Health & Environment Business Partner

title: Warranty Manager
description:
The Dobbs Truck Group is a growth company that successfully expands our operations and customer base through a high-quality team of employees.

Dobbs Truck Group operates 25 commercial truck dealerships through two operating companies – Dobbs Peterbilt and Western Truck Center. These dealerships represent some of the best commercial truck brands including Peterbilt, Volvo, Mack, Autocar, and Hino and include locations in Arkansas, California, Louisiana, Mississippi, Oregon, Tennessee, and Washington.

We offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, life insurance, and 401(k), as well as paid vacation and sick leave. Our Company is looking for long-term employees that we can invest in and grow with as we pursue our mission of being the premier commercial truck dealer group.

I. General Job Description

This position will be responsible for processing warranty claims for repair services and requests for repair services. This position will also be responsible for working with vendors and Warranty Administrators to ensure timely filing and collecting of all claims.

The duties listed below are intended only as illustrations of the various types of work that may be performed. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related, or a logical assignment to the position.

Responsibilities

  • Process warranty repair orders to obtain maximum recovery of revenue from vendor.
  • Work with service personnel to resolve issues to obtain maximum recovery of revenue from claims.
  • Insure all claims are filed promptly and accurately.
  • Communicate to Service and Parts Departments the proper time to process cores and other parts being held as a result of a warranty repair.
  • Work with all OEM and vendors in a professional fashion to maintain a good working relationship.
  • Work with vendors and Warranty Administrators to ensure Warranty Recovery Rate and Warranty Daily Outstanding Sales Rate is within target levels.
  • Work with OEM’s, Warranty Administrators, and managers to ensure Warranty ROs are closed timely.

Minimum Job Qualifications

  • 18 years of age.
  • 1 year of entry-level heavy-duty truck repair experience.

II. Desired Job Qualifications

  • High school graduate, GED, or 1 year of work experience.
  • Accounts Receivable experience.
  • Commitment and desire to learn medium and heavy-duty truck repair trade.
  • Intermediate to advanced knowledge off Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.
  • Strong organization, communication, managerial, and leadership skills.

III. Mental Capability Requirements

title: Senior Program Director - Science and Technology Policy and Law

description:
Job Description Summary:

The Center for Advancing Science and Technology (CAST) fuels innovation across physical sciences, engineering, computing, education, and policy to advance the nation’s future prosperity and resilience. Our work prepares and supports the U.S. workforce to strengthen American competitiveness and security.

CAST is comprised of five program areas (nationalacademies.org/cast). The Science and Technology Policy and Law (STPL) program area encompasses activities concerned with the scientific enterprise and the health and vitality of the scientific ecosystem. STPL examines legal and governance frameworks, monitors policy developments, and supports evidence-based decision-making.

The STPL Senior Program Director (SPD) is responsible for the development, implementation, and ongoing management and evaluation of program activities of significant scope, size, and/or complexity with particular focus on emerging issues in physical sciences, engineering, computing, and technologies. Develops the overall budget, including staffing requirements and ensures that each study or activity meets its stated objectives and supports the mission of the organization. Maintains internal and external relations. Oversees the assembling of committees and provides guidance to those committees in the conduct of their work and/or consensus building process. Responds to requests for studies, negotiating scope of work and budget, and independently develops high-impact programs/projects and negotiates funding with sponsors. Is a recognized leader in their field outside of the organization. Contributions often reach outside own board, program, or division (e.g., leading activities such as organization-wide training, consulting with other divisions on projects, and collaborating on division and organization-wide program development outside of their own portfolio. Significantly impacts the advancement of science or policy through the successful conduct of multiple and complex National Academies’ programs and activities.

Responsible for financial management and resource allocation, staff planning and management, and is fully accountable for the performance and results of the department. Has authority to formulate, affect, interpret, or implement management policies or operating practices. Studies and decisions have long-term implications and affect continuing operations. Subordinates may have higher job classifications requiring greater education and experience to master. If no subordinate manager, must have high-level professional staff as direct reports. Incumbent deals with important or controversial issues and effective persuasion, negotiation, and compromise are critical to work. Reports to the CAST Executive Director. Assignments to this job require the approval of the Chief Program Officer.

Job Description:

Responsibilities

  • Leadership: In consultation with executive director, chair, and members, develops and maintains a balanced, high quality, large portfolio of projects/programs with particular focus on emerging issues in physical sciences, engineering, computing, technologies, and the domains in CAST (nationalacademies.org/cast). Establishes a vision and working strategy for studies and activities conducted within the program.

  • Program Management: Plans, conducts, and directs work on projects/programs. Oversees the management of projects, assembles or oversees the assembling of board, committees, and/or study panels and provides oversight and guidance to the conduct of their work. Oversees quality assurance efforts.

  • Program Development: Responsible for program/project development. Maintains current and develops new relationships with prospective sponsors and other external contacts. Responds to requests for studies/projects, negotiating scope of work and budget, and independently develops high-impact programs/projects and negotiates funding with sponsors. Performs fundraising activities. Prepares proposals. Oversees management of contracts.

  • Staff Management: Provides leadership and mentors employees. Trains and develops employees to successfully perform current responsibilities and encourages development of staff for future roles. Forms effective teams and cultivates a work environment that fosters teamwork. Interprets and ensures consistent application of organizational policies. Initiates personnel actions, including performance and compensation reviews and if needed, disciplinary actions.

  • Collaboration, Communications, and Dissemination: Initiates and responds to opportunities for collaboration across units in division or other divisions in the Academies. Significantly impacts the advancement of science or policy through the successful conduct of multiple and complex National Academies’ programs and activities. Maintains communication and productive working relationships with program volunteers. Sets agenda and oversees meeting arrangements. Oversees outreach efforts, including dissemination. Conducts speaking engagements, handles press calls, participates in outside committees, and represents program at internal and external meetings. Oversees the report process during writing, reports review, and release, if applicable.

  • Financial Management: Oversees financial management. Participates in business planning, conducts status meetings, coordinates logistical issues, and implements planning, scheduling, and procedural changes.

  • Confidentiality: Maintains an appropriate standard of confidentiality. When handling secure, privileged, sensitive, or confidential information and matters, maintains strict confidence and exercises care to prevent disclosure to others. Accesses confidential information for work-related reasons only, following the policies and procedures of the organization. Ensures that any privileged, sensitive, or confidential information is securely stored, disposed of, and transmitted according to the Institutional guidance. Ensures procedures are in place to maintain and protect confidentiality and to prevent disclosure. Trains and updates staff/team members on these issues periodically.

Requirements

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to solve intellectual problems that reflect substantial variety and complexity.
  • Ability to serve as a resource to others in the resolution of complex problems and issues.
  • Ability to operate with substantial latitude for independent judgment and action.
  • Ability to negotiate funding.
  • Ability to train and develop staff.

  • Experience working in complex environments with a high degree of organizational effectiveness.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to effectively interact with all levels of employees.
  • Understanding of the National Academies’ mission and culture.

Minimum Education/Training Requirements: Doctorate in a related field or equivalent knowledge.

Minimum Experience: 10 years of related management experience, five of which were in a supervisory capacity.

Required Licenses, Certification or Registration: None

Cover Letter: Required; Applications submitted without a cover letter will not be reviewed.

Any qualification to be considered equivalent, in lieu of stated minimum, requires the prior approval of the Office of Human Resources.

Hybrid office/telecommute environment; expected onsite percentage 60%. Occasional travel between National Academies’ facilities and to off-site meeting/sponsor locations.

title: Google Cloud Data Platform and Security Architect
description:
About Intelance

Intelance is an independent technology, AI and cyber assurance firm based in the UK. We help organisations check, govern and improve their technology through enterprise architecture, AI governance, cyber assurance and data governance work. We are building a small panel of senior associates to deliver technology and AI due diligence on company sales and investments.

The role

You will review the security and set up of Google Cloud data platforms as part of technology due diligence, for clients who are selling, buying or investing in software companies. Buyers want to know that client data is kept apart, that access is tightly controlled and logged, and that the security claims in a company's SOC 2 or ISO 27001 evidence hold up in practice.

You report to an Intelance engagement partner and work with our technology due diligence lead, who brings your findings into the final report.

What you will do

  • Review how Google Cloud projects, BigQuery datasets and storage are organised, and how each client's data is kept separate.

  • Check IAM roles, service accounts, network controls, secrets and encryption keys.

  • Check logging, monitoring and alerting, including who can reach production data and how that access is recorded.

  • Test security claims against the company's SOC 2, ISO 27001 or client security questionnaire evidence.

  • Review backup, recovery and how the platform copes as data and users grow.

  • Rate each finding by how it could affect the deal, and write clear, practical fixes.

What you will bring

  • At least five years designing, running or securing production platforms on Google Cloud.

  • Hands on knowledge of BigQuery, IAM, VPC Service Controls, Cloud Logging and Cloud KMS.

  • A current Google Cloud Professional certification is a strong plus.

  • Experience supporting SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits.

  • Clear, plain writing that founders, buyers and lawyers can follow.

  • Experience with health or other regulated data, or with due diligence work, is a strong plus.

How the work is set up

  • Remote within the UK, with occasional meetings in London.

  • Around 3 to 5 days between late November 2026 and the end of January 2027, with further engagements as the practice grows.

  • Freelance, or through your own limited company, at £600 to £750 a day depending on experience. Reasonable travel costs for client meetings are covered.

  • A panel agreement, NDA and statement of work are signed before any client details are shared.

  • You work from an Intelance mailbox and use our evidence log and report templates, so every report meets the same standard.

How to apply

Send your CV and answer the short screening questions. They take about two minutes. We aim to reply to every shortlisted candidate within five working days.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About the role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Advanced Navigation, you will sit at the point where our navigation technology meets the real world. Working hands-on with customers — often on their sites, in their labs and alongside their vehicles and platforms — you will integrate our inertial navigation systems (INS), GNSS receivers and Fibre Optic Gyroscope (FOG) based solutions into customer systems, and make sure they perform under the most demanding conditions.


Moreover, you will support the sales team in ensuring customer satisfaction by managing timelines and providing clients with regular updates on project progress. Your role will be crucial in facilitating technical implementations and resolving product issues and escalations, all aimed at achieving the highest levels of client satisfaction.


This is a customer-facing team. You will run field trials, analyse navigation data, debug integration issues end to end and turn what you learn into working solutions for the customer and actionable feedback for our Product and R&D teams You will also provide onsite as well as online support to customer either in a pre-sales context or post-sales. You will support the sales team with technical credibility during evaluations, then carry that momentum through deployment so that customers reach value quickly and stay successful.


You will own delivery for a portfolio of customer deployments under the general direction Forward Deployed Engineering Manager, with a clear path to growing into a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer or Technical Lead.


What you'll do

  • Customer Deployment and Integration: Engage with prospects and customers to assess their geospatial navigation requirements and business objectives. Leverage your expertise in geospatial technologies, including GNSS (global navigation satellite system) and INS (inertial navigation system), to recommend solutions that address their specific needs and deliver measurable value. Collaborate with the sales team to design and customise solutions that align with customer requirements and differentiate our offerings in the market.
  • ● Product Demonstrations and Presentations: Conduct compelling product demonstrations and presentations to showcase the capabilities, features, and benefits of our geospatial navigation solutions. Tailor presentations to highlight the unique value proposition of our offerings and demonstrate how they address customer pain points and business challenges. Effectively communicate complex geospatial concepts and technical details to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • ● Customer Deployment and Integration: Embed with customer engineering teams to integrate Advanced Navigation products (INS, GNSS/INS, FOG-based systems) into their platforms across land, air, maritime and robotics applications. Configure, mount, align and tune systems; resolve interface, timing, communications-protocol and environmental issues until the solution performs in the customer’s real operating conditions.
  • ● Field Trials and Proof of Concept (PoC) Execution: Plan and run field tests, trials and PoCs with customers. Help define success criteria, collect and analyse position, velocity, acceleration and orientation data against reference truth, and present clear, evidence-based results to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • ● Voice of the Customer: Capture real-world usage, gaps and feature requests from the field and feed them back to Product and R&D in a structured, prioritised way. Contribute to product documentation, application notes, integration guides and internal knowledge bases.
  • ● Collaboration and Relationship Building: Foster strong relationships with cross-functional teams, including sales, product development, marketing, and customer success, to ensure alignment and seamless execution of pre-sales activities. Act as a trusted advisor to customers, providing expert guidance and support throughout the sales cycle to build credibility and trust. Maintain regular communication with customers to address questions, concerns, and technical inquiries, ensuring a positive pre-sales experience.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in relevant field (Masters preferred).
  • 3+ years of experience in a pre-sales or technical sales role, preferably within the technology industry.
  • Solid technical knowledge of inertial navigation systems, GNSS, and fiber optic gyroscopes.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Proven track record of driving successful sales outcomes, building customer relationships, and delivering exceptional service.
  • Customer-focused mindset with a passion for problem-solving, innovation, and continuous learning.
  • Customer-facing role, with a balanced capability across pre-sales, implementation, and support functions
  • A dedication to delivering a great customer experience while being a creative problem-solver in response to technical, product, and business questions
  • Experience working in support environments using integrated CRM systems as well as tools such as Matlab for data analysis.
  • Enjoyment in being in a fast-paced environment, to help customers accelerate their journey to creating an accurate position, velocity, acceleration and orientation under the most demanding conditions
  • A collaborative and team-oriented mindset for accomplishing goals
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Other languages are advantageous.
  • Strong experience in Python (preferred) and/or Matlab (less preferred) for data analysis. Any other scripting tool is also advantageous.
  • Excellent time management, driven to work quickly
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Effective presentation crafting and delivery skills
  • Willingness to travel and work hands-on in field environments (up to 25 % of the time).

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

Our Retail and Consumer experts are dedicated to helping clients in an industry which is being transformed by new technologies and evolving consumer expectations. Leveraging over a decade of experience in Applied AI, we combine exceptional technical and delivery expertise to empower businesses to adapt and thrive.


About the role

As a delivery manager, you’ll own the end-to-end success of high-impact AI projects for our retail and consumer clients. You act as the crucial link between our customers and technical teams - we’ll look to you to balance technical possibility with feasibility, ensure we maximise value for our clients, and cultivate strong external relationships which position Faculty as the partner of choice for future projects.

What you'll be doing:

  • Owning the end-to-end delivery of customer projects, from initial scoping to final implementation

  • Collaborating with technical teams, and customers, to design innovative AI solutions that solve their challenges and leverage opportunities

  • Managing project development and ensuring a delivery approach that provides maximum value to the customer

  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with customers; acting as the primary point of contact throughout the project lifecycle

  • Identifying new commercial opportunities and contributing to new business pitches and proposals

  • Developing and mentoring your peers; taking a proactive role in building good processes and practices

Who we're looking for:

  • You have previous experience in 0-1 AI/Digital transformation projects in the retail and consumer facing sectors (which also includes comms/telco, media/entertainment and consumer goods)

  • You take full responsibility for the successful delivery of your projects, from initial scoping to end-user adoption

  • You're currently client-facing - trusted to help them navigate ambiguous situations, complex technical information and unexpected challenges

  • You are a clear communicator, with outstanding written and verbal skills, using these to instil confidence, bring clarity, and influence senior stakeholders

  • You are comfortable working with technical teams and have experience delivering technical projects

  • You know how to gauge possibility, and feasibility, and how to lead a team to balance vision and pragmatism

  • You are a practical problem-solver, identifying potential issues and proactively implementing solutions

Our interview process:

  1. Talent Team Screen (40 mins)

  2. Introduction Interview (60 mins)

  3. Case Study Interview (60 mins)

  4. Interview with Business Unit Director (30 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Lab Intern, Chemistry & Lab Automation
description:
About b12

b12 builds AI agents and automated laboratories that turn molecular designs into real compounds and experimental data. We recently launched b12 Foundry and are building out our lab operations in San Francisco.

We are looking for a hands-on scientist to help run the chemistry and make our experimental workflows reliable. You will work closely with the founders, scientists and engineers, taking experiments from a proposed protocol through execution, analysis and a clear record of what happened.

What you will do
• Plan and execute small-molecule synthesis and reaction-screening experiments.
• Prepare reagents, stock solutions, samples and plate layouts with careful attention to identity, concentration and traceability.
• Develop and run automated workflows, checking that the physical experiment matches the intended protocol.
• Troubleshoot dispensing, handling and instrument problems using observations, controls and run data.
• Analyze results, investigate unexpected outcomes and distinguish chemistry failures from execution failures.
• Maintain clear experimental records, QC checks and reproducible operating procedures.
• Help set up lab equipment, supplies and day-to-day workflows as we build our San Francisco operation.
• Work with our engineers to improve the tools that plan experiments and control laboratory instruments.

What we are looking for
• Strong hands-on laboratory experience in organic chemistry, chemical biology or a closely related field.
• Evidence that you can independently execute experiments, interpret results and troubleshoot when things do not work.
• Experience with analytical characterization and careful experimental documentation.
• Good judgment around chemical handling, laboratory safety, contamination and data quality.
• A practical, organized approach and willingness to take ownership of both the science and the work needed to keep the lab running.
• Ability to work full-time on-site in San Francisco, ideally starting soon.

Especially useful
• High-throughput experimentation, parallel synthesis or reaction optimization.
• Experience with Chemspeed, Opentrons, Hamilton, Tecan or other laboratory automation systems.
• LC-MS, HPLC, NMR or other relevant analytical methods.
• Python, instrument scripting or experience translating manual procedures into automated workflows.

You do not need experience with every instrument we use. We care about the experiments you have personally owned, how you diagnose problems and how quickly you learn.

The founding team

b12 Labs was founded by Zlatko Jončev and Andres M. Bran.

Zlatko brings deep experience in organic synthesis, catalysis, medicinal chemistry, and laboratory automation. Andres builds AI agents for chemistry and systems that translate scientific intent into executable laboratory workflows.

Between us, we have worked at Roche, Chemspeed, the Max Planck Institute, and EPFL, where we helped pioneer AI agents for chemistry and retrosynthesis.

We started B12 after repeatedly seeing the same problem: scientists had powerful instruments and increasingly capable AI models, but fragmented software still forced them to connect every step manually—or become programmers just to operate their laboratories.

We are building the unified software layer we wished existed: from synthesis planning and experiment design through robotic execution.

How to apply
Send your CV and a short description of an experiment or laboratory workflow you personally ran and improved. Tell us which instruments you operated or programmed, where you are currently based and your earliest on-site start date.

THE LAST FRONTIER

ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist.

We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.

Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.

THE ROLE
We’re looking for a Senior Electronics Engineer to design, build, and test all electrical systems within ARD’s product stack. You’ll work at the intersection of hardware, software, and real-world deployment making an impact at every layer – from the PCB to Arctic field tests. You’ll move fast and take end-to-end ownership of the electronic architecture you’ll build, ensuring seamless operation in the harshest climate on Earth. You will be involved at all stages of electronics development and a key member of the engineering team at our early company stage.

* Please note: this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship *

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architect, build, and iterate embedded systems from first principles - including MCUs, PCBs, physical comms modules, and ARD’s custom subsystems

  • Own electrical integration across ARD’s full stack, optimising for SWaP-C at every iteration

  • Serve as the go-to technical lead across electrical, RF, systems, and mechanical interfaces

  • Work tightly with deployment, software, and systems teams to ship field-ready hardware

  • Get hands-on in field – travel to Arctic test sites and client installations

REQUIREMENTS

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience building electronics for real world systems and completing projects from the requirements stage through design, prototype and to production

  • An understanding across all areas of electronics - you'll be comfortable dealing with microcontrollers as well as RF circuits and DC/DC converters

  • Exposure to battery powered platforms including BMS and DC/DC power supply design is a real advantage

  • Good understanding of mixed signal board design including microcontrollers, sensors, ethernet, SPI, I2C etc

  • Proven track record designing & debugging high-density, high-reliability PCBs for harsh environments

  • Confident getting hands on soldering, prototyping & field testing under pressure

  • Willingness to learn quickly and push your limits in a fast paced environment

  • Self-driven, able to work effectively within a startup environment

  • Field ready: able to travel as required to test product in the field

Future Security Clearance Requirements

As our business scales into the defence and security sectors, the responsibilities of this role are expected to evolve to include projects requiring UK Security Check (SC) clearance.

While an active clearance is not required to apply or start in this role, candidates must be willing and eligible to undergo UK Government security vetting in the future should project requirements dictate it.

To meet the standard eligibility criteria for UK standard SC vetting, you must typically have resided in the UK for the past 5 continuous years, hold a valid passport, and be capable of passing comprehensive background, financial, and criminal record checks.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation

  • Private Health Insurance from Day 1

  • Dental & Vision

  • Equity - meaningful options as an early employee at an early-stage company

  • Real field exposure - travel to Arctic sites and Outposts when needed

title: Capital and Supply Ramp Manager
description:
About GlobalFoundries

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power efficient and high performance solutions for high growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity and sustainability. For more information, visit .


Summary of Role:

The Capital Ramp Program Specialist provides dedicated execution support for assigned Singapore capital ramp workstreams. Working under the Ramp Program Lead, the role owns detailed milestone tracking, supplier follow-up,

analysis, documentation, and closure of defined equipment and materials readiness actions.


The specialist may independently manage selected tools, modules, material packages, or supplier workstreams within the approved plan and escalation framework.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain detailed trackers for tool and material milestones, supplier commitments, risks, issues, dependencies, actions, change orders, and commercial impacts.
  • Coordinate execution from approved specification and configuration through RFQ, bid analysis, purchase order, contract, supplier build, delivery, installation, qualification, acceptance, and handoff for assigned scope.
  • Follow up with suppliers on long-lead items, build status, subtools, shipment readiness, field-service resources, spares, training, warranty, and recovery actions.
  • Coordinate with responsible teams on logistics, customs, export controls, trade compliance, move-in, pre-facilitization, hook-up, power-on, site acceptance, and shipment release.
  • Build and maintain materials readiness plans covering first fills, ramp consumption, supplier capacity, lead times, safety stocks, qualification status, and delivery dates for assigned packages.
  • Prepare meeting materials, dashboards, decision logs, action registers, cost summaries, and leadership updates for review by the Program Lead.
  • Identify deviations against baseline, investigate root causes with functional owners, and escalate unresolved risks early with impact and recommended next steps.
  • Support commercial execution, including RFQ packages, bid comparisons, supplier onboarding, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, contract routing, and change documentation.
  • Ensure acceptance evidence, final-payment conditions, warranty start, open punch-list items, and steady-state ownership are documented before handoff.
  • Independently manage defined workstreams as assigned while maintaining alignment with the Program Lead and relevant category owner.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, Operations, Project Management, or a relevant field of study.
  • More than 5 years' experience in sourcing, capital equipment, supplier management, project execution, manufacturing operations, materials planning, or a related environment.
  • Experience coordinating projects with suppliers and internal technical stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of RFQs, bid analysis, purchase orders, contracts, delivery commitments, and change management.
  • Strong project-control, analytical, organizational, follow-up, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain accurate records, and close actions with limited supervision.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and ability to learn GF business systems and reporting tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to travel as required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in semiconductor manufacturing, capital equipment, construction, facilities, materials readiness, or technically complex high-volume manufacturing.
  • Knowledge of equipment installation, hook-up, qualification, ramp, acceptance, and sustaining handoff.
  • Experience with logistics, customs, export controls, equipment importation, or trade compliance.
  • Experience with Oracle, SAP, procurement systems, project dashboards, Power BI, or work-breakdown-structure/time-charging processes.

GlobalFoundries is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard.


As an affirmative employer, all qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, marital status, citizenship, race, religion, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation and medical and/or physical abilities.


All offers of employment with GlobalFoundries are conditioned upon the successful completion of background checks, medical screenings as applicable and subject to the respective local laws and regulations.


No Recruitment Fee Policy: GlobalFoundries is committed to ethical and transparent hiring practices. Candidates will not be charged any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. Any request for payment related to a GlobalFoundries employment opportunity is unauthorized and should be reported immediately. All legitimate recruitment communications are conducted exclusively through official GlobalFoundries channels. To report concerns or suspected recruitment fraud, please contact our Ethics & Compliance Office at global[dot]compliance[at]globalfoundries[dot]com or visit our official website.

The Ethics & Compliance mailbox is not a recruitment channel. CVs/resumes submitted to this mailbox will not be reviewed, processed, or considered for employment opportunities. Please apply through the official GlobalFoundries careers site only.
