title: Associate Vice President, Salesforce Engineering & Development
description:
About Us

Infotech is a global IT research and advisory company helping technology leaders make better decisions. Our Commercial Technology organization develops and supports the Salesforce platform and custom applications that enable our commercial operations.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an accomplished, hands-on-minded engineering executive to build and lead our Salesforce engineering and development organization. This is not a steady-state operating role: you will establish stronger engineering management, quality practices, release discipline, technical governance, and AI-enabled development across three Salesforce scrum teams and a Salesforce administration function. You will lead through five direct reports: three Development Managers, a Quality Engineering Lead, and a Salesforce Administration Manager, all while partnering as a peer with Product Management and collaborating closely with a separate Architecture organization within IT.

The mandate is to build a cohesive, accountable, high-performing engineering organization. You must be credible in detailed technical discussions, able to challenge designs constructively, and equally capable of developing leaders, improving delivery systems, and driving sustained change.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead, coach, hire, and performance-manage five leaders: three Salesforce Development Managers, the Quality Engineering Lead, and the Salesforce Administration Manager. Build a consistent operating cadence while preserving accountability within each scrum team.
  • Set and execute a multi-quarter engineering maturity roadmap spanning software development practices, code review, testing, security, technical debt, release management, observability, incident response, and production support.
  • Own engineering delivery and execution for three Salesforce scrum teams; partner with Product Management on priorities, capacity, estimates, trade-offs, sequencing, and achievable commitments. Product retains roadmap and business-priority ownership.
  • Build a quality engineering discipline with the QA Lead: shift testing earlier in sprint planning, scale maintainable automated tests, reinforce developer-owned unit/integration testing, and create measurable release quality gates.
  • Establish consistent Git-based development and reliable release processes across all three Salesforce scrum teams, including deployment planning, sandbox-refresh coordination, release readiness, rollback procedures, and post-release validation. Partner with IT Architecture and existing DevOps resources on CI/CD tooling and shared environment services.
  • Assess and evolve the Salesforce DevOps operating model, clarifying ownership of CI/CD, pipeline administration, environment management, deployment automation, and release execution. Reduce manual work, approval bottlenecks, and single-person dependencies; recommend process and organizational changes.
  • Maintain clear boundaries between architectural design accountability (in IT) and engineering implementation, release execution, and application operational accountability (in this organization). Challenge impractical designs and surface technical risks early without duplicating the Architecture function.
  • Lead an AI-enabled engineering improvement agenda: evaluate secure coding assistants and automation, establish adoption guardrails with IT/security, upskill teams, and measure genuine productivity and quality improvements.
  • Oversee the Salesforce administration/service-request function, including intake, prioritization, support levels, recurring issue analysis, service metrics, escalation, and coordination between admin/configuration and development work.
  • Create transparent engineering metrics and management processes covering delivery predictability, cycle time, deployment frequency, change failure, recovery time, escaped defects, automation reliability, service responsiveness, and team health. Use data to improve outcomes rather than gaming metrics.
  • Build a sustainable talent strategy across North America and India, including leadership development, hiring, onboarding, documentation, cross-time-zone collaboration, and knowledge transfer from external partners.
  • Partner with Product, Architecture, Security, IT, and business leaders during critical incidents, major releases, and significant technical decisions; communicate risks, options, and progress credibly to senior executives.

What You Bring

  • 12+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including significant hands-on technical development earlier in your career and 5+ years managing engineering managers or multiple development teams.
  • Demonstrated success building or transforming an engineering organization where processes, automation, governance, and accountability were not already mature.
  • Strong technical expertise in Salesforce engineering, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, APIs/integrations, complex custom applications, deployment strategies, platform constraints, and production reliability. Ability to review designs and ask detailed technical questions without needing to be the principal coder.
  • Experience operating a multi-team Agile engineering organization with mature practices in CI/CD, automated testing, source control, environment management, release coordination, and incident management.
  • Ability to partner, and constructively disagree, with senior architecture leaders; experience establishing working agreements, decision rights, and practical documentation standards across organizational boundaries.
  • Experience developing strong managers, building accountable teams, improving distributed collaboration, and coordinating technical delivery with nontechnical product leadership.
  • Practical understanding of AI-assisted software development, including security, code quality, developer adoption, and measurable value realization.
  • Excellent executive communication, prioritization, change leadership, and stakeholder-management skills; sound judgment in balancing speed, maintainability, risk, and business impact.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with highly customized Salesforce CPQ, quote-to-cash, pricing, contracting, or commercial operations platforms.
  • Experience in sourcing externally managed development teams and improving operational knowledge transfer.
  • Experience overseeing a service-request/administration function alongside software engineering and quality engineering.
  • Experience across both US/Canadian and India-based delivery teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 30 days: establish relationships with Product and IT Architecture, assess the three scrum teams and admin function, baseline delivery/quality/support performance, review existing Salesforce DevOps responsibilities and tooling, and identify critical near-term risks.
  • First 90 days: publish a prioritized engineering improvement roadmap and clear decision-rights agreement with Architecture and Product; introduce consistent release, QA, operational, and engineering leadership cadences; assess the Salesforce DevOps operating model and recommend future enhancements; support the CPQ team’s transition to internal delivery leadership.
  • Within 6 months: demonstrate more predictable releases, visible testing and deployment standards across all three teams, a functioning automation improvement plan, stronger architecture documentation and design reviews, measurable improvements in service-request management, and a clearly defined, scalable Salesforce DevOps operating model with agreed ownership and reduced critical dependencies.
  • Within 12 months: sustain a high-performing engineering management bench, stronger production stability, reduced dependency on manual testing and external development support, and demonstrable improvements from responsibly adopted AI tooling.

SABSA, TOGAF, CISSP, CCSP and cloud certifications are welcome but do not replace the UKCSC registration requirement.

You must be based in the UK, able to attend UK client sites when agreed, and able to contract through a limited company or another compliant arrangement.

title: Game Reliability Manager
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Netflix is looking for a Game Reliability Manager to join Netflix Game Studios to help deliver the next generation of video games to a worldwide audience. This role is part of our Game Reliability team, which makes sure games launch ready and stay healthy across our portfolio and platforms. You will help get every title ready well before launch, applying learnings to proactively set the right level of support, expectations, plans and monitoring so launches go smoothly. You will keep incidents related to game health moving, run post-incident reviews to make sure what we learn feeds the next launch, and help partners have a clear view of game health through consumable dashboards and automated alerts. You will work with Production, Game Engineering, Quality Assurance, Release Management, Player Support and other cross-functional teams, and alongside the senior Game Reliability Manager, who sets the team’s strategy, frameworks and standards. Your ideas will help shape and improve them over time.


Responsibilities

  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to get every title launch ready, from onboarding and support-level alignment to checklists and support plans.
  • Triage game health signals and alerts, translate them into what is happening and who needs to act, and start investigations with the right owners across teams.
  • Keep incidents moving toward resolution with a clear owner and a current update, and apply the incident declaration and severity standards.
  • Run post-incident reviews, or make sure they happen, and close follow-ups on time.
  • Review incidents across titles to identify repeat patterns that can be applied as learnings for future launches.
  • Produce game reliability reporting, including stability updates and incident reports, that cross-functional partners can understand and act on.
  • Run a regular feedback loop with partners and execute the improvements that come from it, and help shape the Game Reliability roadmap.
  • Create, update and maintain runbooks, checklists and the incident and launch knowledge base so that process and execution stay consistent.
  • Spearhead initiatives with Engineering to influence how our processes and tools mature on a technical and automated level.
  • Leverage tools to automate workflows and dashboards that can scale with volume.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in Incident Management, SRE, TPM, Release Management, Production, Live Operations or QA, ideally supporting games or live service products.
  • Ability to read crash, QoE and cloud or mobile data, spot what is off, dig in, and explain what it means to technical and non-technical partners.
  • A self-starter who takes action despite ambiguity without waiting for direction, and makes timely calls with the information available.
  • Strong prioritization and judgment: you focus effort by risk, and you know when to escalate.
  • Experience building trusted relationships across Production and Engineering, and closing loops without formal authority.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including concise incident updates, post-incident reviews and reports.
  • Experience writing and maintaining runbooks, checklists and process documentation.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools, such as Claude, to automate reporting and analysis, and an automation mindset.
  • Familiarity with incident management and on-call tooling (such as Incident.io or PagerDuty) and with dashboards and monitoring.
  • Passion for playing games and for understanding what makes them great.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $170,000.00 - $250,000.00.

title: Automation Specialist Intern
description:

title: Digital Experience Engineer - Genesys Cloud & AI
description:
Be the Technical Engine Behind Next-Gen AI & Cloud Contact Centers


Are you a Genesys Cloud engineer or CCaaS specialist who loves building custom API integrations, prototyping with AI, and seeing the real-world impact of your work with clients?


At Probe CX, we’re expanding our Digital team in Manila—and we’re looking for a sharp, hands-on Digital Experience Engineer who wants to move beyond routine ticket queues and help shape how modern contact centers run.


About the Role


Based in Manila and reporting to our Senior Manager – Digital Experience and Success, you will serve as the technical engine for building, integrating, and optimizing our client-facing digital and CX platforms.


Working across Genesys Cloud, Amazon Connect, and complementary AI and knowledge ecosystems—including Convai Oration, Upland Panviva, livepro, and Symtrain—you will translate solution blueprints into clean code, build custom webhooks and REST APIs, lead platform optimization programs, and use modern AI tools like Cursor and Claude to prototype and ship solutions in days instead of weeks.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Technical Implementation & API Integration: Develop, configure, and deploy omni-channel CX workflows, custom webhooks, REST APIs, and middleware connecting Genesys Cloud and Amazon Connect with client CRMs and backend systems.
  • L3 Engineering & Root-Cause Resolution: Serve as an escalation point for complex system and integration bugs—performing deep root-cause analysis and refactoring configurations to boost stability, lower latency, and streamline agent workflows.
  • Platform Success & Client Engagement: Partner directly with clients and our Digital Architects on ongoing platform success programs—running optimization reviews, translating technical features into business wins, and keeping system diagrams and API specs sharp.
  • R&D, Prototyping & AI-Accelerated Delivery: Build and validate Proofs of Concept (PoCs) using conversational AI, automation, and licensed AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini)—helping transition successful sandbox experiments into production-ready modules.

What You Bring to the Table

  • CCaaS & Cloud Platform Expertise: 2–3+ years of hands-on experience in CCaaS or CRM platforms (or an Engineer, Architect, or Customer Success technical role), with strong Genesys Cloud capability as a must and Amazon Connect as a strong plus.
  • APIs, Webhooks & Technical Execution: Solid experience building and troubleshooting REST APIs, JSON data flows, and CRM integrations—with the ability to turn architectural designs into clean, reliable configurations (Python or scripting experience is a bonus).
  • AI Curiosity & Modern Mindset: You actively embrace new ways of working. Whether you’re already using Cursor, Claude, or Gemini in your daily workflow or building AI side projects, you’re eager to push what’s possible.
  • Ecosystem Exposure (Nice to Have): Familiarity with conversational AI or agent-assist tools such as Convai Oration, Upland Panviva, livepro, or Symtrain, plus any relevant cloud or CCaaS certifications.
  • Client-Facing Confidence & Ownership: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills paired with clear communication—you’re comfortable fronting client meetings, taking full end-to-end accountability, and upholding strict data security and privacy standards.

Why Join Our Digital Team in Manila?

This role is designed for ambitious engineers who want fast career growth, real technical autonomy, and direct exposure to international clients.


You’ll get hands-on access to enterprise AI engineering tools, close collaboration with global Digital leaders, and the opportunity to turn R&D ideas into live enterprise solutions.

- Schedule and organize project meetings; prepare agendas, record minutes, and track action items to closure
- Coordinate site access, onboarding, and logistics for contractors, vendors, and internal visitors
- Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for GCs and internal teams on administrative and documentation matters

Track & Report:
- Track project schedules, milestones, and deliverables; flag delays and open items to CMs early
- Manage RFI and submittal logs to make sure responses are on time and followed up
- Compile project metrics, status updates, and risk logs for CMs and senior leadership
- Support budget tracking by recording costs, purchase orders, and change orders against approved estimates

Support:
- Process purchase requests, POs, and invoices in line with company procurement and finance policies

- Find and put in place improvements to coordination processes, templates, and tracking tools that make the team more efficient

title: Research Specialist (Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering)
description:
Whiting School of Engineering's Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering department is seeking a Research Specialist to split time between managing the mouse colonies of the Elisseeff Lab in the Translational Tissue Engineering Center (Johns Hopkins School of Medicine) and performing mouse surgeries to collect blood and generate serum for the lab's research.


The Research Specialist performs a range of assays and experiments specific to an area of research, requiring a good understanding of the work of the laboratory. Makes contributions to various aspects of research efforts. Performs routine troubleshooting and helps with training and orientation of others working in the laboratory.


Specific Duties & Responsibilities

  • Plan and run experiments after discussion with investigators. Work may include making protocol modifications within the parameters set by investigator.
  • Utilize specialized knowledge to interpret results, e.g. read controls, and evaluate results.
  • Use scientific knowledge and lab experience to evaluate whether component parts of experiments are working as expected.
  • Train/orient learners and new staff in the laboratory.
  • Assist in development of new techniques and instruments.
  • Become familiar with published research methods related to current experimental work by investigating published protocols and discussing them with more senior laboratory staff and/or faculty investigators.
  • Process analyzed data into figures for scientific publications.
  • May order equipment and supplies, and interface with vendors.
  • May facilitate problem solving for entry-level lab members with research assays.
  • May participate in protocol development, efficiency, and productivity.
  • May contribute to writing manuscripts and grants by writing methodology sections.
  • Other duties as assigned.


In addition to the duties described above

  • Manage the laboratory's mouse colonies (about half of the position), including husbandry, breeding, weaning, genotyping, and colony maintenance in compliance with approved animal care and use protocols.
  • Set up matings, track litters and experimental cohorts, and maintain colony records, breeding schedules, and inventories in coordination with lab members and animal facility staff.
  • Perform mouse surgeries for blood collection and process the blood into serum (about half of the position) following standardized protocols.
  • Aliquot, label, catalog, and store serum samples, keeping accurate records.


Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Biology, Chemistry or related field.
  • One year of laboratory experience performing relevant techniques.
  • Additional education may substitute for required experience and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond a high school diploma/ graduation equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Some experience working with mice.
  • General laboratory skills, such as pipetting, preparing solutions, and following written protocols.
  • Strong organization and attention to detail.
  • Willingness to learn mouse surgery for blood collection, serum processing, and genotyping.
  • Post-undergraduate research experience is a plus but not required.
  • Mouse surgery for blood collection and serum processing (training provided).
  • Genotyping, including nucleic acid isolation and real-time PCR (training provided).


Technical Skills & Expected Level of Proficiency

  • Data Management and Analysis - Awareness

  • Protocol Development and Optimization - Awareness

title: General Chapters - Packaging and Distribution – Digital Twin Expert Panel - Member
description:
Who is USP

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s top experts in health and science to develop quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. USP’s fundamental belief that Equity = Excellence manifests in our core value of Passion for Quality through our more than 1,100 talented professionals across five global locations to deliver the mission to strengthen the supply of safe, quality medicines and supplements worldwide.

Who are our Expert Volunteers?

A hallmark of USP’s standards is that they are determined by independent scientific experts. USP Expert Volunteers are selected based on their individual expertise and experience and use their best personal, professional, and scientific judgment to work collaboratively on setting standards. USP Expert Volunteers must agree to disclose conflicts of interest and to uphold standards of conduct that preserve the integrity of the standard setting process.

2025-2030 Focus Area: This Expert Panel will focus on advancing the strategic and technical foundation for digital twin implementation in pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical development and manufacturing. The Panel will help define terminology, scope, and practical expectations for pharmaceutical digital twins; identify high-value use cases across development, technology transfer, manufacturing, and lifecycle management; and develop a roadmap and framework to support credible, compliant, and effective adoption. The work is expected to address model credibility and validation, data governance, lifecycle management, interoperability, cybersecurity, and alignment with evolving regulatory and standards-based expectations.

2025-2030 KEY ISSUES:

  • Terminology and Scope Harmonization: Establish clear definitions and practical distinctions among digital models, digital shadows, digital twins, cognitive digital twins, and related concepts used across pharmaceutical contexts.
  • Model Credibility and Validation: Define risk-based expectations for verification, validation, qualification, and ongoing performance monitoring of digital twin models used in GxP-relevant applications.
  • Data Governance and Interoperability: Address data quality, traceability, metadata, system integration, and lifecycle management needed to support reliable and scalable digital twin deployment.
  • Cybersecurity and Computer System Assurance: Clarify expectations for secure architectures, change control, access management, and assurance of software-enabled and AI/ML-enabled capabilities.
  • Use Cases and Implementation Frameworks: Prioritize representative applications such as formulation development, process development and scale-up, process monitoring and control, predictive maintenance, and real-time release support.
  • Regulatory and Standards Alignment: Identify opportunities to support globally harmonized guidance and standards concepts that improve regulatory confidence and enable broader industry adoption.

Required Expertise:

    The expert volunteer should have experience in one or more of the following areas relevant to pharmaceutical digital twins:

    • Process Modeling and Simulation
    • Mechanistic, empirical, hybrid, or AI/ML-enabled modeling approaches
    • Scale-up, technology transfer, and process optimization o Model verification, validation, and uncertainty assessment • Advanced Manufacturing and PAT
    • Real-time monitoring, process control, and continuous verification
    • Sensor integration and analytical data streams
    • Use of digital tools to support manufacturing robustness and efficiency
    • Data Science, AI/ML, and Digital Infrastructure o Data architecture, interoperability, metadata, and governance o Predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and decision support
    • Cloud, edge, or hybrid computing environments for regulated applications
    • Automation, Control Systems, and Assurance o Automation architectures, software-defined automation, and OT/IT integration
    • Computer system assurance, cybersecurity, and change management
    • Lifecycle management of digital systems in GxP environments
    • Pharmaceutical Development and Manufacturing Applications
    • Formulation development, process development, and scale-up
    • Commercial manufacturing, predictive maintenance, and batch quality assessment
    • Application of QbD, QRM, and lifecycle concepts to model-informed operations
    • Regulatory and Standards Experience o Familiarity with global regulatory frameworks relevant to digital and model-informed manufacturing
    • Participation in standards development, guidance development, or industry consortia
    • Experience communicating technical expectations across industry, academia, and regulatory stakeholders

    In this role as a USP Volunteer, you contribute to USP’s public health mission of increasing equitable access to high-quality, safe medicine and improving global health through public standards and related programs.

title: Technology Due Diligence Lead (M&A and SaaS Platforms)
description:
About Intelance

Intelance is an independent technology, AI and cyber assurance firm based in the UK. We help organisations check, govern and improve their technology through enterprise architecture, AI governance, cyber assurance and data governance work. We are building a small panel of senior associates to deliver technology and AI due diligence on company sales and investments.

The role

You will lead technology due diligence engagements for clients who are selling, buying or investing in software companies. Some reviews are paid for by the seller and run in two stages: a private readiness review so the company can fix issues first, then a report that buyers read in the data room. Our first engagements are with data and AI platforms in regulated sectors.

You lead the work day to day. An Intelance engagement partner owns the client relationship and signs off the report, and you work alongside our AI assurance, cloud security, data protection and GxP specialists.

What you will do

  • Review the architecture, code, cloud set up and data pipelines of modern data platforms, such as those built on Google Cloud, BigQuery, dbt, Airflow and Looker.

  • Run code and open source licence scans, and turn the results into clear findings.

  • Interview founders and technical leads, request evidence and review it.

  • Keep the evidence log, so every statement in the report is backed by a document or by two people.

  • Rate each finding by how it could affect the deal, and write a fix list the seller can act on.

  • Bring the specialist findings together and write both reports to a standard a buyer's advisers will trust.

What you will bring

  • At least five years in technology due diligence, technical advisory or senior engineering leadership.

  • At least three due diligence reports written as the main author. Experience of a vendor report shared with buyers is a strong plus.

  • Hands on knowledge of modern data platforms and SaaS architecture. Google Cloud, BigQuery and dbt are a strong plus.

  • Sound judgement on code quality, technical debt, scalability, secure development and open source licence risk.

  • Clear, plain writing. Your reports are read by founders, buyers and lawyers.

  • A calm, respectful manner with founders who are close to their product.

  • Experience with health, clinical or other regulated data is a strong plus.

How the work is set up

  • Remote within the UK, with occasional meetings in London.

  • Around 2 to 3 days a week from late November 2026 to the end of January 2027, with further engagements as the practice grows.

  • Freelance, or through your own limited company, at £650 to £800 a day depending on experience. Reasonable travel costs for client meetings are covered.

  • A panel agreement, NDA and statement of work are signed before any client details are shared.

  • You work from an Intelance mailbox and use our evidence log and report templates, so every report meets the same standard.

How to apply

Send your CV and answer the short screening questions. They take about two minutes. We aim to reply to every shortlisted candidate within five working days.

title: Manager - Risk Analysis, Amazon Leo - Fraud and Abuse
description:
Are you passionate about protecting customers and building trust at scale? Do you thrive at the intersection of fraud and abuse investigation, engineering collaboration, and strategic problem-solving?

As a Manager of Risk Analysis within the Leo Fraud and Abuse team, you lead a team of risk analysts that will serve as a critical bridge between operations, engineering, and business stakeholders. You will be accountable for holding a high bar on making fraud and abuse decisions, driving automation, scale the team for growth and proactively identifying new fraud & abuse trends that require mitigation. This is not a traditional back-office operations role. You will be expected to think like an investigator and communicate like a strategist, driving measurable impact across the fraud and abuse prevention ecosystem.

Key job responsibilities
- Audit and ensure that the adjudication of complex fraud and abuse cases across Account, Identity, Payment Fraud, and Abuse vectors follow the SOPs and maintains a high bar.
- Apply sound judgment and navigate high-risk decisions where outcomes directly impact customer trust, financial exposure, and enforcement integrity.
- Constantly question assumptions, identify improvement opportunities, and follow up on implementation of those enhancements.
- Collaborate with the Fraud and Abuse product team to deep-dive on escalations and complex edge cases requiring nuanced investigation.
- Provide ongoing feedback to product and engineering stakeholders on tooling gaps, workflow friction points, and opportunities for automation or process simplification.
- Proactively ideate, design, and document new fraud and abuse scenarios based on investigation insights, industry trends, and adversarial thinking to strengthen detection models and enforcement rules.
- Identify gaps in current detection systems, investigation strategies, and enforcement workflows, and recommend enhancements and process improvements to mitigate emerging risks through a collaborative approach with stakeholders.
- Drive innovation in fraud detection and investigation methodologies - challenging the status quo and bringing fresh, creative approaches to problem-solving.
- Hire and develop a team of Risk Analysts

*** Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

title: Specification Manager Region 16
description:
As a Specification Manager region 16, Georgia. Your primary responsibility is to develop relationships and drive product specification within the architecture and design (A&D) community. You will focus on getting Acoufelt’s solutions integrated into project designs by working closely with architects and interior designers.


You will not be responsible for closing deals or managing transactions. Instead, your success will be measured by the number and value of specifications generated and the growth of Acoufelt’s revenue within your region. You’ll collaborate with inside sales, and the special projects team to ensure opportunities move through the pipeline effectively.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and strengthen relationships with architects and designers to increase brand awareness and drive specification.
  • Identify and create new opportunities by engaging A&D firms and presenting Acoufelt’s solutions in a consultative, problem-solving approach.
  • Deliver compelling product presentations and educational sessions (CEUs) to design firms, positioning Acoufelt as the preferred solution.
  • Track and document all activities and opportunities in CRM, ensuring accurate project details and progress updates.
  • Collaborate with inside sales and the special projects team to ensure a seamless handoff once opportunities move toward pricing and bidding.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, key projects, and competitor activity to strategically position Acoufelt in the market.
  • Consistently follow up with designers and project stakeholders to keep Acoufelt top of mind throughout the specification process.


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of success in architectural product sales or specification sales within the A&D community.
  • A relationship-driven professional with a passion for working with architects and designers.
  • Experience in consultative, solution-based selling, particularly in the commercial interiors sector.
  • Strong presentation skills and the ability to deliver CEUs and educational sessions.
  • Proficiency in CRM systems and Microsoft Office for tracking opportunities and maintaining pipeline visibility.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple projects and relationships simultaneously.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and bonuses
  • Comprehensive health insurance including a choice of two medical plans, dental, vision, employer paid health savings account, and voluntary accident, hospital, life, critical illness.
  • Paid Time Off starting at 15 days with carry over
  • Collaborative wellness program
  • Paid volunteer time off

  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Rewards and Recognitions

title: Clinical Compliance Coordinator
description:
Essential Functions

  • Conduct clinical chart reviews, compliance spot checks, and peer reviews of DAs, DAUs, treatment plans, progress notes, and other documentation to ensure quality, medical necessity, and regulatory compliance.
  • Identify documentation deficiencies, recommend corrective actions, and provide staff coaching and training on clinical compliance expectations.
  • Coordinate agency Quality Improvement (QI) activities, monitor performance indicators, analyze trends, and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Oversee ADAMH outcome measures (BAM, OQ), staff training, and ADAMH, NCCC client satisfaction, and referral source surveys.
  • Prepare quarterly Quality Improvement Plan (QIP) reports for the Board of Directors, including agency outcomes, performance measures, incident trends, client satisfaction, compliance activities, progress toward goals, and recommendations.
  • Monitor regulatory changes and coordinate updates to agency policies and procedures to maintain compliance with applicable laws, Medicaid, ADAMH, CARF, and other requirements.
  • Coordinate Ohio Department of Behavioral Health (DBH/OhioMHAS) licensing and renewals, including Terminal Distributor of Dangerous Drugs (TDDD) renewals and related documentation.
  • Coordinate ongoing CARF accreditation readiness, annual survey preparation, compliance reviews, and corrective actions.
  • Participate in Corporate Compliance Committee meetings and coordinate quarterly compliance training and other required staff education.
  • Coordinate monthly Safety Committee meetings, health and safety activities, site and residential house self-inspections, and related corrective actions.
  • Monitor incident reporting, required follow-up communications, regulatory compliance, and trend analysis; identify risks and recommend improvements.
  • Lead internal investigations involving compliance, documentation, policy violations, privacy, and quality-of-care concerns, including interviews, record reviews, findings, and recommendations.
  • Coordinate the annual review, evaluation, and updating of agency plans with department leadership, ensuring regulatory and CARF compliance, appropriate approvals, and documentation. Plans include: Disaster Preparedness and Emergency Response, Quality Improvement, Information Technology, Professional Services, Cultural Competency and Diversity, Accessibility, Corporate Compliance. Risk Management, Personnel.
  • Support HIPAA Privacy compliance, including staff education, communication, privacy concerns, and appropriate follow-up.
  • Review subpoenas and legal records requests and coordinate records releases in accordance with applicable laws and agency policy, consulting leadership or legal counsel as needed.

Limited Direct Clinical Services

  • Complete Diagnostic Assessments (DA), Diagnostic Assessment Updates (DAU), annual clinical assessments, and required documentation as needed.
  • Provide limited direct clinical services to support operational needs while maintaining applicable clinical and documentation standards.
  • Serve as a resource to staff and leadership while maintaining the independence and objectivity necessary to effectively monitor organizational compliance and quality.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Current, unrestricted Ohio LISW license required.
  • Master's degree in Social Work from an accredited program.
  • Experience in behavioral healthcare, community mental health, or a related setting.
  • Experience with clinical documentation, chart review, compliance, quality assurance, or quality improvement strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of behavioral health documentation and medical necessity requirements.
  • Familiarity with Ohio behavioral health regulations, Medicaid requirements, HIPAA, and professional ethical standards.
  • Experience with CARF accreditation standards preferred.
  • Strong written, analytical, organizational, and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to interpret regulations, standards, policies, and clinical documentation requirements.
  • Ability to objectively investigate concerns and communicate findings professionally.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • The successful candidate will demonstrate:
  • Knowledge of clinical documentation, behavioral health service standards, compliance monitoring, quality assurance, and continuous quality improvement practices.
  • Understanding of CARF accreditation, Ohio behavioral health licensing and regulations, HIPAA, confidentiality requirements, and applicable laws and policies.
  • Ability to conduct chart reviews, audits, peer reviews, compliance spot checks, and objective internal investigations.
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret regulations, evaluate data, identify trends, and recommend improvements.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple compliance, licensing, accreditation, and quality improvement projects.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to educate, coach, and provide constructive feedback to staff and leadership while maintaining confidentiality.
  • Proficiency with electronic health records, Microsoft Office, and other agency information systems.

Salary: $70,000 Annually

Physical Demands & Working Conditions

Work is primarily performed in office, outpatient behavioral health, and residential behavioral health environments. Duties require prolonged periods of sitting, computer use, reviewing electronic and paper records, attending meetings, conducting inspections, and traveling between agency locations as needed. The position routinely handles confidential clinical, personnel, compliance, investigative, and organizational information.

Acknowledgment

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by individuals assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, qualifications, or activities associated with the position. Responsibilities may be modified, expanded, or reassigned based on regulatory changes, accreditation requirements, organizational priorities, and operational needs.

title: PRIPRAVNIK/CA U ODJELU ZA KIBERNETIČKU SIGURNOST I SPECIJALIZIRANE INFORMATIČKE SUSTAVE
description:
SEKTOR ZA INFORMATIKU 
ODJEL ZA KIBERNETIČKU SIGURNOST 
I SPECIJALIZIRANE INFORMATIČKE SUSTAVE 
PRIPRAVNIK (koeficijent za plaću 3,60*osnovica za plaću 604,91 eura) 
1 izvršitelj na određeno vrijeme u trajanju 12 mjeseci 
Uvjeti: 
• Završen diplomski studij (minimalno 300 ECTS bodova) 
• Smjer obrazovanja: društveni/tehnički 
• poznavanje rada na računalu u MS Office okruženju (Word, Excel) 
• aktivno znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu 
• mjesto rada Zagreb 
Prednost pri zapošljavanju će pod istim uvjetima imati kandidati koji su tijekom studija ili kroz druge oblike obrazovanja stekli znanja iz područja kibernetičke sigurnosti ili specijaliziranih informatičkih sustava vezanih za područja inteligentnih transportnih sustava. 
Tijekom pripravničkog staža kandidati će imati priliku upoznati se s poslovima iz područja kibernetičke sigurnosti i specijaliziranih informatičkih sustava iz područja inteligentnih transportnih sustava. 
Tražimo kandidate odgovornog i profesionalnog odnosa prema poslu, kreativne i spremne na timski rad i kontinuirano učenje i usavršavanje. Ukoliko ste u navedenom prepoznali mogućnost razvoja karijere u skladu s Vašim profesionalnim interesima i ambicijama, a udovoljavate navedenim uvjetima, pridružite se našem timu. Nudimo rad na zanimljivim projektima, ugodnu radnu okolinu, mogućnost razvoja u timu stručnjaka te kontinuirano učenje i profesionalni razvoj. 
Zainteresirani kandidati prijave na Natječaj dostavljaju isključivo na obrascu „Prijavni upitnik“. U prijavnom upitniku obavezno se navodi ime i prezime kandidata, adresa stanovanja, broj mobitela, e-adresa te podatci o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz Natječaja. Prijavni upitnik je sastavni dio ovog Natječaja te se nalazi na web stranici Društva  . Obrazac je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati. Uz Prijavni upitnik, kandidati su u obvezi priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta: životopis, presliku diplome, potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO. 
Između kandidata koji zadovoljavaju tražene uvjete može se izvršiti selekcijski postupak testiranjem. Testiranje se sastoji od provjere stručnog znanja, engleskog jezika te rada na računalu. Prednost će pod istim uvjetima imati kandidati koji budu imali veći broj bodova ostvaren prilikom testiranja. 
Kandidati koji prema posebnim propisima ostvaruju pravo prednosti, moraju se u prijavi pozvati na to pravo, odnosno uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu. 
Napomena: Da bi ostvarili pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju temeljem članka 102. stavaka 1. do 3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članova njihovih obitelji, kandidati su dužni uz prijavu priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te dokaze propisane člankom 103. istog Zakona u svrhu ostvarivanja prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju. 
Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja na kojoj su navedeni dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema Zakonu o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN br. 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21), Zakonu o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN br. 84/21): 
 
U skladu s člankom 13. stavkom 2. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/08, 125/11, 20/12, 138/12 i 69/17) na oglas se mogu prijaviti osobe obaju spolova koje ispunjavaju propisane uvjete. 
Između kandidata koji zadovoljavaju tražene uvjete izvršit će se selekcijski postupak testiranjem. Testiranje se sastoji od provjere znanja, sposobnosti i vještina kandidata, a bit će obuhvaćeno iz zakonskih i podzakonskih akata vezanih uz poslove radnog mjesta za koje se kandidat prijavio. 
Isključivo će se razmatrati prijave dostavljene na obrascu „prijavni upitnik“, zaprimljene u objavljenom roku u elektronskom obliku na e-mail adresi: posao@hac.hr s naznakom „za natječaj za zapošljavanje“ - navesti radno mjesto za koje se prijavljuje. Neće se razmatrati prijave koje ne sadrže podatke o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta te nisu dostavljene u roku. 
Ako odabrani kandidat odustane od sklapanja ugovora o radu, zvat će se prvi sljedeći kandidat s rang liste. 
Ugovor o radu sklopit će se na određeno vrijeme, uz probni rad u trajanju 6 mjeseca. 
Hrvatske autoceste d.o.o. neće kandidate osobno izvještavati o rezultatima odabira, osim onih koje su prema posebnim propisima obvezni obavijestiti. Rezultati Natječaja bit će objavljeni na web stranici na adresi: . 
Osobni podaci kandidata obrađivat će se u svrhu obrade prijave na natječaj, sukladno članku 6. stavku 1. točki b) Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka. 
Ovisno o radnom mjestu i podacima koje kandidat dostavi, HAC obrađuje sljedeće podatke: 
• identifikacijske podatke (ime i prezime, datum i mjesto rođenja, OIB, državljanstvo), 
• kontaktne podatke (adresa, broj telefona, adresa elektroničke pošte), 
• podatke o obrazovanju, stručnim kvalifikacijama, dodatnim edukacijama, znanjima i vještinama, 
• podatke o radnom iskustvu i prethodnim zaposlenjima, 
• podatke o poznavanju stranih jezika, rada na računalu i drugim kompetencijama, 
• podatke o vozačkoj dozvoli kada su potrebni za radno mjesto, 
• podatke o ostvarivanju prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju, kada ih kandidat dostavi radi ostvarivanja prava propisanih zakonom, 
• podatke nastale tijekom selekcijskog postupka (rezultati testiranja, bilješke s razgovora, procjena kompetencija, motivacije i stručnosti kandidata). 
Ako kandidat ne dostavi podatke potrebne za provedbu natječaja, Poslodavac neće biti u mogućnosti razmotriti prijavu niti provesti selekcijski postupak. 
Osobni podaci kandidata čuvaju se tijekom trajanja natječajnog postupka, a najdulje šest mjeseci od dana zaprimanja prijave, nakon čega se brišu ili uništavaju, osim ako je posebnim propisima predviđena obveza njihova duljeg čuvanja

title: Seamstress (Daily Worker)

title: Patient Experience Associate
description:
When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That’s why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn’t mean we’re not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.


Position Summary


The Patient Experience Associate supports effective delivery and continuous improvement of Patient Support Programs designed to help eligible patients navigate access to prescribed therapies.


Working within the Market Access and Patient Experience team at Alexion, the Associate partners with external PSP service providers and internal cross-functional teams to help patients and healthcare providers navigate the treatment-access journey. This includes supporting reimbursement navigation, program enrolment and services, operational issue resolution, program performance monitoring, and implementation of program enhancements.


The role requires a strong understanding of Canada's healthcare environment, where access pathways can vary by province/territory and between public and private coverage, together with a strong commitment to patient experience, privacy, compliance and operational excellence.



Key Responsibilities


Patient Support Program Operations


  • Support day-to-day operations of assigned Canadian PSPs and patient services.
  • Coordinate activities with PSP vendors, specialty pharmacies and other service providers, as applicable.
  • Develop and obtain internal approval of key documents to support OneSource program and business objectives
  • Monitor service delivery, operational issues and customer concerns and facilitate timely resolution with appropriate collaborators.
  • Support launches, indication expansions, program changes and implementation of new patient services.
  • Maintain program documentation, processes and standard operating procedures as required.

Reimbursement & Patient Access


  • Support PSP services that help patients and healthcare providers navigate public and private reimbursement pathways.
  • Develop an understanding of provincial/territorial drug coverage requirements and relevant private insurance processes.
  • Identify recurring access barriers and work with PSP partners and internal collaborators to improve patient journeys.
  • Monitor changes in the Canadian reimbursement environment that may affect program operations or patient access.



Patient Experience

  • Bring forward insights from program operations, patients, healthcare providers and vendors to inform improvements.
  • Support initiatives designed to enhance accessibility, consistency and quality of PSP services.

Data, Insights & Performance


  • Monitor benchmarks, service levels and operational metrics for assigned programs.
  • Review vendor reports and identify trends, exceptions, operational risks and opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare dashboards, business reviews and presentations communicating PSP performance and insights.
  • Support evaluation of program enhancements and implementation of continuous-improvement initiatives.

Vendor & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Patient Experience, Market Access and other internal functions such as Medical, Regulatory, Legal, Privacy, Pharmacovigilance/Safety, Finance and Procurement, as appropriate.
  • Support vendor governance and business review meetings.

Privacy, Compliance & Governance


  • Handle PSP activities with appropriate consideration for Canadian privacy requirements, company policies and applicable provincial requirements.
  • Support processes designed to protect patients' personal and health information throughout the program.
  • Support program governance, documentation, training, audits and corrective or preventive actions as appropriate.
  • Raise potential privacy, safety, quality or compliance matters through established company processes.



Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree in business, health sciences, life sciences or another relevant field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, patient services, reimbursement, specialty pharmacy or a related field preferred.
  • Knowledge of the Canadian healthcare, reimbursement and drug-access environment is strongly preferred.
  • Experience working with Patient Support Programs or healthcare service providers is an asset.
  • Strong project coordination and organizational capabilities, including ability and demonstrated experience applying latest AI tools in using diverse AI tools to support project management or optimize operations
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret program data and translate findings into actionable insights.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with internal cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to patient privacy, compliance and ethical business practices.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; experience working with dashboards and data-visualization tools is an asset.
  • French-language capability is an asset, particularly for supporting a national Canadian program.



Key Competencies


  • Patient-centric attitude
  • Canadian healthcare and reimbursement competence
  • Operational excellence
  • Vendor and collaborator management
  • Analytical thinking and problem solving
  • Collaboration and influence
  • Accountability and follow-through
  • Learning agility

title: Google Workspace Security Engineer (DLP and Device Management)
description:
Intelance is a UK advisory and assurance firm working across enterprise architecture, cyber assurance, AI governance and data governance. We run information security management systems (ISMS) for growing technology companies certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022. We are appointing a hands on Google Workspace Security Engineer as an associate contractor to close technical security gaps for our clients.

Your first assignment is with an ISO 27001 certified technology company with offices in the UK and Asia. You will set up email data loss prevention (DLP), which stops sensitive data leaving the company by email, and device management, which keeps company laptops and phones secure. The work runs from December 2026 to January 2027 and needs about 6 to 10 days in total.

This is an associate panel role. Each assignment is agreed separately with a written scope, timetable and day rate.

Tasks

  • Review the client's current Google Workspace security settings and agree a short, practical plan.

  • Design and set up Gmail DLP rules for the data that matters most, tested to avoid blocking normal work.

  • Set up and tune device management for laptops and phones, using Google endpoint management or the client's chosen tool (for example Jamf, Kandji or Intune).

  • Apply sensible device rules such as screen lock, disk encryption, updates and remote wipe.

  • Check that each control works and collect clear evidence for the ISO 27001 surveillance audit.

  • Link controls to the client's compliance platform (for example Vanta) where possible.

  • Write short handover notes so the client's team can run the controls after you leave.

  • Follow Intelance quality, security, confidentiality and change control procedures.

Requirements

Essential

  • At least three years of hands on Google Workspace security administration in live company tenants.

  • Has set up Gmail DLP rules in production.

  • Has rolled out device management across macOS and mobile devices in production.

  • Understands how these controls support ISO/IEC 27001:2022 or SOC 2 audits.

  • Careful with change: plans, tests and rolls back safely.

  • Clear, concise writing for handover notes.

  • Based in the UK and able to work as a self-employed contractor.

Desirable

  • Experience with Jamf, Kandji, Mosyle or Microsoft Intune.

  • Experience with Vanta or a similar compliance platform.

  • Google Workspace Administrator or similar certification.

  • Experience with SaaS companies that have staff in more than one country.

Benefits

  • Join Intelance's specialist cyber assurance associate panel.

  • A clear, well scoped first assignment with defined outcomes.

  • Remote work with a written scope, timetable and agreed day rate.

  • Further technical assignments as our managed ISMS client base grows.

  • Flexible, project based work you can fit around other commitments.

Apply with your CV. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for references. Anonymised examples of past work are enough at application stage. Please do not send confidential client material.

title: Associate Program Officer - Food, Nutrition, and Agriculture Program
company: US Government, National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine
description:
Job Description Summary:

ABOUT THE PROGRAM
The Food, Nutrition, and Agriculture program area convenes experts and leaders in food science, food safety, and food quality; nutrition and health; agricultural sciences and natural resources management to provide independent and cross-sector guidance to address a range of challenges in the food and agricultural system.

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY
The Associate Program Officer will perform a variety of programmatic, project management, and research tasks to support the review of the food packages of the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) program. The WIC food packages, previously reviewed by the National Academies in 2017 and 2006, are nutritious supplemental foods provided to low-income pregnant, breastfeeding and non-breastfeeding postpartum women, infants, and children up to five years of age who are at nutritional risk. The review of the food packages involves assessing the nutritional needs of the WIC-eligible population and making evidence-based, practical, and economical recommendations for changes in the current set of foods in the packages that reflect current nutritional science and allow the program to effectively meet the nutritional and cultural needs of the WIC population.

The Associate Program Officer coordinates project activities across planning, implementation, follow-up, and dissemination to help ensure objectives, schedules, and deliverables are met. Conducts and synthesizes research, supports meetings and other convening activities, and works with staff, experts, sponsors, and other stakeholders to advance assigned project activities. May assist senior staff with program and project development, including researching new opportunities, developing prospectuses and proposals, and supporting fundraising activities.

Job Description:

PROJECT MANAGEMENT

Under the general supervision of the Study Director, manages assigned components of studies and projects to support achievement of project objectives, schedules, and deliverables. Coordinates project activities and inquiries and manages the planning and execution of hybrid meetings, workshops, and other convening activities, including agendas, presenter and participant engagement, meeting logistics, multimedia presentations, and written summaries. Collaborates with experts and sponsors from government agencies, foundations, academic institutions, and other organizations. May perform financial and administrative activities related to assigned projects and represents the program or project within and outside the National Academies.


COMMITTEE MANAGEMENT

Where applicable and with senior staff oversight, supports committee or panel formation and operation by identifying potential nominees and coordinating with committee chairs, members, consultants, sponsors, and staff. Facilitates timely information sharing among participants and prepares materials and reports that support committee and project activities.

RESEARCH AND WRITING

Conducts and synthesizes background research to support assigned studies, projects, and committee deliberations. Identifies and evaluates relevant research materials and technical data, assesses their relevance to project objectives, and prepares background papers, technical summaries, and other written materials. Coordinates reference checking and publication activities and may edit reports, support the response-to-review process, and participate in dissemination activities, including engagement with external organizations and preparation of dissemination materials.

STAFF MANAGEMENT

May provide day-to-day direction, guidance, and feedback to assigned staff and assist with mentoring and staff development. Serves as a resource to staff on assigned project activities and supports effective coordination of team responsibilities.

PROJECT DEVELOPMENT

Supports development of new and continuing programs and projects under senior staff guidance. Conducts research on emerging topics and funding opportunities, contributes to prospectuses and proposals, identifies potential sponsors, and supports fundraising activities for current and future work. Where applicable, participates in maintaining relationships with funders, members, alumni, and other external partners.

Related duties and special projects may be assigned as needed.


REQUIREMENTS

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Knowledge of scientific, technical, policy, or other issues relevant to the applicable discipline.
  • Strong project coordination and organizational skills, including the ability to manage assigned activities, schedules, stakeholders, and deliverables.
  • Ability to conduct research, evaluate and synthesize information from multiple sources, and communicate findings clearly in written and verbal form.
  • Ability to identify and resolve varied project issues, exercise sound judgment, and work with appropriate independence within established project objectives, institutional policies, and senior staff guidance.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt to changing project needs, and maintain attention to quality, accuracy, and deadlines.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues, experts, sponsors, and other internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to build productive working relationships and contribute effectively in collaborative and multidisciplinary environments.
  • Ability to provide clear direction, guidance, and feedback to staff when assigned staff-coordination or mentoring responsibilities.

EDUCATION

Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent knowledge required. Master's degree in related field preferred.


EXPERIENCE

Three years of related professional experience required.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Compensation & Benefits: An estimated compensation range for this position is $73,760 - $92,190. Compensation offered to the selected candidate will be based on the candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, and work experience, commensurate with compensation of current employees in comparable positions with similar knowledge, skills, and work experience, and subject to budget parameters. Note it is not typical for a candidate to be hired at the higher end of the range. This is a benefits-eligible position. Our Benefits Plan offers competitive and comprehensive benefit options, including medical, dental and vision insurance, life insurance, disability coverage, retirement and savings benefits, leave benefits such as paid holidays and paid personal leave, transportation subsidies, and education assistance. For more information, please click

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Hybrid office/telecommute environment, expected onsite percentage 60%, with occasional travel between National Academies’ facilities and to off-site meeting/sponsor locations.

EQUAL OPPORTUNTY EMPLOYER

It is also the institution's policy to recruit, hire, promote, and provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities and covered veterans who are otherwise qualified.

title: Operational Excellence Manager
description:
At Smiths Detection, we are looking for an experienced Operational Excellence Manager to lead the deployment of Operational Excellence initiatives at our Johor manufacturing site. This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for driving sustainable improvements across Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost and People (SPQDC) while embedding a culture of continuous improvement and operational discipline.

You will work closely with site leadership and global stakeholders to implement Lean methodologies, deliver measurable business impact, and help shape the future of manufacturing excellence across the organization.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead Operational Excellence Strategy

  • Define and execute the Johor site's Operational Excellence roadmap.
  • Embed Lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement practices across operations.
  • Drive Industry 4.0, sustainability, waste reduction and productivity initiatives.
  • Implement Daily Management Systems, Visual Management and Leader Standard Work.
  • Lead strategic improvement projects focused on quality, cost, delivery and customer satisfaction.

Drive Continuous Improvement

  • Facilitate Kaizen events, Value Stream Mapping workshops and problem-solving initiatives.
  • Deploy structured methodologies to resolve operational challenges and improve factory performance.
  • Lead PFMEA, 7 QC Tools and Poka-Yoke initiatives to improve quality and process reliability.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities and deliver measurable results.

Build Capability & Culture

  • Coach and mentor leaders and employees in Lean, Six Sigma and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Champion a data-driven, customer-focused approach to decision-making.
  • Influence and support leadership teams in driving sustainable cultural change.
  • Share best practices across global Operational Excellence communities.

Governance & Performance Management

  • Track and report key operational KPIs.
  • Ensure governance processes drive accountability and corrective action.
  • Align site reporting with global operational standards.
  • Provide visibility and insights to support strategic business decisions.

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations Management or similar discipline.
  • 8-10 years' experience within manufacturing environments.
  • At least 5 years of Operational Excellence, Lean or Continuous Improvement leadership experience.
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or equivalent
  • Demonstrated success leading Lean transformations and delivering measurable business improvements.
  • Strong knowledge of Lean Management Systems, structured problem solving and cultural change deployment.
  • Experience working with manufacturing operations, quality, supply chain and engineering teams.
  • Advanced proficiency with data analysis and reporting tools such as Power BI, Minitab and Excel.

Preferred

  • Experience within highly regulated industries such as aerospace, security, medical devices, electronics or advanced manufacturing.
  • Master's degree, MBA, Black Belt certification or equivalent advanced qualification.
  • Experience with ERP and MES systems.
  • Exposure to Industry 4.0 initiatives and digital manufacturing technologies.

Who You Are

  • A strong change agent with exceptional influencing and coaching skills.
  • Comfortable engaging stakeholders from the shop floor through to senior leadership.
  • Analytical, data-driven and passionate about solving complex operational challenges.
  • Resilient, proactive and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A collaborative leader who can translate strategy into tangible operational results.

Why Join Us?

title: Part-Time Food & Beverage Associate I
description:
The Role:

San Jose, CA - Part Time - 2pm-6:30pm Monday-Friday

Crafty’s Food & Beverage Associates are the face of our in-office Concierge pantry program. They are the human element and the friendly face that leads client-site execution on a daily basis; supporting the site’s product merchandising, inventory management & order replacement, in addition to equipment management.

This is a high-energy role for people who derive joy from a meticulously organized shelf and positive energy from being around people. Crafty is looking for an Associate whose responsibilities will include:

  • Merchandising: Take pride in your spaces by owning client’s office kitchens & pantries and highly organized storage rooms, complete expiration checks and product rotations as needed
  • Customer Service: With support from your manager, engage with our clients and other Crafty team members onsite, delivering the highest quality service
  • Maintenance + Inventory: Perform routine maintenance on machines (such as coffee & kegerators), quality control checks, and completion of task lists (inventory, budget)
  • Communication: Communicate and escalate any location needs or safety concerns your manager, and accurately complete pre/post route paperwork

This role is a part-time, hourly role within Crafty. This role supports one of our Chicago, clients Monday through Friday 2:00PM - 6:30 by meeting the skill based qualifications below:


Required Attributes

  • Client Obsessed: Demonstrates a deep commitment to understanding and exceeding client needs and preferences, consistently showing eagerness and patience in all client interactions.
  • Effective Communicator: Demonstrates exceptional communication skills across interpersonal, verbal, and written formats to ensure clear, accurate, and positive interactions.
  • Operationally Sound: Ensures that all operations run smoothly, efficiently, and effectively, adhering to best practices and standards.
  • Reliable: Shows accountability, punctuality, and consistency in fulfilling commitments. Maintaining high service standards, fostering client trust, and contributing to operational efficiency.
  • Resilient: Quickly adapts to change, anticipates and addresses challenges with strong problem-solving skills, and maintains a positive attitude to ensure ongoing success.
    • Must be able to remain stationary for 50% of the time and capable of pushing, pulling, and lifting boxes weighing up to 50 pounds throughout the client site as needed
  • Collaborative:
    • Encompasses the ability to work effectively with others towards shared goals while providing and receiving constructive input to enhance individual and team performance
    • Demonstrates a team-oriented approach, emphasizing teamwork, supportive behavior, constructive conflict resolution, and a commitment to shared success.
  • Autonomy: Autonomy empowers client operations team members to act decisively, innovate, and continuously improve, ultimately leading to enhanced client relationships, operational efficiency, and overall success in their roles through site and task ownership.
  • Attention to Detail: Demonstrates exceptional attention to detail by meticulously overseeing merchandising, inventory management, and ownership responsibilities to ensure precision, consistency, and excellence in all aspects of operations.

Don’t meet all of the qualifications? We want you to consider all of your skills and experiences - both professional and personal- that would make you successful in this role. Although some qualifications are essential, others can be attained with time. We believe diverse perspectives, upbringings, and knowledge contribute to our strong company culture and we encourage you to apply.

Role Goals

Goal: Achieve a 95% annual client retention rate by delivering top-tier on-site operations and exceptional client experiences, ensuring all client goals are met and exceeded, for at least 6 consecutive months by completing these initiatives:

  • Initiative #1: Task Ownership: Complete daily task lists with an average of 95% successful shift completion week over week as measured via Tableau on a monthly basis.
  • Initiative #2: Quality control: Maintain an average of 95% or greater on all quality control checks quarterly.
  • Initiative #3: Client Satisfaction: Assist in supporting all client requests on a weekly basis, working with your manager and the site point of contact.

What we offer

Our people mean everything to us. When you join Crafty, you’re joining a team of passionate, smart people who work incredibly hard and have fun along the way.

We are proud to offer a compensation package that includes our Crafty healthcare plan, covering primary health, dental, and vision plans, 401k, paid time off, equipment certification courses, and parental leave. And, of course, it also includes Crafty-grade snacks, beverages, and fun events!

Lastly, this role offers a special opportunity: to have a major hand in shaping the future of a young, flourishing company. Your creativity, ambition, and work will steer the direction of our successes.

Our compensation amount for this role is $24 an hour. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including cost of living based on location, candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Crafty provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without discriminating against race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or genetics.
